title.en: Explore the Voucher Center discovery flow
title.zh: 操作 Voucher Center 探索流程

task.en: Find a Voucher that is relevant to your shopping context.
task.zh: 找出符合目前購物情境的優惠券。

whatToNotice.en: Notice how the permanent entry, category access and recommended content create one discovery path.
whatToNotice.zh: 留意常設入口、分類存取與推薦內容如何形成一條探索路徑。

en: Open a Voucher to understand the next action
zh: 開啟 Voucher 並理解下一步

measurementPeriod.zh: 易用性測試・2024 年 11 月

attributionBoundary.en: I led the prototype and interaction design; research planning and synthesis were shared with Research and Product.
attributionBoundary.zh: 我主導原型與互動設計；研究規劃與統整由研究團隊、產品團隊與我共同完成。

headline.en: I turned fragmented incentive work into one reusable product direction across five shopping stages.
headline.zh: 我將分散的獎勵工作整合為橫跨五個購物階段的單一可重用產品方向。

supportingStatement.en: Led research synthesis, system framing, end-to-end journey strategy, interaction architecture and recurring validation.
supportingStatement.zh: 主導研究統整、系統定義、端到端旅程策略、互動架構與持續驗證。

voucher.transformation: From fragmented campaign logic to a reusable incentive system
voucher.transformation_zh: 從分散的活動規則，到可重用的獎勵系統
voucher.summary: A multi-year programme turned fragmented customer, commercial and operational evidence into shared cross-channel incentive rules and shipped capabilities.
voucher.summary_zh: 一項多年期計畫，將分散的顧客、商業與營運證據轉化為共享的跨通路獎勵規則與正式上線能力。
voucher.owned: Evidence synthesis · Cross-channel system framing · Journey strategy · Initiative design · Workshop co-facilitation · Shared taxonomy and state modelling
voucher.owned_zh: 證據統整・跨通路系統定義・旅程策略・產品計畫設計・工作坊共同主持・共享分類與狀態模型
voucher.at_glance: Led the three-year evolution of FairPrice’s incentive experience, turning fragmented Voucher logic into reusable rules across product, checkout, Wallet and in-store journeys.
voucher.at_glance_zh: 主導 FairPrice 三年期獎勵體驗演進，將分散的 Voucher 邏輯轉化為橫跨商品、結帳、Wallet 與門市旅程的可重用規則。
voucher.audience:
Primary: Customers
Secondary: Operations, Marketing, Product, Engineering
voucher.audience_zh:
主要：顧客
次要：營運、行銷、產品、工程
voucher.why: Voucher rules had evolved separately by campaign and channel, leaving discovery, eligibility, redemption, and internal setup inconsistent across the retail ecosystem.
voucher.why_zh: 優惠券規則隨活動與通路各自發展，使探索、資格判斷、兌換與內部設定在整個零售生態中缺乏一致性。
voucher.impact: Established shared incentive rules and reusable product foundations, reducing the need to reinterpret and rebuild voucher behaviour for every campaign.
voucher.impact_zh: 建立共享獎勵規則與可重用產品基礎，降低每次活動都必須重新解讀與重建優惠券行為的依賴。

eyebrow.zh: 多年期獎勵系統計畫・2022–2025

title.en: From fragmented campaign logic to a reusable incentive system
title.zh: 從分散的活動規則，到可重用的獎勵系統

atAGlance.en: Led the three-year evolution of FairPrice’s incentive experience, turning fragmented Voucher logic into reusable rules across product, checkout, Wallet and in-store journeys.
atAGlance.zh: 主導 FairPrice 三年期獎勵體驗演進，將分散的 Voucher 邏輯轉化為橫跨商品、結帳、Wallet 與門市旅程的可重用規則。

audience.en:
Primary: Customers
Secondary: Operations, Marketing, Product, Engineering
audience.zh:
主要：顧客
次要：營運、行銷、產品、工程

whyItMattered.en: Voucher rules had evolved separately by campaign and channel, leaving discovery, eligibility, redemption, and internal setup inconsistent across the retail ecosystem.
whyItMattered.zh: 優惠券規則隨活動與通路各自發展，使探索、資格判斷、兌換與內部設定在整個零售生態中缺乏一致性。

businessImpact.en: Established shared incentive rules and reusable product foundations, reducing the need to reinterpret and rebuild voucher behaviour for every campaign.
businessImpact.zh: 建立共享獎勵規則與可重用產品基礎，降低每次活動都必須重新解讀與重建優惠券行為的依賴。

confidentialityNote.en: For confidentiality reasons, exact metrics are not disclosed.
confidentialityNote.zh: 基於保密原因，未公開精確數據。

title.en: Value had to appear in the shopping journey—not outside it
title.zh: 優惠價值必須出現在購物旅程中，而不是旅程之外

statement.en: Customers did not need more Vouchers. They needed value to appear in the right shopping context, with clear eligibility and a trustworthy path to application.
statement.zh: 顧客需要的不是更多優惠券，而是讓價值在正確購物情境中出現，並具備清楚資格與可信任的套用路徑。

signals.en: Value appeared outside the shopping flow
signals.zh: 優惠價值出現在購物流程之外
資格條件直到太晚才被理解

signals.en: One action did not fit every Voucher mechanic
signals.zh: 單一操作無法適用所有優惠券機制
手動套用造成漏用優惠的焦慮

signals.en: States and terminology changed across channels
signals.zh: 狀態與名詞隨通路改變

title.en: From evidence to a shared product direction
title.zh: 從證據走向共享產品方向

content.en: Mapped how issuance mechanisms, Voucher types, product services, payment paths and redemption locations intersected across Online Grocery, Scan & Go, LinkPay and Kopitiam.
content.zh: 盤點發放機制、優惠券類型、產品服務、付款路徑與兌換地點，如何橫跨 Online Grocery、Scan & Go、LinkPay 與 Kopitiam。

content.en: Co-planned and co-facilitated a cross-functional workshop that synthesised prior research, shared pain points and journey-specific opportunities into five experience principles and initial product directions.
content.zh: 共同規劃並主持跨職能工作坊，將既有研究、共同痛點與旅程機會收斂成五項體驗原則與初步產品方向。

content.en: Tested behavioural assumptions through usability studies, experience surveys, product analytics and operational evidence before turning selected directions into shipped capabilities.
content.zh: 透過可用性測試、體驗問卷、產品分析與營運證據驗證行為假設，再將選定方向轉化為正式上線能力。

strategyLine.en: Bring value into the shopping journey, make eligibility explicit and reduce application effort through shared rules and states.
strategyLine.zh: 把優惠價值帶入購物旅程，明確揭露資格，並透過共享規則與狀態降低套用負擔。

label.zh: 份既有兌換使用者問卷
條件理解分數，為四項旅程指標最低

label.en: of classified comments concerned finding or applying Vouchers
label.zh: 已分類意見與尋找或套用優惠券有關

publicProofs.detail: Online Grocery · Scan & Go · LinkPay · Kopitiam
Discoverability · Personalisation · Perceived Value · Effortless Redemption · Sense of Delight

corePlanningAndCoFacilitation.en: Co-planned and co-facilitated with the Design Manager, UX Researcher and Offers PM.
corePlanningAndCoFacilitation.zh: 與設計主管、使用者研究員及優惠產品經理共同規劃並主持。

ownedByMe.en: Created journey task flows for Online Grocery, Scan & Go, LinkPay and Kopitiam.
ownedByMe.zh: 建立 Online Grocery、Scan & Go、LinkPay 與 Kopitiam 的旅程任務流程。

ownedByMe.en: Mapped the existing Voucher mechanisms, types, services, payment paths and redemption locations.
ownedByMe.zh: 盤點既有優惠券機制、類型、服務、付款路徑與兌換地點。

ownedByMe.en: Visualised the cross-channel Voucher structure as the shared workshop foundation.
ownedByMe.zh: 將跨通路優惠券結構視覺化，作為工作坊的共同基礎。

coCreated: Preliminary Voucher, Offer and promo-code definitions

maturityBoundary.en: The workshop definitions were directional hypotheses, not the later validated operating taxonomy.
maturityBoundary.zh: 工作坊定義屬於方向性假設，並非後續經驗證的正式營運分類。

title.en: From a shared hypothesis to a validated operating model
title.zh: 從共享假設，到經驗證的營運模型

label.zh: 早期共享假設・2023 年 9 月

items.zh: 優惠券需要顧客採取行動
促銷代碼需要輸入代碼

label.zh: 後期經驗證的營運模型

title.en: From wallet-dependent exposure to contextual discovery
title.zh: 從依賴錢包曝光，到情境式探索

problem.en: Voucher value often appeared outside the moment customers were deciding what to buy.
problem.zh: Voucher 價值經常出現在顧客決定購買內容的決策時刻之外。

direction.en: Surface relevant value within product, search and in-store contexts.
direction.zh: 在商品、搜尋與門市情境中呈現相關價值。

representativeShippedSignal.en: Connected relevant Voucher visibility to shopping contexts such as PDP and Voucher Details, rather than relying on Wallet discovery alone.
representativeShippedSignal.zh: 將相關 Voucher 曝光連結至 PDP 與 Voucher Details 等購物情境，而非只依賴 Wallet 探索。

keyInsight.en: Voucher value often appeared outside the moment customers were deciding what to buy.
keyInsight.zh: Voucher 價值經常出現在顧客決定購買內容的決策時刻之外。

whatChanged.en: Surface relevant value within product, search and in-store contexts.
whatChanged.zh: 在商品、搜尋與門市情境中呈現相關價值。

shipped.zh: 將相關 Voucher 曝光連結至 PDP 與 Voucher Details 等購物情境，而非只依賴 Wallet 探索。

keyInsight.en: Voucher value often appeared outside the moment customers were deciding what to buy.
keyInsight.zh: Voucher 價值經常出現在顧客決定購買內容的決策時刻之外。

designDirection.en: Surface relevant value within product, search and in-store contexts.
designDirection.zh: 在商品、搜尋與門市情境中呈現相關價值。

designSolution.en: Connected relevant Voucher visibility to shopping contexts such as PDP and Voucher Details, rather than relying on Wallet discovery alone.
designSolution.zh: 將相關 Voucher 曝光連結至 PDP 與 Voucher Details 等購物情境，而非只依賴 Wallet 探索。

outcome.en: Relevant Voucher value became visible closer to purchase intent, reducing the need to leave the shopping journey to find or interpret applicable offers.
outcome.zh: 相關 Voucher 價值更接近購買意圖出現，減少顧客為尋找或理解適用優惠而離開購物旅程的需要。

title.en: From unclear conditions to confident eligibility
title.zh: 從不清楚的條件，到有把握的資格判斷

problem.en: Customers had to interpret product, channel and threshold conditions before knowing whether a Voucher was useful.
problem.zh: 顧客必須先解讀商品、通路與門檻條件，才能判斷 Voucher 是否有用。

direction.zh: 在顧客投入前讓資格判定容易理解。

representativeShippedSignal.en: Linked Voucher conditions to eligible items, channel requirements, savings and remaining thresholds.
representativeShippedSignal.zh: 將 Voucher 條件連結至適用商品、通路要求、節省金額與剩餘門檻。

caption.en: Eligibility evidence connects product, channel, threshold and action rules before commitment.
caption.zh: 資格判斷證據在顧客投入前，連結商品、通路、門檻與操作規則。

alt.en: Placeholder reserved for a system visual showing Voucher eligibility and applicable-state rules.
alt.zh: 預留給呈現優惠券資格與適用狀態規則的系統視覺。

keyInsight.en: Customers had to interpret product, channel and threshold conditions before knowing whether a Voucher was useful.
keyInsight.zh: 顧客必須先解讀商品、通路與門檻條件，才能判斷 Voucher 是否有用。

whatChanged.zh: 在顧客投入前讓資格判定容易理解。

shipped.zh: 將 Voucher 條件連結至適用商品、通路要求、節省金額與剩餘門檻。

keyInsight.en: Customers had to interpret product, channel and threshold conditions before knowing whether a Voucher was useful.
keyInsight.zh: 顧客必須先解讀商品、通路與門檻條件，才能判斷 Voucher 是否有用。

designDirection.zh: 在顧客投入前讓資格判定容易理解。

designSolution.en: Linked Voucher conditions to eligible items, channel requirements, savings and remaining thresholds.
designSolution.zh: 將 Voucher 條件連結至適用商品、通路要求、節省金額與剩餘門檻。

outcome.en: Eligibility became explicit at the point of decision, reducing interpretation effort and making remaining qualification requirements visible before checkout.
outcome.zh: 資格判定在決策節點變得明確，降低解讀負擔，並在結帳前呈現尚待完成的資格要求。

title.en: From generic collection to mechanic-specific participation
title.zh: 從通用領取，到符合機制的參與方式

problem.en: High-volume campaign participation depended on continuity across entry, browsing and return access—not a single campaign touchpoint.
problem.zh: 高流量活動的參與仰賴入口、瀏覽與返回存取之間的連續性，而非單一活動接觸點。

direction.en: Create a continuous activation journey from campaign entry to repeat Voucher access.
direction.zh: 建立從活動入口到重複存取 Voucher 的連續啟動旅程。

representativeShippedSignal.en: Connected campaign entry points, the dedicated Save Every Day Voucher experience and Wallet access into one repeatable participation path.
representativeShippedSignal.zh: 將活動入口、專屬 Save Every Day Voucher 體驗與 Wallet 存取串成可重複使用的參與路徑。

caption.en: Participation actions changed with the incentive mechanic instead of using one generic collection action.
caption.zh: 參與操作依獎勵機制改變，而不是套用單一通用領取行為。

alt.en: Placeholder reserved for a flow showing mechanic-specific Save, Claim, Add item or participation actions.
alt.zh: 預留給呈現依機制使用儲存、領取、加入商品或參與操作的流程。

keyInsight.en: High-volume campaign participation depended on continuity across entry, browsing and return access—not a single campaign touchpoint.
keyInsight.zh: 高流量活動的參與仰賴入口、瀏覽與返回存取之間的連續性，而非單一活動接觸點。

whatChanged.en: Create a continuous activation journey from campaign entry to repeat Voucher access.
whatChanged.zh: 建立從活動入口到重複存取 Voucher 的連續啟動旅程。

designDirection.zh: 建立從活動入口到重複存取 Voucher 的連續啟動旅程。

designSolution.en: Connected campaign entry points, the dedicated Save Every Day Voucher experience and Wallet access into one repeatable participation path.
designSolution.zh: 將活動入口、專屬 Save Every Day Voucher 體驗與 Wallet 存取串成可重複使用的參與路徑。

outcome.en: Campaign Vouchers remained easier to rediscover after first exposure, reducing re-entry friction across the campaign lifecycle.
outcome.zh: 活動 Voucher 在首次曝光後仍更容易再次找到，降低整個活動生命週期的重新進入阻力。

title.en: From manual trial and error to explicit application states
title.zh: 從手動試錯，到明確的套用狀態

problem.en: Customers had to judge Voucher applicability and selection rules on their own.
problem.zh: 顧客必須自行判斷 Voucher 適用性與選取規則。

direction.en: Move redemption logic from customer judgment into system guidance.
direction.zh: 將兌換邏輯從顧客自行判斷轉為系統引導。

representativeShippedSignal.en: Grouped applicable and unavailable Vouchers, enabled Select all for bulk selection, and surfaced non-stackable conflicts before checkout.
representativeShippedSignal.zh: 將適用與不可用 Voucher 分組，提供 Select all 批次選取，並在結帳前呈現不可疊加衝突。

caption.en: Explicit application and recovery states reduced trial-and-error during redemption.
caption.zh: 明確的套用與復原狀態，降低兌換過程中的反覆試錯。

alt.en: Placeholder reserved for a redemption and recovery flow with explicit application states.
alt.zh: 預留給具明確套用狀態的兌換與復原流程。

keyInsight.zh: 顧客必須自行判斷 Voucher 適用性與選取規則。

whatChanged.zh: 將兌換邏輯從顧客自行判斷轉為系統引導。

outcome.en: Redemption became more system-guided, reducing manual applicability checks and surfacing invalid combinations before checkout.
outcome.zh: 兌換流程轉為更明確的系統引導，減少手動適用性檢查，並在結帳前揭露無效組合。

title.en: From uncertain outcomes to visible value confirmation
title.zh: 從不確定的結果，到可見的價值確認

problem.en: High-volume Voucher use made payment harder when customers had to work out which Vouchers could actually be applied.
problem.zh: 在大量使用 Voucher 時，若顧客必須自行判斷哪些 Voucher 能實際套用，付款決策會更加困難。

direction.en: Make Voucher application status explicit inside payment.
direction.zh: 在付款流程中明確呈現 Voucher 套用狀態。

representativeShippedSignal.en: Owned the Voucher interaction and rule logic, partnering with the Payment designer to integrate Voucher access and added / not-added review into the payment flow.
representativeShippedSignal.zh: 負責 Voucher 互動與規則邏輯，並與 Payment designer 協作，將 Voucher 存取及已加入／未加入檢視整合至付款流程。

caption.en: Post-use evidence should confirm savings, usage or returned value without overstating future-state coverage.
caption.zh: 使用後證據應確認節省、使用或退回價值，且不誇大尚未全面實現的狀態。

alt.en: Placeholder reserved for a post-use Voucher state confirming savings, usage or returned value.
alt.zh: 預留給確認節省、使用或退回價值的使用後優惠券狀態。

keyInsight.zh: 在大量使用 Voucher 時，若顧客必須自行判斷哪些 Voucher 能實際套用，付款決策會更加困難。

designDirection.zh: 在付款流程中明確呈現 Voucher 套用狀態。

designSolution.zh: 負責 Voucher 互動與規則邏輯，並與 Payment designer 協作，將 Voucher 存取及已加入／未加入檢視整合至付款流程。

outcome.en: Customers could verify applied and unapplied Vouchers before continuing, increasing transparency at the payment decision point.
outcome.zh: 顧客可在繼續付款前確認已套用與未套用的 Voucher，提高付款決策節點的透明度。

title.en: Annual campaign digitisation
title.zh: 年度活動數位化

previousCondition.en: Save Everyday operated mainly through physical coupons at selected stores, with only 10 app-exclusive coupons.
previousCondition.zh: Save Everyday 主要依靠特定門市的紙本優惠券，App 專屬優惠券僅有 10 張。

decision.en: Build one journey from offline discovery to in-app saving and digital redemption across major shopping channels.
decision.zh: 建立從線下探索、App 內儲存到主要購物通路數位兌換的一體化旅程。

outcome.en: The final three weeks delivered ~125K digital redemptions; 30.6% of all campaign redemptions were digital in that period.
outcome.zh: 最後三週帶來約 12.5 萬次數位兌換；該期間所有活動兌換中有 30.6% 為數位兌換。

title.en: Eligibility-aware application
title.zh: 具資格判斷的套用

previousCondition.en: Customers had to discover, interpret and select value without knowing what matched the current cart or channel.
previousCondition.zh: 顧客必須在不知道目前購物車或通路適用什麼的情況下，自行探索、解讀並選擇優惠。

decision.en: Use cart and channel context to distinguish applicable value before payment.
decision.zh: 在付款前，利用購物車與通路情境區分適用優惠。

title.en: Shared integration model
title.zh: 共享整合模型

previousCondition.en: Partner Vouchers relied on separate presentation and redemption behaviours.
previousCondition.zh: 合作夥伴優惠券依賴分離的呈現與兌換行為。

decision.en: Bring Partner Vouchers into the same customer journey through shared eligibility, list and Voucher Card patterns.
decision.zh: 透過共享資格、列表與優惠券卡片模式，讓合作夥伴優惠券進入同一顧客旅程。

summary.en: Converted fragmented customer, commercial and implementation knowledge into shared definitions, rules, states and reusable delivery patterns.
summary.zh: 將分散的顧客、商業與實作知識，轉化為共享定義、規則、狀態與可重用交付模式。

content.en: Voucher, Offer, Promo Code, categories and channel definitions
content.zh: 優惠券、優惠、促銷代碼、分類與通路定義

content.en: Eligibility, applicability, value, thresholds and redemption logic
content.zh: 資格、適用性、價值、門檻與兌換邏輯

content.en: Added, selected, applied, used, expired and returned
content.zh: 已加入、已選取、已套用、已使用、已過期與已退回

content.en: Interaction patterns, content guidance, Voucher Card and implementation guidance
content.zh: 互動模式、內容指引、優惠券卡片與實作指引

designSystemBoundary.en: Early Voucher Card exploration must remain labelled as not yet Design System. Only later formal shared components may be labelled shipped Design System evidence.
designSystemBoundary.zh: 早期優惠券卡片探索必須標示為尚未進入設計系統；只有後期正式共享元件才能標為已上線設計系統證據。

terminologyEvidence.en: A cross-channel terminology audit identified conflicting labels across Wallet, payment, external codes, campaign pages and receipts, then proposed one customer-facing language for each value type.
terminologyEvidence.zh: 跨通路用語稽核盤點錢包、付款、外部代碼、活動頁與收據中的衝突名稱，並為不同價值類型提出一致的顧客用語。

led: Selected initiative design and phased planning

relationship.en: A separately shipped customer product that realised part of the broader vision through clearer discovery, eligibility and application states.
relationship.zh: 獨立上線的顧客產品，透過更清楚的探索、資格與套用狀態，實現整體願景的部分方向。

recommendedVisualSequence: Problem: rules-only page and multi-click path
2024 shipped: eligible products and Add to Cart
System proof: four condition types mapped to channel actions
2025 shipped: progressive disclosure moves products higher
Outcome: redrawn approximate observational ATC trend
voucherDetailsShoppableJourney.interactionRule: Reuse the existing image viewer and evidence rail. Do not introduce a nested case or separate carousel system.

recommendedVisualSequence: Research tension: compact glanceability versus full information
Component model: variants, properties, states and accessibility
Cross-journey reuse: Wallet, Checkout, Campaign and error states
Operating-model change: Operations setup to shared coded component
voucherCardComponentSystem.interactionRule: Reuse the existing evidence viewer and Design Decision blocks. Do not create a separate Design System case renderer.

eyebrow.zh: 0→1 數位年度活動・已上線

title.en: From a store-only coupon event to a recurring omnichannel savings campaign
title.zh: 從僅限門市的優惠券活動，到可持續運作的年度全通路省錢活動

atAGlance.en: Co-created the 0→1 digital edition of Save Everyday, expanding an established store campaign from 10 app-exclusive coupons to 400+ in-app Vouchers and connecting offline discovery to saving and redemption across Online Grocery, Scan & Go and FairPrice Pay.
atAGlance.zh: 與團隊從 0→1 建立 Save Everyday 的數位版本，將既有門市活動從 10 張 App 專屬優惠券擴展為 400+ 張 App 內優惠券，並把線下探索串接至 Online Grocery、Scan & Go 與 FairPrice Pay 的儲存及兌換旅程。

label.zh: App 內可用優惠券規模

label.en: digital redemptions in the final three weeks

label.zh: 全部兌換來自數位通路

performanceSummary.en: The final three weeks reached 51.1k digital customers across 64.1k transactions. Early Save all tracking showed active redemption participation at 21.7% in Online Grocery / Scan & Go—2.2× the pre-launch rate—and 12.65% in FairPrice Pay, 56% above the prior rate.
performanceSummary.zh: 最後三週涵蓋 5.11 萬名數位顧客與 6.41 萬筆交易。全部儲存的早期追蹤顯示，Online Grocery／Scan & Go 的主動兌換參與率達 21.7%，為上線前的 2.2 倍；FairPrice Pay 則達 12.65%，較先前提高 56%。

businessImpact.en: Established a repeatable annual campaign model that linked offline reach, in-app engagement and digital redemption instead of running the event as a separate store-only coupon programme.
businessImpact.zh: 建立可重複使用的年度活動模型，串接線下觸及、App 內互動與數位兌換，不再讓活動只停留在獨立的門市紙本優惠券計畫。

metricFootnote.en: Save all comparisons are early observational tracking across adjacent periods, not randomised causal tests.
metricFootnote.zh: 全部儲存比較為相鄰期間的早期觀察追蹤，並非隨機因果實驗。

publicMetrics.label: digital redemptions in the final three weeks of 2023
digital share in the final three weeks of 2023

eyebrow.zh: 第二年演進・階段性證據

title.en: From digital campaign launch to a shoppable omnichannel operating model
title.zh: 從數位活動上線，到可直接購物的全通路運作模型

summary.en: The 2024 campaign extended the original digital model with pre-loaded Vouchers, shoppable eligible-item journeys, a web fallback for non-app customers and stronger product-level mechanics.
summary.zh: 2024 年活動在原有數位模型上加入預載優惠券、可購物的適用品項旅程、非 App 顧客 Web 替代方案，以及更清楚的商品層級機制。

performanceProof.en: Across comparable post-drop weeks, total redemptions were approximately 5-20% above 2023 and digital share was about 4-7 percentage points higher.
performanceProof.zh: 在可比較的優惠券發放週期中，總兌換量約高於 2023 年 5–20%，數位兌換占比約提升 4–7 個百分點。

title.en: Selected initiatives
title.zh: 代表性子專案

summary.en: Two shipped initiatives showing how the programme model was applied to different commercial and customer behaviours.
summary.zh: 兩個正式上線的子專案，呈現計畫模式如何被應用在不同商業目標與顧客行為中。

title.en: Continue exploring
title.zh: 繼續探索

summary.en: A research-led product for persistent Voucher discovery, eligibility and application.
summary.zh: 以研究為基礎、持續支援優惠券探索、資格判斷與套用的獨立產品。

summary.en: A separate incentive product built around effort-to-reward progression.
summary.zh: 以投入與獎勵進程為核心的獨立獎勵產品。

title.en: Create one decision model for a fragmented incentive ecosystem
title.zh: 為分散的獎勵生態建立共同決策模型

summary.en: The work needed to align customer behaviour, commercial rules, operations and product delivery across channels—not redesign one Voucher surface.
summary.zh: 這項工作需要對齊跨通路的顧客行為、商業規則、營運與產品交付，而不是只改版單一優惠券介面。

cardLabel.zh: 情境式探索・PDP 優化

headline.en: Make Voucher value visible where customers decide what to buy
headline.zh: 在顧客決定購買的商品頁，讓優惠券價值清楚可見

proofStripDraft: 4/5 recalled all deals in the grouped concept vs 0/5 in the separated concept
9/10 continued to add items directly from PDP
Internal campaign analysis: 83.8% digital redemption share

atAGlance.en: Led problem framing, hypothesis, end-to-end design and rollout of contextual PDP Voucher discovery, testing two directions with 10 customers and shipping an Eligible Voucher swimlane at a high-intent product touchpoint.
atAGlance.zh: 主導 PDP 情境式優惠券探索的問題定義、假設、端到端設計與推行，以 10 位顧客測試兩個方向，並在高購買意圖接觸點上線適用優惠券橫向內容列。

whyItMattered.en: Voucher value was difficult to notice while customers decided what to buy, and qualification rules remained disconnected from the product journey.
whyItMattered.zh: 顧客決定購買什麼時，很難注意到優惠券價值；使用條件也與商品探索旅程脫節。

businessImpact.en: Established a contextual Voucher-discovery pattern that connected product visibility, eligibility and downstream redemption, later referenced in campaign performance analysis.
businessImpact.zh: 建立將商品可見性、資格判斷與後續兌換串接起來的情境式優惠券探索模式，並在後續活動成效分析中被視為重要改善因素。

title.en: From Voucher rules to a condition-aware shopping journey
title.zh: 從優惠券規則，到理解條件並可直接購物的旅程

ownershipLine.en: Primary Design Lead · End-to-end flows, system variants and final UI specifications
ownershipLine.zh: 主要設計負責人・端到端流程、系統版本與最終 UI 規格

atAGlance.en: Led two shipped releases for a roughly 220k-user touchpoint: enabling eligible products to be added directly to cart, then moving them above lengthy instructions, supported by a reusable model for four Voucher condition types and channel-specific actions.
atAGlance.zh: 主導約 22 萬名使用者接觸點的兩次上線：先讓適用商品可直接加入購物車，再將商品移到冗長說明之前，並建立涵蓋四種優惠券條件類型與依通路設計的操作的可重用模型。

headline.en: One Voucher Details framework, four condition types, channel-specific actions
headline.zh: 一套優惠券詳情架構、四種條件類型、依通路對應操作

title.en: From campaign Vouchers to an intent-led incentive platform
title.zh: 從活動型優惠券，到意圖導向獎勵平台

summary.en: The future direction connected earlier discovery, explicit customer intent, best-value application and post-purchase rewards with a measurable sponsor operating model across channels.
summary.zh: 此未來方向將更早的探索、明確顧客意圖、最佳價值套用與購買後獎勵，整合成可衡量的跨通路贊助單位運作模型。

content.en: Relevant discovery, clear criteria, visible savings and lower redemption effort.
content.zh: 相關探索、清楚條件、可見節省金額與較低兌換負擔。

content.en: Flexible targeting, measurable behaviour change and lower campaign setup and redemption overhead.
content.zh: 彈性分眾設定、可衡量行為改變，以及較低的從設定到請款負擔。

content.en: Shared taxonomy, eligibility, states, behaviour signals and cross-channel measurement.
content.zh: 共享分類架構、資格判斷、狀態、行為訊號與跨通路衡量。

northStar.en: Capture customer intent earlier, then reduce application effort through channel-appropriate mechanics.
northStar.zh: 更早取得顧客意圖，再以符合通路的機制降低套用負擔。

title.en: From a big-bang mechanic replacement to an incremental transition
title.zh: 從一次性全面替換，到漸進式轉型

proof.en: Business logic, loyalty-platform changes and in-store basket visibility made the ideal end state unsafe to launch in one step.
proof.zh: 商業邏輯、會員機制平台變更與店內購物籃可見性，使理想終態不適合一次上線。

tradeOff.en: Accepted slower convergence and temporary manual complexity to protect engagement and reduce migration risk.
tradeOff.zh: 接受較慢收斂與暫時的手動複雜度，以保護互動並降低轉移風險。

confidentialityAndStatusNote.en: This section distinguishes shipped evidence from strategic and concept work.
confidentialityAndStatusNote.zh: 本區塊會清楚區分已上線證據、策略方向與概念工作。

ownershipLine.en: Co-led with a Senior Product Designer from Payments; I owned the Voucher strategy, taxonomy, opportunity architecture, mechanism evaluation, transition roadmap, future journeys, stakeholder alignment and measurement framework.
ownershipLine.zh: 與付款資深產品設計師共同主導；我負責優惠券策略、分類架構、機會架構、機制評估、轉型路線圖、未來旅程、利害關係人對齊與衡量架構。

description.en: Customers could explicitly secure relevant value earlier in the journey.
description.zh: 顧客可在旅程前段明確取得相關價值。

description.en: Reduced repeated application work through an explicit batch action.
description.zh: 透過明確批次操作降低重複套用負擔。

description.en: Prioritised for the speed-sensitive self-checkout context; exact delivery status remains to be confirmed.
description.zh: 優先用於速度敏感的自助結帳情境；實際交付狀態仍待確認。

label.en: FUTURE · NOT DELIVERED DURING MY TENURE
label.zh: 未來方向・任職期間未交付

title.en: Sponsor self-service
title.zh: 贊助單位自助設定

summary.en: Sponsors and suppliers still relied on Operations to create Vouchers, campaigns and games. The self-serve setup-to-claims model remained a future platform requirement.
summary.zh: 贊助單位與供應商仍依賴營運團隊建立優惠券、活動與遊戲；從設定到請款的自助設定模型仍是未來平台需求。

title.en: From one-off Voucher cards to an Operations-configured component system
title.zh: 從一次性的優惠券卡片，到營運團隊可配置的元件系統

atAGlance.en: Led research, component architecture and Engineering alignment for a reusable Voucher Card system, then encoded Voucher-type mapping into Operations setup so the correct variant was applied automatically without recurring Engineering handoffs.
atAGlance.zh: 主導可重用優惠券卡片系統的研究、元件架構與工程團隊對齊，並將優惠券類型對應寫入營運設定，使正確版本自動套用，不再需要反覆工程交接。

whyItMattered.en: Voucher presentation varied by context, while each new setup could trigger repeated design and Engineering clarification.
whyItMattered.zh: 優惠券呈現會隨情境改變，而每次新設定都可能再次觸發設計與工程團隊確認。

businessImpact.en: Established a rule-mapped contract from Voucher setup to coded presentation, making consistent reuse the operational default rather than a manual implementation decision.
businessImpact.zh: 建立從優惠券設定到程式呈現的規則對應契約，使一致重用成為營運預設，而不是每次重新做出的實作決策。

researchProof: A and B concepts received 8 and 7 selections
12 preferred colour differentiation, but only 3 understood its intended meaning
14 prioritised discount value; 13 prioritised usage channel
systemProof: Shared states for Wallet, Checkout, Campaign and error review
Voucher type automatically mapped to the corresponding card variant during Operations setup

primaryNarrative.systemInsight: Bring value into the shopping journey, make eligibility explicit and reduce application effort through shared rules and states.

primaryDecisions.title: From Wallet-first exposure to contextual value discovery
From one universal mechanic to channel-specific effort reduction
From one-off card decisions to rule-mapped Operations reuse
evidence: Voucher Card research and component contract

selectedShippedEvidence.title: Contextual discovery became directly shoppable
selectedShippedEvidence.proof: ~2.6× observational Add-to-Cart trend via Voucher Details

selectedShippedEvidence.title: Eligibility and application became explicit
selectedShippedEvidence.proof: Wallet and Checkout tests with 18 customers informed shipped states and Select all

selectedShippedEvidence.title: Campaign mechanics became repeatable product behaviour

title.en: Voucher Wallet and Checkout evidence
title.zh: Voucher Wallet 與結帳證據

observedEvidence.zh: 9 位參與者中有 8 位使用分頁。
9 位參與者中有 7 位使用篩選。

observedEvidence.en: 0 of 9 participants used Search during real tasks, although 5 later rated it important.
observedEvidence.zh: 真實任務中 9 位參與者無人使用搜尋，但事後有 5 位將搜尋評為重要。

decisionUse.en: Use as evidence for task-specific Wallet discovery, filtering, eligibility and Checkout application inside the parent Voucher / Offer system narrative.
decisionUse.zh: 作為母專案中依任務設計 Voucher Wallet 探索、篩選、資格判斷與結帳套用的證據。

flashVoucherRelationship.en: Flash Voucher included saving into the main Voucher Wallet and returning earned reward vouchers there; this Wallet relationship belongs to the parent Voucher / Offer programme evidence.
flashVoucherRelationship.zh: Flash Voucher 包含儲存至主要 Voucher Wallet，並將獲得的獎勵券返回其中；此 Wallet 關係屬於優惠券／優惠母專案證據。

voucherCenterBoundary.en: These capabilities belong only to the Voucher / Offer parent case. Voucher Center uses only the Flash Voucher precursor and the separate 20-participant discovery-and-claim architecture study.
voucherCenterBoundary.zh: 這些能力只屬於 Voucher／Offer 母案。Voucher Center 僅使用 Flash Voucher 前導，以及獨立的 20 位參與者探索與領取架構研究。

outerProjectCard.title: From fragmented voucher journeys to a shared cross-channel incentive model
outerProjectCard.summary: Synthesised fragmented customer, campaign and operational evidence into a shared incentive strategy, then translated it into shipped journeys and reusable product capabilities.
outerProjectCard.summary_zh: 將分散的顧客、活動與營運證據整合為共享獎勵策略，再轉化為正式上線旅程與可重用產品能力。
outerProjectCard.proofLine: 2022–2025 · 400+ in-app Vouchers in a flagship campaign · Strategy → shipped systems
outerProjectCard.proofLine_zh: 2022–2025・旗艦活動 400+ 張 App 內優惠券・策略 → 正式上線系統
outerProjectCard.eyebrowRule: Domain only; do not combine capability, company, Type or problem keywords.

prohibitedHierarchy: Voucher Center as a child initiative
Game Center as a child initiative
Save Everyday as a standalone top-level project card
Brand Challenges as a standalone top-level project card

purpose.en: Explore how Voucher discovery and redemption could be improved at key touchpoints across customer journeys.
purpose.zh: 探索如何改善顧客旅程中關鍵接觸點的優惠券探索與兌換。

en: Establish a clearer Voucher mechanism that could support customer and business needs.
Align on common goals and a future direction for the Voucher experience.
zh: 建立能同時支援顧客與商業需求的清晰 Voucher 機制。
對齊共同目標與 Voucher 體驗的未來方向。

evidenceBoundary.en: The workshop definitions were directional hypotheses. They were not the later validated taxonomy developed from backend rules, commercial logic, operations and actual usage.
evidenceBoundary.zh: 工作坊定義屬於方向性假設，並非後續依據後台規則、商業邏輯、營運與實際使用所建立的正式分類。

claimCollectConceptStudy2023.hypothesis: A claim or collect process could increase awareness and intention to use Vouchers.
findings: 6/9 participants showed a product-focused mindset and interpreted Collect as purchase or add-to-cart intent.
3/9 participants were familiar with collecting but treated it as a low-commitment action that often did not lead to use.
No participant naturally chose the Voucher Wallet as the starting point for online shopping.
Checkout was expected to show collected and applicable Vouchers rather than introduce new discovery.
implications: Use mechanics-specific actions rather than one universal Collect action.
Support SKU-level Vouchers through product and cart-building actions.
Support cart-level Vouchers with eligibility-aware application.

voucherExperienceSurveyQ42023.sampleBoundary: Respondents had redeemed Vouchers through the FairPrice Group App in the previous 30 days; results do not represent all FairPrice customers.
voucherExperienceSurveyQ42023.interpretation: Pre-redemption finding, relevance and requirement clarity were the primary system-level opportunities.

touchpointPriorityAnalysis2023.decisionUse: Used relative touchpoint reach together with behavioural research and journey dependencies to phase discovery, qualification and application work.
touchpointPriorityAnalysis2023.attributionBoundary: Page views and clicks are reach or engagement proxies, not proof of Voucher interest, conversion or redemption uplift.

mappingCorrection.en: Voucher Wallet, Search, filtering and Checkout Select all evidence belongs only to the Voucher / Offer parent case. It must not render in Voucher Center.
mappingCorrection.zh: Voucher Wallet、搜尋、篩選與結帳全選證據只屬於優惠券／優惠母專案，不得出現在 Voucher Center。

display.en: The final three weeks generated 125.2k digital redemptions from 51.1k customers across 64.1k transactions, with digital channels accounting for 30.6% of all redemptions.
display.zh: 最後三週帶來 12.52 萬次數位兌換，涵蓋 5.11 萬名顧客與 6.41 萬筆數位交易；數位通路占全部兌換的 30.6%。

campaignObjective.note: Do not publicly claim 60% above target until the target and dashboard date scopes are confirmed as directly comparable.

approvedDisplay.en: In Online Grocery and Scan & Go, 21.7% of Save all users redeemed—2.2× the pre-launch rate of 9.8% (+11.9 percentage points).
approvedDisplay.zh: 在線上購物與 Scan & Go 中，全部儲存使用者的兌換參與率達 21.7%，是功能上線前 9.8% 的 2.2 倍（增加 11.9 個百分點）。

approvedDisplay.en: In FairPrice Pay, 12.65% of Save all users redeemed, compared with 8.13% before launch—a 56% relative increase (+4.52 percentage points).
approvedDisplay.zh: 在 FairPrice Pay 中，全部儲存使用者的兌換參與率為 12.65%，相較功能上線前的 8.13% 提高 56%（增加 4.52 個百分點）。

behaviouralInterpretation.en: Save all broadened active participation, while individual saving signalled stronger deliberate intent in Online Grocery and Scan & Go. The two behaviours should not be treated as interchangeable.
behaviouralInterpretation.zh: 全部儲存擴大了主動參與範圍，而逐張儲存在 Online Grocery 與 Scan & Go 中則代表更強的主動選擇意圖；兩種行為不應被視為相同。

causalityBoundary.en: These were early observational comparisons across adjacent periods and self-selected behaviours, not a randomised experiment. Use 'associated with' or 'early tracking showed', not 'caused'.
causalityBoundary.zh: 這是相鄰期間與自選行為的早期觀察比較，不是隨機實驗。公開文案應使用「呈現關聯」或「早期追蹤顯示」，不得寫成因果提升。

terminologyBoundary.saveAll: Campaign-page action that saves all campaign Vouchers into the Wallet.
terminologyBoundary.selectAll: Checkout action that selects applicable saved Vouchers.
terminologyBoundary.rule: Never merge Save all performance evidence into the shipped Select all feature outcome.

saveEverydayDigitalCampaign2023.name: Save Everyday Digital Campaign
saveEverydayDigitalCampaign2023.name_zh: Save Everyday 數位年度活動

recurrence.boundary: The annual store campaign existed previously; the 0→1 work refers to its digital and omnichannel edition, not the creation of the original offline campaign.

transformation.en: From a store-only coupon event to a recurring omnichannel savings campaign
transformation.zh: 從僅限實體門市的優惠券活動，到可持續運作的年度全通路省錢活動

ownership.team: Co-created the 0→1 digital edition with a cross-functional team.
ownership.user: Designed the end-to-end in-app journey connecting offline discovery, campaign browsing, saving, eligibility-aware selection and digital checkout.
ownership.leadershipVerbStatus: approved-as-co-created; do not upgrade to led without user confirmation

shippedModel.storeCoverage: All stores plus online and in-store digital journeys
journey: Online Grocery, Scan & Go and FairPrice Pay redemption

businessValue.en: Established a repeatable annual omnichannel campaign model linking offline media, in-app discovery and digital redemption across major shopping channels.
businessValue.zh: 建立可重複使用的年度全通路活動模型，把線下曝光、App 內探索與主要購物通路的數位兌換串接起來。

annualEvolution2024.name: Save Every Day 2024
annualEvolution2024.initiativeRelationship: second-year evolution of the recurring digital and omnichannel campaign

year2023.journeyLimitation: Campaign entry points mainly led to a page where customers could browse and save, with limited next actions.

behaviouralSignal.privateSource: Weekly redemptions rose from 4-6K to 20K when all 400 Vouchers were deposited directly into Wallet.
behaviouralSignal.publicApproximation: Weekly redemptions increased from roughly 5K to about 20K when Vouchers were pre-loaded into Wallet.
behaviouralSignal.interpretation: Reducing the need to browse and save each Voucher had a stronger effect than campaign-page exposure alone.
behaviouralSignal.causalBoundary: Observational campaign tracking, not a randomised experiment.

title.en: From campaign awareness to a shoppable omnichannel journey
title.zh: 從活動曝光，到可直接購物的全通路旅程

sourcePresentedAs2024Experience: More than 400 Vouchers pre-loaded into Wallet and ready to use
App users routed to the SEC campaign and Voucher-detail journey
Non-app users routed to a mobile e-catalogue rather than ending at an app-download prompt
Eligible products visible from Voucher details
Online Grocery campaign pages remained directly shoppable
Education embedded across communications and in-store POSM
proposedOrNotFullyVerified: Removing an additional offline payment screen
One shared rule-based sequence across EDM and Wallet
Full consistency of personalised ordering across channels

title.en: From manual saving to ready-to-use campaign inventory
title.zh: 從逐張儲存，到可直接使用的活動內容規模

whatIDecided.en: Use Wallet pre-loading as the default campaign-access model rather than requiring customers to browse and save hundreds of Vouchers before use.
whatIDecided.zh: 以錢包預先載入作為活動的主要存取模型，而不是要求顧客先瀏覽並逐張儲存數百張優惠券。

whyThisChoice.en: Campaign tracking showed weekly redemptions rising from roughly 5k to about 20k when the Voucher inventory was deposited directly into Wallet.
whyThisChoice.zh: 活動追蹤顯示，當優惠券內容規模直接存入錢包後，每週兌換由約 5 千次提升至約 2 萬次。

content.en: We accepted less intentional browsing and saving behaviour in exchange for substantially lower redemption friction and broader campaign participation.
content.zh: 我們接受較少的主動瀏覽與儲存行為，以換取顯著更低的兌換摩擦與更廣泛的活動參與。

title.en: From an app-download interruption to a shoppable web fallback
title.zh: 從 App 下載中斷點，到可直接購物的 Web 替代方案

whatChanged.en: Route non-app customers from in-store campaign media to a mobile e-catalogue with add-to-cart hotspots, while app customers continued into the Voucher campaign journey.
whatChanged.zh: 讓未安裝 App 的顧客從門市活動媒體進入可直接加入購物車的行動版電子型錄；已安裝 App 的顧客則繼續進入優惠券活動旅程。

whyItMattered.en: The previous flow pushed non-app customers into an app-store or exit path before they could act on the campaign.
whyItMattered.zh: 先前流程在顧客能對活動採取行動前，就將非 App 顧客推向 App 門市或離開路徑。

title.en: From a generic campaign badge to product-level savings mechanics
title.zh: 從通用活動標籤，到商品層級的省錢機制

evidence.privateSource: +36% add-to-cart rate for a badge displaying the Voucher mechanic.
evidence.publicApproximation: ~35% higher add-to-cart rate when the badge showed the Voucher mechanic.

mechanicSpecificProductSignal.direction: Show the exact saving mechanic near the product image while controlling badge size and visual clutter.

title.en: From conflicting channel logic to one promotion-aware relevance model
title.zh: 從各通路不同邏輯，到一致的促銷相關性模型

crossChannelRelevanceModel.proposal: Use a shared rule-based sequence across EDM and Wallet that prioritises promoted products with prior purchase, cart or click signals before broader recommendations.

publicApproximateSummary.matchedWeeks: Across the first four comparable post-drop weeks, total redemptions were approximately 5-20% above 2023, while digital share was about 4-7 percentage points higher.
publicApproximateSummary.week5Snapshot: By the Week 5 snapshot, the campaign had generated roughly 750K redemptions, with digital channels contributing about 39%.
publicApproximateSummary.channelNuance: The digital shift was led mainly by in-store app redemption; Online Grocery share was mixed and did not increase consistently.

publicCopyDraft.en: Across the first four comparable post-drop weeks, total redemptions were approximately 5-20% above the 2023 campaign and digital share was around 4-7 percentage points higher. By Week 5, the campaign had generated roughly 750k redemptions, with about 39% coming through digital channels.
publicCopyDraft.zh: 在前四個可比較的優惠券發放週期中，總兌換量約高於 2023 年 5–20%，數位兌換占比約提高 4–7 個百分點；至第 5 週時，活動已累積約 75 萬次兌換，其中約 39% 來自數位渠道。

claimBoundary: Interim performance only; do not present as the final 2024 campaign result.
Do not attribute the full performance change to one design feature.
Use the matched post-drop comparison as the primary public benchmark.
Keep the Online Grocery mixed result visible in deeper evidence.
Use approximate public numbers only.

principalSignal.en: Demonstrates how a 0→1 digital campaign became a recurring operating model that was refined through behavioural data, cross-channel journey design and annual performance tracking.
principalSignal.zh: 呈現一個 0→1 數位活動如何成為可重複運作的模型，並透過行為數據、跨渠道旅程與年度成效追蹤持續演進。

title.en: From generic failures to contextual recovery
title.zh: 從籠統失敗訊息，到情境式錯誤恢復

summary.en: Customers reported that apparently applicable Vouchers still failed, especially Bank Vouchers, while generic messages did not explain the cause or recovery path.
summary.zh: 顧客反映看似適用的優惠券仍無法使用，尤其是銀行優惠券；既有籠統訊息未說明原因或恢復方式。

publicLine.en: Co-led Phase 1–3 product planning and cross-functional delivery with the Product Manager, partnering with a Content Designer on contextual guidance.
publicLine.zh: 與產品經理共同主導階段 1–3 的產品規劃及跨團隊推動，並與內容設計師合作建立情境式指引。

title.en: From generic failures to contextual recovery
title.zh: 從籠統失敗訊息，到情境式錯誤恢復

whatIDecided.en: We classified Voucher failures by cause and recovery path, mapped each state to contextual guidance, and automatically removed invalid Bank Vouchers when the selected payment method created a detectable conflict.
whatIDecided.zh: 我們依錯誤原因與恢復路徑分類優惠券 failure，為各狀態建立情境式指引，並在付款方式造成可辨識衝突時，自動移除無效銀行優惠券。

whyThisChoice.en: Recurring complaints showed that customers did not understand why Vouchers labelled as applicable could still fail. The previous generic message confirmed a failure without providing an actionable next step.
whyThisChoice.zh: 反覆出現的客訴顯示，顧客不理解為何被標示為適用的優惠券仍會失敗；原有籠統訊息只確認錯誤，沒有提供可執行的下一步。

content.en: We shipped recovery for failure states that could be mapped reliably and deferred automated resolution for non-stackable conflicts. We accepted incomplete exception coverage rather than introduce an unreliable selection experience before label mapping and system dependencies were ready.
content.zh: 我們優先上線能可靠對應的錯誤恢復，並延後 Non-stackable 優惠券的自動衝突處理；接受例外覆蓋尚未完整，以避免在標籤對應與系統依賴未成熟前推出不可靠體驗。

tradeOff.chosen: Reliable recovery for mapped failure states
tradeOff.constraint: Incomplete label mapping and higher implementation cost

scope: Classify errors by cause and next action
Map contextual messages with Content Design
Explain Bank Voucher and payment-method conflict
Detect non-stackable Voucher conflicts after Select all
Let customers choose which Voucher to keep
phase3.reason: Required reliable label mapping and additional backend implementation that were not ready.

businessImpact.en: Established a reusable Voucher error taxonomy and recovery model, giving product, content and engineering a shared basis for payment eligibility and future exception states.
businessImpact.zh: 建立可重用的優惠券錯誤分類與恢復模型，讓產品團隊、內容團隊與工程團隊能以共同基礎處理付款資格與後續例外狀態。

claimBoundary: Do not claim Zendesk complaint reduction
Do not claim redemption uplift
Do not claim Checkout completion improvement

workingTitle.en: From hidden Voucher value to contextual product-level guidance
workingTitle.zh: 從隱藏的優惠券價值，到商品情境中的清楚指引

customer.en: Customers often missed applicable Vouchers while browsing products, could not compare Voucher and offer value at a glance, and had to manually check whether they had met requirements.
customer.zh: 顧客瀏覽商品時常錯過可用優惠券，無法快速比較優惠券與優惠，也必須手動確認是否已達成使用條件。

business.en: Voucher value was not visible at a high-intent product touchpoint, limiting the opportunity to translate campaign interest into add-to-cart and redemption behaviour.
business.zh: 優惠券價值未在高意圖商品接觸點清楚呈現，限制了將活動興趣轉化為加入購物車與兌換行為的機會。

participantCriteria: Ordered groceries online with the FairPrice app at least three times in the previous three months

structure.method: counterbalanced comparison of Version A and Version B

researchFindings.finding: 4 of 5 Group B participants recalled all three product-related deals, while none of Group A did.
researchFindings.implication: Group related Voucher and offer value so customers can evaluate it in one scan.

researchFindings.finding: Users reported that increased scrolling made deal comparison and purchase-quantity decisions harder.
researchFindings.implication: Keep the overview and key rules visible near the first fold.

researchFindings.finding: Customers wanted visible progress towards minimum spend or quantity requirements without manually checking the cart.
Only 4 of 10 participants remembered to apply a Voucher at cart or checkout on the first attempt; three others assumed it had already been applied.
researchFindings.implication: Do not rely on memory or terminology knowledge to complete the redemption path.

researchFindings.finding: 9 of 10 participants still added items directly from the product page, while some did not discover the eligible-items list lower in Voucher details.
researchFindings.implication: Make eligible items easier to access from the product context and within the first fold.

researchFindings.finding: Participants used Voucher, offer, promo and discount interchangeably and interpreted 'stackable' inconsistently.
researchFindings.implication: Prioritise actionable rules and recovery states over expecting precise taxonomy knowledge.

title.en: From separated promotions to one contextual deal view
title.zh: 從分散的促銷資訊，到同一個商品情境中的優惠總覽

whatIDecided.en: Group product-related Voucher and offer value near the product information, surface the most important rules early, and connect customers to eligible items and qualification progress without forcing them to reconstruct the journey from separate screens.
whatIDecided.zh: 將與商品相關的優惠券與優惠集中在商品資訊附近，提早呈現關鍵規則，並讓顧客不必跨頁自行拼湊，即可查看適用品項與達標進度。

whyThisChoice.en: The grouped concept materially improved recall, while the separated concept looked unrelated to the product and required more scrolling. Customers also showed that they shop from PDP first and do not reliably remember a later application step.
whyThisChoice.zh: 集中式概念明顯提升記憶；分離式概念則容易被視為與商品無關，且需要更多捲動。研究也顯示顧客主要從 PDP 購物，無法可靠記得之後的套用步驟。

content.en: Aligning Voucher, offer and product data so visibility, eligibility, progress and recovery states could remain consistent from PDP to cart and checkout.
content.zh: 對齊優惠券、優惠與商品資料，讓可見性、資格、進度與錯誤恢復狀態能從 PDP 一致延伸至購物車與結帳。

candidateShippedElements: Voucher overlay badges on product images
designDirection.shippingStatus: partially-confirmed-by-internal-performance-summary; exact screen-level scope needs user confirmation

sourceTermDefinition.CNY: Chinese New Year campaign, based on the wording in the internal source screenshot.
sourceTermDefinition.SEC: The annual campaign with the largest Voucher issuance volume.

performanceEvidence.internalInterpretation: The internal campaign summary associated stronger digital and Online Grocery redemption mix with PDP enhancements, including Eligible Voucher swimlanes and product-image overlay badges.

publicCopyDraft.en: Internal campaign analysis associated the PDP enhancements with a stronger digital redemption mix: approximately 84% of redemptions came through digital channels, compared with about 44% in the annual high-volume SEC campaign. The campaign had already generated roughly 75k redemptions with several weeks remaining.
publicCopyDraft.zh: 內部活動分析將 PDP 優化與更高的數位兌換占比連結：數位渠道約占 84%，相較年度最大優惠券發放活動 SEC 約 44%；在活動仍有數週的情況下，已累積約 7.5 萬次兌換。

claimBoundary: Do not claim the PDP work alone caused the campaign difference.
Do not present the comparison as an A/B experiment.
Do not publish exact internal figures.
Confirm the campaign year and measurement window before public release.
State that the internal analysis associated the shift with PDP enhancements.

principalPositioning.signal: contextual-system optimisation across product discovery, eligibility and redemption
principalPositioning.leadershipValue: Shows how research findings were translated into a cross-surface model rather than a single PDP component.
evidenceStillNeeded: which teams aligned around the model
whether the design became a reusable PDP standard

ledByMe: Confirmed the commercial problem with Business
Led Version A and Version B concepts
Led the final interaction and product direction

delegatedExecution.scope: Detailed UI specification for the final Eligible Voucher swimlane
delegatedExecution.leadershipBoundary: Shulin retained product direction, interaction intent, rollout and stakeholder alignment; detailed UI-spec execution was completed by another designer.

publicLine.en: Led the commercial problem framing, hypothesis, two design concepts, prototype, final product direction, rollout and stakeholder alignment; co-created the test structure with Research and guided a junior designer who completed the detailed UI specification for the shipped Eligible Voucher swimlane.
publicLine.zh: 主導商業問題定義、假設建立、兩個設計概念、原型、最終產品方向、推行與利害關係人對齊；與研究員共同制定測試架構，並指導初階產品設計師完成已上線適用優惠券橫向內容列的詳細 UI 規格。

confirmedShipped.label: Eligible Voucher swimlane
confirmedShipped.executionOwnership: Detailed UI specification executed by a Junior Product Designer under Shulin's product direction and review.

notYetConfirmedAsShipped: Long-term collapsed Voucher and Promotion view

title.en: From separated promotions to one first-glance deal view
title.zh: 從分散促銷資訊，到第一眼可比較的優惠總覽

learning1.researchSignal: Customers needed Voucher and Promotion value visible within the same viewport, while still recognising that the mechanics were different.
designDirection: Preserve visual distinction between Vouchers and Promotions.
Show the discount and key requirement upfront.
Short-term: surface eligible category / SKU Vouchers on PDP and keep the Promotion swimlane available for comparison.
Long-term concept: consolidate Voucher and Promotion details into a fuller view that gives eligible items more space.
learning1.shippingStatus: partially-shipped; only the Eligible Voucher swimlane is currently confirmed.

title.en: From cart-only checks to visible qualification progress
title.zh: 從只能到購物車檢查，到旅程中可見的達標進度

learning2.researchSignal: Customers wanted to know whether minimum-spend or quantity requirements had been met without manually calculating or checking the cart.
designDirection: Expose Voucher eligibility progress during product discovery.
Show Condition met, Apply and Applied states.
Carry the same state model across Wallet, PDP, Voucher details and swimlanes.
Use tailored sorting when progress states affect Voucher-card priority.
learning2.shippingStatus: concept / scope not yet confirmed by user.

title.en: From buried eligible items to action-first Voucher details
title.zh: 從被埋在長文下方的適用品項，到行動優先的優惠券詳情

learning3.researchSignal: Customers valued eligible items but often did not discover them below long Voucher descriptions.
designDirection: Collapse descriptive content to essential keywords upfront.
Highlight Voucher usage type, such as Delivery or In-store.
Move eligible items earlier in the page.
Explore a progress tracker to improve eligibility awareness.
learning3.shippingStatus: concept / scope not yet confirmed by user.

title.en: From a rule-heavy Voucher page to a shoppable qualification journey
title.zh: 從規則導向的優惠券頁面，到可直接購物的達標旅程

strategicRelationship.en: Complements the PDP Voucher work: PDP surfaced applicable Vouchers while Voucher Details surfaced and sold eligible products.
strategicRelationship.zh: 與 PDP 優惠券優化互補：PDP 呈現可用優惠券，優惠券詳情則呈現並直接購買適用商品。

collaborationBoundary.claimRule: Present Shulin as Primary Design Lead while retaining cross-functional contributors.

publicAttribution.en: Primary Design Lead for the 2024 Add-to-Cart release and the 2025 visibility optimisation, owning the complete interaction model, variant architecture and final UI specifications.
publicAttribution.zh: 擔任 2024 加入購物車與 2025 可見性優化的主要設計負責人，負責完整互動模型、版本架構與最終 UI 規格。

customer.en: Customers could understand Voucher rules but could not act immediately: eligible products were buried below instructions and adding them required multiple navigation steps.
customer.zh: 顧客能看到優惠券規則，卻無法立即行動：適用品項被埋在說明下方，加入購物車還需經過多個步驟。

business.en: A high-intent Voucher Details touchpoint reached roughly 220k unique visitors, but the journey lost customers between viewing eligible items and adding them to cart.
business.zh: 優惠券詳情是約 22 萬名獨立訪客使用的高意圖接觸點，但顧客在查看適用品項到加入購物車之間大量流失。

publicApproximate: ~12% continued to a Product Details Page

title.en: Make eligible products directly shoppable from Voucher Details
title.zh: 讓適用商品可直接從優惠券詳情購買

problem.en: Voucher Details explained redemption conditions but offered no next action for customers to fulfil them. Eligible products could not be added directly.
problem.zh: 優惠券詳情能說明兌換條件，卻沒有讓顧客完成條件的下一步；適用商品也無法直接加入購物車。

objectives: Allow customers to add eligible products from Voucher Details.
Help customers complete the actions required to become eligible.
Increase Voucher redemption from the existing approximately 62% baseline.

included: Vouchers tagged for Delivery order type
Entry from My Vouchers / Voucher Wallet

sortingLogic.publicRule: Do not describe the ranking or sorting rules until the user confirms them.

technicalIntegration: Trigger product Add-to-Cart through a deep link
Convert product data into cart-item objects
Update local cart quantity when the product already exists
timeline: 13 June: Save Every Day campaign period

title.en: Move eligible products above long instructions without removing essential guidance
title.zh: 在保留必要指引下，將適用品項移到長篇說明之前

problem.en: Eligible products remained difficult to discover because the How to use section pushed the product rail below the first view.
problem.zh: 使用方式區塊將商品列推到首屏之外，使適用品項仍不易被發現。

constraints: Minimal disruption to existing Voucher functionality
Preserve access to How to use instructions

title.en: From permanently expanded instructions to progressive disclosure
title.zh: 從固定展開的說明，到漸進式揭露

whatIDecided.en: Collapse the How to use content by default and provide Show more / less, moving eligible products higher without removing redemption guidance.
whatIDecided.zh: 預設收合使用方式並提供展開／收合，使適用品項上移，同時保留兌換指引。

whyThisChoice.en: The team needed a fast, low-disruption change that improved product visibility without rebuilding the existing Voucher information architecture.
whyThisChoice.zh: 團隊需要快速且低干擾的改善，在不重建既有優惠券資訊架構下提升商品可見性。

content.en: We accepted one extra disclosure action for customers who needed full instructions in exchange for placing shoppable eligible products earlier for the majority of browsing sessions.
content.zh: 我們接受需要完整指引的顧客多一次展開操作，以換取多數瀏覽情境能更早看到可購買的適用品項。

successMetrics: Product impressions per Weekly Active User on Voucher Details
Voucher redemption rate as a secondary measure

performanceEvidence.metricDefinition: Dashboard-defined Add-to-Cart rate via Voucher Details

publicCopyDraft.en: Across the dashboard comparison window, Add-to-Cart via Voucher Details rose from roughly 1.5% on May 12 to about 4% in the latest reading - approximately 2.6x higher.
publicCopyDraft.zh: 在儀表板比較期間，優惠券詳情的加入購物車率從 5 月 12 日約 1.5% 上升至最新約 4%，約為原本的 2.6 倍。

claimBoundary: Do not call this an A/B-test result.
Do not describe May 12 as the release date until confirmed.
Do not claim the 2025 layout change alone caused the increase.
Use approximate values in public content.
Do not publish the raw dashboard screenshot because it exposes internal tooling and employee identity.

businessImpact.en: Converted Voucher Details from a passive rules page into a reusable commerce touchpoint, connecting eligibility understanding with product discovery and cart action across successive releases.
businessImpact.zh: 將優惠券詳情從被動規則頁轉化為可重用的 Commerce 接觸點，透過連續版本串接資格理解、商品探索與購物車行動。

title.en: From one generic Voucher page to a condition-driven experience system
title.zh: 從單一通用優惠券頁面，到依條件驅動的體驗系統

systemPurpose.en: Map each Voucher's qualifying logic and shopping channel to the correct product treatment, action and usage guidance instead of forcing every Voucher into one page pattern.
systemPurpose.zh: 依每張優惠券的達標邏輯與購物通路，對應正確的商品呈現、操作與使用指引，而不是強迫所有優惠券使用同一頁面模式。

conditionTypes.productTreatment: Show the single eligible item prominently
conditionTypes.inStoreAction: Add to List or find the item in store
conditionTypes.feedback: Confirm cart quantity and remind customers to apply the Voucher at checkout

conditionTypes.qualifyingLogic: One or more products from a defined eligible set
conditionTypes.productTreatment: Eligible-product rail plus a full Search / Filter / Sort list
conditionTypes.deliveryAction: Add one or multiple products to Cart
conditionTypes.inStoreAction: Add products to List or browse eligible in-store items
conditionTypes.feedback: Reflect selected quantities and progress towards the condition

conditionTypes.qualifyingLogic: Applies to all or a broad range of items
conditionTypes.productTreatment: Do not show a misleading narrow eligible-product rail
conditionTypes.deliveryAction: Shop now or Shop delivery items
conditionTypes.feedback: Prioritise spend threshold and usage context

conditionTypes.qualifyingLogic: Eligibility depends on a non-product condition such as a bank card
conditionTypes.productTreatment: Prioritise the external condition instead of product eligibility
conditionTypes.deliveryAction: Shop now with the required payment condition visible
conditionTypes.inStoreAction: Direct customers to the relevant Pay via app or Scan & Go usage flow
conditionTypes.feedback: Explain the required payment or membership condition before checkout

sharedSystemRules: Exclude pre-order products from the 2024 MVP
Use feature flags for controlled rollout
Support Search, Filter and Sort in the full eligible-item list
Keep redemption limit and stackability visible
Use channel-specific success and application guidance
Do not imply Auto Apply when customers must still apply at checkout

confirmedShipped: Single and multiple eligible-product cart actions
needsConfirmation: Which in-store, omni, generic-item and special-criteria variants reached production
Which Phase 2 variants remained specification or concept

title.en: From one generic Voucher page to condition- and channel-specific actions
title.zh: 從單一通用優惠券頁面，到依條件與通路對應操作

whatIDecided.en: Defined four Voucher condition types and mapped each to the appropriate eligible-item treatment, CTA, feedback and channel-specific usage guidance.
whatIDecided.zh: 定義四種優惠券條件類型，並將各類型對應至適用品項呈現、CTA、回饋與依通路 usage 引導。

whyThisChoice.en: Product-linked Vouchers need direct fulfilment actions, while broad-basket and bank-card Vouchers need threshold or payment guidance. A single generic layout would either show irrelevant products or hide the condition that determines eligibility.
whyThisChoice.zh: 商品型優惠券需要直接完成條件的操作；廣泛品項與銀行卡優惠券則需要門檻或付款指引。單一通用版型不是顯示無關商品，就是隱藏真正決定資格判斷的條件。

question.en: Was May 12 the rollout date, the first full day after rollout, or only the analytics comparison start?
question.zh: 5 月 12 日是正式推行 date、上線後第一個完整觀測日，還是數據分析選定的比較起點？

openQuestions.reason: This determines whether the public case can say after launch or must only say across the dashboard comparison window.

question.en: What was the final eligible-item sorting priority?
question.zh: 適用 items 最後採用的排序優先順序是什麼？

openQuestions.reason: The deliverable is confirmed, but the rule itself must not be invented.

question.en: Which in-store, omni, generic-item and special-criteria variants shipped, and which remained Phase 2 specification?
question.zh: 門市、Omni、通用-item 與 Special-criteria 版本中，哪些正式上線，哪些停留在階段 2 規格？

openQuestions.reason: The Master Screens document includes both production-oriented specifications and Phase 2 explorations.

principalThesis.en: Defined a multi-year cross-channel incentive direction, converted fragmented customer and operational evidence into a shared operating model, and guided multiple shipped initiatives.
principalThesis.zh: 定義多年期跨通路 incentive 方向，將分散的顧客與營運證據轉化為共享運作模型，並引導多項正式上線成果。

principalEvidenceStillNeeded: Which senior leaders or executive forums used the model
Which decisions, roadmap priorities or investments changed because of the work
How many teams, channels or product surfaces adopted the shared rules
What governance or ownership mechanism kept the model active
Whether the user mentored designers or raised critique / quality standards
Any operational time, dependency or rework reduction
deepCaseNarrativeOrder: Why the existing organisation could not scale the old model
principalPositioning.publicationRule: Lead with organisational and system change. Use workshops, research and artefacts only as evidence for decisions.

principalValue.en: Shows organisation-level direction setting with explicit domain leadership: co-leading across Voucher and Payment, defining the Voucher operating model, adapting one strategic principle by channel, and carrying parts of the direction into Voucher Center.
principalValue.zh: 呈現具明確 Domain leadership 的組織層級方向設定：跨優惠券與付款共同主導、定義優惠券營運模式、依通路調整同一策略原則，並將部分方向延伸至 Voucher Center。

confirmedEvidence: Co-led with a Senior Product Designer from Payments
Owned all Voucher-side Future Vision artefacts and alignment
Payment was prioritised for Auto Apply testing
Parts of the direction were applied in Voucher Center
remainingEvidenceNeeded: Reason Online Grocery did not use Auto Apply
Exact Payment Auto Apply test and delivery status
Exact Future Vision capabilities adopted by Voucher Center
Senior leadership review and roadmap impact

principalValue.en: Shows both product stewardship and system architecture: leading the initial commerce MVP, defining reusable behaviour across heterogeneous Voucher rules, returning to improve hierarchy a year later, and tracking the touchpoint over time.
principalValue.zh: 同時呈現產品團隊 stewardship 與系統架構：主導最初 Commerce MVP、為異質優惠券規則定義可重用行為、隔年回頭改善資訊層級，並持續追蹤同一接觸點。

confirmedEvidence: Primary Design Lead for the 2024 release
Owner of final detailed UI specifications
Defined the condition-type and channel variant system
Observed ATC trend from roughly 1.5% to roughly 4%
remainingEvidenceNeeded: Relationship between May 12 and the 2025 rollout
Shipping status of broader Phase 2 condition and in-store variants

principalValue.en: Moves the portfolio evidence beyond component craftsmanship: the key result is a durable organisational contract connecting research, design rules, Engineering implementation and Operations configuration.
principalValue.zh: 將作品集證據從元件 craftsmanship 提升到長期組織 Contract：串接研究、設計規則、工程團隊實作與營運團隊配置。

confirmedEvidence: Shulin is named as the Voucher Card designer in the component specification.
A 15-participant study informed information hierarchy and visual treatment.
The component covers multiple layouts, claimability models, states and contexts.
Accessibility, responsive text and touch-target rules were documented.
Engineering implemented the corresponding internal component.
Operations selected a Voucher type and the setup system automatically mapped it to the corresponding component variant.
remainingEvidenceNeeded: Exact Engineering implementation coverage by platform
Name and launch date of the internal Voucher setup system
Any measurable reduction in tickets, handoffs, setup time or rework
Whether the component was promoted into the company-wide Design System or remained Voucher-domain specific

claim.en: Guided a junior Product Designer who completed the detailed UI specification for the shipped Eligible Voucher swimlane while I retained product direction, interaction intent, rollout and stakeholder alignment.
claim.zh: 指導 Junior Product Designer 完成已上線 Eligible Voucher swimlane 的詳細 UI 規格，同時由我持續負責產品方向、互動意圖、上線規劃與利害關係人對齊。

claim.en: Led the 2024 and 2025 Voucher Details releases, owning the interaction model, condition and channel variants, final specifications, design iteration, critique and handoff.
claim.zh: 主導 2024 與 2025 年 Voucher Details 上線，負責互動模型、條件與通路變體、最終規格、設計迭代、設計評議與交付。

claim.en: Connected Voucher-type rules to the Operations setup flow so the system mapped the correct shared card variant by default, reducing reliance on recurring ad hoc Design and Engineering decisions.
claim.zh: 將 Voucher 類型規則寫入營運設定流程，使系統預設對應正確的共享卡片變體，降低反覆依賴臨時的設計與工程判斷。

confirmedPublicEvidence.boundary: Qualitative dependency reduction only; no quantified time, ticket or rework reduction has been provided.

claim.en: Co-led the omni-incentive future direction with a Senior Product Designer from Payments and owned the Voucher strategy, taxonomy, opportunity architecture, mechanism evaluation, transition roadmap, future journeys, stakeholder alignment and measurement framework.
claim.zh: 與 Payment Senior Product Designer 共同主導全通路獎勵未來方向，並負責 Voucher 策略、分類、機會架構、機制評估、轉型路線圖、未來旅程、利害關係人對齊與衡量架構。

claim.en: Co-planned and co-facilitated the cross-functional Voucher workshop and personally created the four journey task flows and shared system structure used as the alignment foundation.
claim.zh: 共同規劃並主持跨職能 Voucher 工作坊，並親自建立四條旅程任務流程與共享系統結構，作為團隊對齊基礎。

doNotClaimYet: Exact number of teams or production surfaces adopting every shared rule
A specific roadmap or investment decision changed because of the model
Formal organisation-wide critique or quality-bar ownership
Quantified reduction in setup time, Engineering tickets, handoffs or rework
Company-wide Design System adoption across every platform

sourceFiles: Pricing offers & payment future state design2.pdf
Pricing offers & payment future state design.pdf

ownership.partnerOwnership: The Senior Product Designer from Payments owned the Payment stream.
ownership.claimBoundary: Do not imply that Shulin authored the Payment-specific designs independently.

title.en: The organisation had multiple promotion mechanics but no shared incentive operating model
title.zh: 組織擁有多種促銷機制，卻缺少共享的獎勵運作模型

customerProblem.en: Customers encountered inconsistent terminology, discovery paths, eligibility rules and redemption behaviour across Online Grocery, in-store payment, Scan & Go, food services and external programmes.
customerProblem.zh: 顧客在 Online Grocery、店內付款、Scan & Go、餐飲服務與外部方案中，面對不一致的名詞、探索路徑、資格規則與兌換行為。

businessProblem.en: Business units and sponsors lacked a scalable way to target, run, measure and improve incentives without repeated manual coordination.
businessProblem.zh: 商務團隊 units 與贊助單位缺乏可擴展的方法來設定、執行、衡量與優化獎勵，仍依賴重複的人工協調。

platformProblem.en: The same customer value could appear as an Offer, Voucher, Promotion, Promo Code, stored-value instrument or external benefit, even though the required action and accounting treatment differed.
platformProblem.zh: 相同的顧客價值可能被稱為優惠、優惠券、促銷、促銷代碼、Stored-value instrument 或外部權益，但其操作與財務處理方式並不相同。

customerGoal.en: Cultivate a habit of discovering and using relevant incentives across channels, with clear value and less checkout effort.
customerGoal.zh: 培養顧客在跨通路情境中探索並使用相關獎勵的習慣，同時提供清楚價值並降低結帳負擔。

businessGoal.en: Create a high-engagement, measurable incentive platform that supports retention, growth and sponsor outcomes with flexible targeting.
businessGoal.zh: 建立高互動、可衡量的獎勵平台，以彈性分眾設定支援留存、成長與贊助單位目標。

behaviourClaimBoundary.prohibitedClaim: Do not state as fact that behaviour remains after the incentive is removed.
behaviourClaimBoundary.approvedFraming: The platform was intended to shape repeat discovery and redemption behaviour.

title.en: One platform had to create value for customers, sponsors and product operations
title.zh: 同一個平台必須同時為顧客、贊助單位與產品營運創造價值

goal.en: Find relevant value, understand the final benefit and redeem it with confidence.
goal.zh: 找到相關價值、理解最終利益，並有把握地完成兌換。

goal.en: Run targeted incentives with measurable ROI and lower operational overhead.
goal.zh: 以較低營運負擔執行可衡量 ROI 的分眾 incentives。

goal.en: Provide shared definitions, rules, data and states across channels.
goal.zh: 提供跨通路共享的定義、規則、資料與狀態。

operatingReality.en: Sponsors and suppliers still needed to work with the Operations team to configure Vouchers, campaigns and games.
operatingReality.zh: 贊助單位與供應商在建立優惠券、活動或遊戲時，仍需要與營運團隊 team 合作。

publicClaim.en: Not delivered during my tenure: sponsor self-service remained a future capability, while Operations continued to support setup and execution.
publicClaim.zh: 我任職期間尚未交付：贊助單位自助設定仍屬未來能力，設定與執行持續由營運團隊支援。

claimBoundary: Do not imply that sponsor self-service entered delivery.
Do not claim operational-efficiency improvement from this capability.
Do not imply sponsors could independently configure campaigns.

title.en: Separate price, incentive and stored value by customer action and system treatment
title.zh: 依顧客操作與系統處理方式，區分價格、獎勵與儲值工具

publicSimplifiedModel.application: Automatically reflected in product or basket price

publicSimplifiedModel.customerAction: May require Save, Collect, Claim or participation

publicSimplifiedModel.application: Offsets payment rather than acting as a promotion
examples: Physical Gift Card stored in app

principles.statement: Relevant value appears at the right point in the journey.
Ranking and targeting reflect customer behaviour and context.
Customers understand criteria and do not repeat avoidable application work.
Final savings and benefit are visible before and after redemption.
Rewards reinforce achievement, repeat behaviour and emotional value.

mechanismsCompared.label: Awarded and manually applied
mechanismsCompared.strength: Lowest migration risk and no required collection behaviour.
mechanismsCompared.weakness: Retains manual redemption friction, low early intent capture and existing cross-channel confusion.

mechanismsCompared.label: Collect and auto-apply
mechanismsCompared.strength: Captures intent earlier, reduces checkout effort and supports stronger measurement and sponsor value.
mechanismsCompared.weakness: Requires discovery education, system changes and high migration effort.

mechanismsCompared.label: Points-based rewards
mechanismsCompared.strength: Clear reward currency and scalable across challenges and campaigns.
mechanismsCompared.weakness: High mental-model and loyalty-platform change, while explicit offer intent is weaker.

mechanismsCompared.label: Personalised pricing
mechanismsCompared.strength: Low customer effort and immediate value.
mechanismsCompared.weakness: Lower behaviour measurement, limited cross-channel scalability and potential transparency or trust risk.

mechanismsCompared.label: Hybrid
mechanismsCompared.strength: Preserves some current constructs while adding personalised pricing.
mechanismsCompared.weakness: Keeps multiple mental models and much of the existing operational complexity.

title.en: Collect relevant value earlier, then reduce application effort by channel
title.zh: 更早收集相關價值，再依通路降低套用負擔

strategicDirection.en: Use explicit intent earlier in the journey, then minimise redemption effort without forcing one identical mechanic across every channel.
strategicDirection.zh: 在旅程前段取得明確意圖，再降低兌換負擔，而不是強迫所有通路使用完全相同的機制。

interpretation.en: Online Grocery reduced repeated application effort through an explicit Select all action rather than silent auto-application.
interpretation.zh: Online Grocery 以明確的全選取代 Silent 自動套用，降低重複套用負擔。

onlineGrocery.requiredFollowUp: Ask why Online Grocery did not adopt Auto Apply.

reason.en: Payment was the primary environment for testing Auto Apply because self-checkout customers needed to complete payment quickly and additional Voucher steps could disrupt the SCO flow.
reason.zh: 付款是自動套用的首要測試場域，因為 SCO 自助結帳需要快速完成；額外優惠券操作可能干擾結帳流程。

claimBoundary: Do not say Auto Apply shipped across all channels.
Do not describe Select all as technically identical to Auto Apply.
Do not state why Online Grocery rejected Auto Apply until the user supplies the reason.
Do not claim the Payment test shipped without confirmation.

title.en: From a big-bang mechanic replacement to an incremental transition
title.zh: 從一次性全面替換，到漸進式轉型

whatIDecided.en: Sequence the transition: improve contextual discovery, terminology and eligibility first; implement Collect; reduce application effort through channel-appropriate mechanics; and continue towards broader automation as business, loyalty and payment foundations matured.
whatIDecided.zh: 依序推進轉型：先改善情境式探索、用語與資格判斷；實作收集；以符合通路的機制降低套用負擔；並隨商務團隊、會員機制與付款基礎成熟，持續朝更廣泛 Automation 推進。

whyThisChoice.en: The existing business logic could not change immediately, the in-store payment flow did not know the basket before QR scanning, loyalty-platform changes were pending and a full mechanic replacement carried substantial education and operational risk.
whyThisChoice.zh: 既有商業邏輯無法立即改動；店內付款在掃描 QR 前無法取得購物籃；會員機制平台仍待變更；全面替換機制也帶來顯著教育與營運風險。

content.en: We accepted slower convergence and temporary coexistence with manual complexity instead of forcing a full mechanic migration, protecting existing engagement and reducing platform, staff and payment-transition risk.
content.zh: 我們接受較慢收斂與暫時保留部分手動複雜度，而不強制一次完成機制 migration，以保護既有互動並降低平台、門市人員與付款 transition risk。

adoptionEvidence.roadmapAlignment: Parts of the functions and flows were aligned, not the complete roadmap.
adoptionEvidence.downstreamApplication: Parts of the direction were applied in the later Voucher Center project.

capabilities: Shared terminology and taxonomy
Contextual Voucher indicators and entry points
Simplified cards, criteria and missing-condition guidance
Shared eligibility, application and state definitions
Collect or Save where the mechanic benefits from explicit intent
Personalised sorting and relevant prompts
Shop and Explore from Voucher details
Best-value recommendation and total-savings visibility
Auto-apply eligible saved value
Consistent online and in-store application states
Progress and expiring-value reminders
Post-purchase reward and next-purchase loops
Sponsor self-serve setup, run, monitor and claims
Unified ROI and behaviour measurement
Flexible targeting by business unit and sponsor goal
Controlled monetisation and placement experiments

journeyMeasurementFramework.purpose: Connect customer outcomes, platform capabilities and business measurement across the full incentive journey.

stages.customerOutcome: Relevant value is visible before shopping.
Customers can secure useful value without missing conditions.
Eligible value is applied with fewer errors and less effort.
Customers understand achieved savings and have a reason to return.

journeyMeasurementFramework.measurementBoundary: These are proposed measures and expected business impacts, not achieved metrics.

opportunityArchitecture.publicUse: Redraw only as a simplified journey-to-capability-to-measurement framework. Do not publish the full raw canvas.

habitFormationModel.sourceFile: Pricing offers & payment future state design2.pdf
habitFormationModel.publicUse: Supporting evidence only; do not frame gamification as the core platform strategy.

experimentalConceptLibrary.publicationRule: Do not list the entire concept catalogue in the public case. Use only concepts that later became shipped evidence or that directly explain a strategic decision.

deterministicVariableRewardExploration.mechanic: Predetermined rule or sequence based on scan order or customer attributes, while the customer-facing experience could feel variable.
riskConsiderations: Avoid implying a random or lucky-draw mechanism if rewards are predetermined.
Maintain appropriate audit trails or logs.
Review legal, operational and campaign-governance requirements.
deterministicVariableRewardExploration.publicUse: Do not render in the main Future Vision section. Retain as evidence of rule, communication and governance awareness.

constraints.constraint: The in-store payment system did not know the customer basket before the customer scanned the payment QR.
constraints.designImpact: Eligibility, personalised pricing, total savings and auto-application could not be communicated reliably before that point.

constraints.constraint: Loyalty-platform changes could alter the customer and reward construct.
constraints.designImpact: The programme avoided a big-bang experience replacement before the platform direction was stable.

constraints.constraint: Funding, SAP posting, supplier claims and different financial treatments required alignment.
constraints.designImpact: Customer-facing simplification depended on backend and commercial-rule standardisation.

constraints.constraint: The product team could not sustain a steady incentive supply through manual setup and coordination.
constraints.designImpact: Long-term scale required sponsor self-service from setup through monitoring and claims.

constraints.constraint: Collect and Auto Apply would change customer expectations, staff procedures and education.
constraints.designImpact: The transition needed sequencing, migration support and engagement protection.

visionToDeliveryContinuity.purpose: Show which parts of the direction were later represented by shipped or independent work without implying that the complete vision became one funded roadmap.

confirmedDownstreamAdoption.relationship: Parts of the Future Vision functions and flows were applied in the later product.

visionToDeliveryContinuity.causalBoundary: Only Voucher Center is currently confirmed as a downstream application of parts of the vision. Other initiatives may be strategically consistent but must not be described as direct adoption without confirmation.

questionsCovered: Current business role of Vouchers and Offers
stakeholderDiscoveryPlan.publicUse: Use only after the user confirms which interviews were completed and what changed because of them.

summary.en: Co-developed with a Senior Product Designer from Payments because Voucher and Payment mechanics were tightly interdependent.
summary.zh: 由我與付款產品的資深產品設計師共同完成，因為優惠券與付款機制高度相依。

sharedScope: Alignment on dependencies between Voucher, checkout and payment

publicAttribution.en: Co-led an omni-incentive future vision with a Senior Product Designer from Payments, owning the Voucher strategy, taxonomy, opportunity architecture, mechanism evaluation, transition roadmap, future journeys, stakeholder alignment and measurement framework.
publicAttribution.zh: 與付款資深產品設計師共同主導全通路獎勵未來願景；我負責優惠券策略、分類架構、機會架構、機制評估、轉型路線圖、未來旅程、利害關係人對齊與衡量架構。

title.en: From one universal mechanic to channel-specific reduction of redemption effort
title.zh: 從單一通用機制，到依通路降低兌換負擔

whatIDecided.en: Preserve the same strategic principle—capture intent early and reduce application effort—while adapting the execution to each shopping context: Select all for Online Grocery and Auto Apply as the primary test direction for Payment.
whatIDecided.zh: 保留同一個策略原則：提早取得意圖、降低套用負擔；但依購物情境調整執行方式，Online Grocery 使用全選，付款則以自動套用作為首要測試方向。

whyThisChoice.en: Payment takes place in a time-sensitive self-checkout environment where every additional step can interrupt transaction flow. Online Grocery implemented the effort-reduction principle through Select all; its reason for not adopting Auto Apply still requires confirmation.
whyThisChoice.zh: 付款發生在時間敏感的自助結帳環境，任何額外操作都可能中斷交易。Online Grocery 則以全選實現降低負擔的原則；未採自動套用的原因仍待補充。

channelAdaptationDecision.principalSignal: Shows that the designer maintained a shared strategic principle while avoiding a one-size-fits-all interaction model across channels.

question.en: Why did Online Grocery use Select all instead of Auto Apply?
question.zh: 為什麼 Online Grocery 最後使用全選，而不是自動套用？

question.en: Was Payment Auto Apply only tested, committed for delivery, or shipped?
question.zh: 付款自動套用是僅測試、已進入交付，還是正式上線？

question.en: Which exact Future Vision functions and flows were later applied in Voucher Center?
question.zh: 未來願景中哪些具體功能與流程後來被 Voucher Center 採用？

question.en: Which proposed customer-facing terms were actually adopted in production—for example My Vouchers, Voucher Code, FairPrice Group E-Gift Vouchers, Voucher and Promotions?
question.zh: 哪些提議的顧客端名稱真正被產品採用，例如 My 優惠券、優惠券代碼、FairPrice Group E-Gift 優惠券、優惠券與促銷？

problem.en: Stable incentive supply still depended on manual coordination between sponsors, suppliers, Product and Operations.
problem.zh: 穩定的獎勵供給仍依賴贊助單位、供應商、產品團隊與營運團隊之間的人工協調。
