principalSignal.en: Shows that the vision identified an organisational scaling constraint beyond customer-facing UX, while preserving an honest boundary that the operating-model change had not yet been delivered.
principalSignal.zh: 證明願景能辨識顧客端 UX 之外的組織擴展限制，同時誠實區分此營運-模型 change 尚未交付。

crossChannelTerminology2023.purpose: Align customer-facing pricing and reward terminology across app, web, payment, receipt and offline touchpoints.

period.operationsIntegration: implemented later; exact date needs confirmation

title.en: From an existing Voucher Card to a reusable state-aware component model
title.zh: 從既有 Voucher Card，到可重用的狀態化元件模型

positioning.en: A reusable system foundation within Voucher / Offer Vision, not a separate project.
positioning.zh: 優惠券／優惠願景內的可重用系統基礎，不是獨立專案。

personallyOwned: Evolved the existing Voucher Card into a reusable state-aware pattern
Planned and designed the Voucher Card usability study
Defined information hierarchy and card behaviour
Designed horizontal and vertical component variants
Defined Voucher-type, state, label, expiry, tracker and CTA properties
Documented responsive writing and truncation rules
Specified accessibility, focus and touch-target requirements
Aligned the design contract with Engineering
Connected the component model to the later Voucher setup system used by Operations

collaborationBoundary.engineering: Engineering team implemented the corresponding internal component; exact platform coverage needs confirmation.
collaborationBoundary.operations: Operations later used the Voucher setup flow to apply the appropriate Voucher Card without a recurring ad hoc Engineering request.
collaborationBoundary.publicClaimRule: Credit Shulin with system ownership and cross-functional alignment; do not imply she wrote production code.

publicAttribution.en: Led the research and state-aware evolution of an existing Voucher Card, aligned the updated interaction contract with Engineering and Operations, and pushed for its abstraction into a reusable Tangram component.
publicAttribution.zh: 主導既有 Voucher Card 的研究與狀態化演進，與工程及營運對齊更新後的互動契約，並推動其抽象為可重用的 Tangram 元件。

customerExperience.en: Voucher information competed for limited space and changed across discovery, claiming, checkout and error states, making it difficult to balance glanceability with sufficient detail.
customerExperience.zh: 優惠券資訊需要在有限空間中支援探索、領取、結帳與錯誤等不同狀態，既有做法難以同時兼顧快速理解與足夠細節。

deliveryModel.en: Without a shared component contract, new Voucher use cases risked repeated design work, inconsistent implementation and recurring clarification between Design, Engineering and Operations.
deliveryModel.zh: 缺少共同元件契約時，新優惠券使用情境容易造成重複設計、不一致實作，以及設計、工程團隊、營運團隊之間反覆確認。

keyFindings.finding: Participants valued both glanceability and complete information.
keyFindings.evidence: A received 8 selections and B received 7; the no-image C received 0, while the existing D received 2.
keyFindings.claimBoundary: Treat these as selections, not mutually exclusive percentages.

keyFindings.finding: Colour was attractive but not self-explanatory.
keyFindings.evidence: 12 participants preferred differentiated colours, but only 3 recognised the intended Free Shipping and Purchase-with-Purchase meanings.

keyFindings.finding: The most important information was utility-first.
evidence: Where the Voucher can be used: 13
Product image or icon: 12 after qualitative adjustment

keyFindings.finding: Voucher quantity could be misread as public stock.
keyFindings.evidence: 2 participants interpreted x8 / 8 left as the number remaining for all customers rather than their personal quantity.

keyFindings.finding: Contextual relevance mattered more than broad exposure.
keyFindings.evidence: Participants found PDP Voucher cards useful when already interested in the item, while the Omni landing page required better personalisation.
Participants described the Applicable section and eligible items as making usable Vouchers easier to identify.
Click heatmaps showed participants selected Apply vouchers rather than using Back after choosing Vouchers.

title.en: From choosing between density and detail to responsive component variants
title.zh: 從在資訊密度與完整細節間二選一，到響應式元件版本

whatIDecided.en: Created horizontal and vertical variants with context-specific information density, responsive truncation and a clear route to Voucher Details.
whatIDecided.zh: 建立橫向與直向兩種版本，依情境調整資訊密度與響應式截斷規則，並保留清楚進入優惠券詳情的路徑。

whyThisChoice.en: Research split between compact image-led cards and wider full-detail cards: customers wanted to scan more Vouchers without losing the information needed to judge relevance.
whyThisChoice.zh: 研究結果分別支持精簡圖像卡與較完整的寬版卡；顧客希望一次瀏覽更多優惠券，同時不能失去判斷是否適用所需的資訊。

content.en: Dense discovery contexts use controlled truncation and fewer visible fields, accepting that some detail moves behind the card interaction in exchange for showing more relevant Vouchers at once.
content.zh: 高密度探索情境採用受控截斷與較少的前台欄位，接受部分細節需進一步點入，以換取同時呈現更多相關優惠券。

title.en: From colour-coded meaning to colour supported by explicit information
title.zh: 從依賴顏色表意，到以明確資訊輔助顏色

whatIDecided.en: Retained visual differentiation while ensuring Voucher type, usage channel, condition and state were communicated through text, labels and component behaviour rather than colour alone.
whatIDecided.zh: 保留視覺差異，但以文字、標籤與元件行為呈現優惠券類型、使用通路、條件與狀態，不讓顏色成為唯一訊號。

whyThisChoice.en: Most participants preferred colour variation, yet few understood what the colours represented and several inferred unrelated meanings such as channel or stackability.
whyThisChoice.zh: 多數參與者偏好多色區分，但只有少數能理解顏色含義，也有人誤認為代表通路或疊加規則。

title.en: From page-specific card designs to a configurable component contract
title.zh: 從各頁面獨立設計卡片，到可配置元件契約

whatIDecided.en: Defined the Voucher Card through reusable properties and states instead of separate page-specific cards: layout, claimability, Voucher type, image, CTA, redemption tracker, expiry, labels and interaction state.
whatIDecided.zh: 不再為各頁面分別製作卡片，而是以可重用屬性與狀態定義優惠券卡片，包括版面、是否可領取、優惠券類型、圖片、操作按鈕、兌換進度、到期資訊、標籤與互動狀態。

whyThisChoice.en: The same Voucher entity had to work across Wallet, Checkout, Campaign, Payment review, Voucher Details and discovery surfaces without fragmenting into unrelated implementations.
whyThisChoice.zh: 同一優惠券項目必須跨錢包、結帳、活動、付款審查、優惠券詳情與探索入口運作，不能持續分裂為互不相干的實作。

title.en: From recurring Engineering clarification to rule-mapped Operations reuse
title.zh: 從反覆向工程團隊確認，到規則對應的營運團隊重用

whatIDecided.en: Connected the shared Voucher Card model to the Voucher setup system so selecting a Voucher type automatically mapped the setup to the corresponding component variant.
whatIDecided.zh: 將共用優惠券卡片模型銜接至優惠券設定系統，使營運團隊選擇優惠券類型後，系統自動對應至相應元件版本。

whyThisChoice.en: A reusable library alone would still leave Operations dependent on Design or Engineering judgment. Encoding the mapping into setup turned the component rules into an operational default.
whyThisChoice.zh: 只有可重用元件庫仍會讓營運團隊依賴設計或工程團隊的判斷；將對應規則寫入設定，才能把元件規則轉成營運預設。

defaultCard: Subtitle limited to two lines with ellipsis
smallCard: Subtitle limited to one line with ellipsis
contentRules.labels: Collapse overflow labels into a numeric +1 pattern.

accessibility: Minimum 44x44 touch target for card and primary action
Dynamic type behaviour documented for 125% and above
State and meaning not communicated by colour alone
Responsive component height for larger text

description.en: Design and Engineering aligned on a shared internal Voucher Card component rather than reproducing cards independently for each feature.
description.zh: 設計與工程團隊對齊同一套內部優惠券卡片元件，不再為每個功能各自重製卡片。

designToCode.codeOwnershipBoundary: Engineering owned production implementation; Shulin owned the component definition, behaviour and specifications.

description.en: When Operations selected a Voucher type during setup, the system automatically mapped it to the corresponding Voucher Card variant.
description.zh: 營運團隊在設定時選擇優惠券類型後，系統會自動對應到相應的優惠券卡片版本。

claimBoundary: Do not claim that every card property was automatically derived unless separately confirmed.
Do not publish a complete mapping table until the supported Voucher types and rules are confirmed.

systemChain: Setup rules map the type to a Voucher Card variant
Customers receive consistent presentation across supported journeys

businessImpact.en: Reduced dependency on one-off Design and Engineering decisions by encoding Voucher-type-to-card mapping into the Operations setup flow, enabling consistent component reuse by default.
businessImpact.zh: 將優惠券類型與卡片版本的對應規則寫入營運設定流程，降低一次性設計與工程團隊決策依賴，讓一致的元件重用成為預設行為。
businessImpact.metricStatus: No quantified operational-efficiency metric has been provided.

principalSignal.en: Demonstrates organisation-level system ownership: turning customer research into a reusable interaction model, translating it into a Design-to-Code contract, and extending that contract into the Operations workflow that creates the underlying incentives.
principalSignal.zh: 呈現組織層級的系統 ownership：將顧客研究轉為可重用互動模型，再轉譯成設計到程式碼契約，最後延伸到真正建立獎勵的營運流程。

question.en: Was the coded component implemented across iOS, Android and Web, or only a subset?
question.zh: 工程團隊元件最後是 iOS、Android、Web 都有實作，還是只涵蓋其中部分平台？

question.en: What was the internal Voucher setup system called, and when did this integration become available?
question.zh: 內部優惠券設定系統的正式名稱是什麼？這個整合何時可用？

question.en: Which Voucher types mapped to which card variants?
question.zh: 哪些優惠券類型會分別對應到哪些卡片版本？

openQuestions.reason: Automatic mapping is confirmed, but the full rule table must not be inferred.

question.en: Was this registered in the company-wide Design System or maintained as a Voucher-domain component library?
question.zh: 這套元件最後有進入公司級設計系統，還是維持在優惠券 domain 的元件 library？

question.en: Was any reduction in setup time, Engineering tickets, handoffs or rework tracked?
question.zh: 是否有追蹤設定 time、工程團隊 tickets、交接或重工的下降？

history.en: The original white Voucher Card already existed in the Design System. Voucher Center evolved that component with stronger differentiation and explicit Claim → View states; I then pushed for the updated model to be abstracted into a reusable Tangram component.
history.zh: 原始白色 Voucher Card 早已存在於 Design System。Voucher Center 在既有元件上強化視覺區分與明確的 Claim → View 狀態；之後我進一步推動更新後的模型抽象為可重用的 Tangram 元件。

atAGlance.en: Evolved an existing Voucher Card into state-aware variants for Voucher Center, then aligned the updated model with Engineering and Operations so it could be reused through shared component rules.
atAGlance.zh: 將既有 Voucher Card 演進為支援 Voucher Center 狀態的多版本模型，再與工程與營運對齊，使其能透過共享元件規則重用。

forbiddenClaims: I created the Voucher Card system from scratch.
The original white Voucher Card was created for Voucher Center.
Colour alone was the system innovation.

strengths: Proactively initiated an organisation-level system problem
Voucher and Payment co-leadership with clear domain ownership
Shared taxonomy, rules, states and component operating model
Multiple shipped capabilities and measurable initiative evidence
remainingGaps: Executive or senior-leadership adoption forum
Exact number of teams and surfaces using the model
Quantified reduction in setup time, rework or coordination
Formal governance after handoff
Mentoring or quality-bar evidence tied directly to this programme

en: How do you design a scalable voucher system?
How do you reduce eligibility and redemption confusion?
How do you align campaign operations across channels?
zh: 如何設計可擴充的 Voucher 系統？
如何降低資格與兌換混亂？
如何對齊跨通路活動營運？

confidentialityNote.en: For confidentiality reasons, exact metrics are not disclosed.
confidentialityNote.zh: 基於保密原因，未公開精確數據。

publicSummary.en: Led evidence synthesis, customer-journey and system framing, interaction design and reusable component modelling; long-term mechanics, phasing and programme priorities were decided with product, business, operations, research, engineering and Design System partners.
publicSummary.zh: 主導證據統整、顧客旅程與系統定義、互動設計及可重用元件模型；長期機制、分階段策略與計畫優先順序則與產品、商務、營運、研究、工程及設計系統夥伴共同決定。

ledByMe.en: End-to-end evidence synthesis across research and shipped initiatives
ledByMe.zh: 跨研究與已上線子專案的端到端證據統整

ledByMe.en: Four-scenario journey/task-flow modelling and voucher-structure definition
ledByMe.zh: 建立四種情境的旅程與任務流程，並定義優惠券結構

ledByMe.en: Customer-facing interaction, state and recovery design for owned initiatives
ledByMe.zh: 負責子專案的顧客互動、狀態與失敗復原設計
建立優惠券卡片與可重用元件模型
整理可公開的證據與系統敘事

coDecided.en: Long-term reward mechanism and transition direction
coDecided.zh: 長期獎勵機制與轉換方向
商業規則對齊與計畫分期

coDecided.en: Formal Design System adoption and governance
coDecided.zh: 正式納入設計系統及其治理方式

partnerOwned.en: Research recruitment and specialist research facilitation
partnerOwned.zh: 研究招募與專業研究執行

partnerOwned.en: Business funding, campaign and operational rules
partnerOwned.zh: 商業預算、活動與營運規則

ownershipDetail.en: Led the campaign-flow and state design; the preloaded-wallet release direction was aligned with PM, business and engineering.
ownershipDetail.zh: 主導活動流程與狀態設計；Preloaded-wallet 上線方向則與產品經理、商務及工程共同對齊。

ownershipDetail.en: Co-led the phased recovery model with the PM and owned the interaction, state and message design.
ownershipDetail.zh: 與產品經理共同主導分階段復原模型，並負責互動、狀態與 Message 設計。

ownershipDetail.en: Led the hypothesis, prototype and product-page experience; business problem definition and rollout were aligned with business, PM and research.
ownershipDetail.zh: 主導 Hypothesis、原型與產品團隊-頁面 experience；商業問題與推行則與商務團隊、產品經理及研究團隊對齊。

ownershipDetail.en: Owned the interaction structure and shipped-state specification.
ownershipDetail.zh: 負責互動結構與已上線-狀態規格。

ownershipDetail.en: Led the condition and channel action model; feasibility and business rules were jointly resolved with PM and engineering.
ownershipDetail.zh: 主導 Condition／通路操作模型；Feasibility 與商業規則則與產品經理及工程團隊共同解決。

ownershipDetail.en: Prepared the evidence, mechanism comparison and transition model; the long-term mechanism and phasing were programme decisions shared with product, business, operations and engineering.
ownershipDetail.zh: 整理證據、機制 comparison 與轉型模型；長期機制及 Phasing 則由產品、商務、營運及工程共同決定。

ownershipDetail.en: Led channel-constraint and customer-friction analysis; the final mechanism direction required shared business and engineering approval.
ownershipDetail.zh: 主導通路 constraint 與顧客-friction 分析；最終機制方向需由商務與工程共同核准。

ownershipDetail.en: Co-led early card exploration and translated cross-team feedback into responsive variants; formal component adoption was completed with the Design System team.
ownershipDetail.zh: 共同主導早期卡片 exploration，將跨團隊回饋轉化為響應式版本；正式元件採用則與設計系統 team 共同完成。

ownershipDetail.en: Led evidence synthesis and information-priority recommendations; final visual semantics were aligned with the Design System team.
ownershipDetail.zh: 主導證據統整與資訊priority recommendations；最終 Visual 語意與設計系統 team 對齊。

ownershipDetail.en: Defined the cross-journey property and state requirements; component API and governance were resolved with Design System and engineering.
ownershipDetail.zh: 定義跨旅程 Property 與狀態需求；元件 API 與治理則與設計系統及工程團隊共同解決。

ownershipDetail.en: Mapped operational rules and reusable states; final configuration ownership and governance were shared with operations, product, engineering and Design System.
ownershipDetail.zh: 整理營運規則與 Reusable 狀態；最終 Configuration ownership 與治理則由營運團隊、產品團隊、工程團隊及設計系統共同承擔。

claim.en: In a nine-participant wallet study, no participant used search during the tasks even though five later rated it as important.
claim.zh: 在 9 人錢包測試中，任務期間無人使用搜尋，但事後有 5 人將搜尋評為重要功能。

claim.en: Observed shopping behaviour started from products and categories rather than from the voucher wallet, supporting contextual discovery over wallet-first design.
claim.zh: 觀察到顧客從商品與品類開始購物，而不是先進入優惠券錢包，支持採用情境式探索。

claim.en: Voucher taxonomy, wallet, contextual offer surfaces, auto-apply, cart matching, code redemption and supplier-funded modules launched and continued to be used.
claim.zh: 優惠券分類、錢包、情境式優惠入口、自動套用、購物車配對、優惠碼兌換及供應商贊助模組皆已上線並持續使用。

claim.en: A campaign snapshot recorded substantial drop-off between payment entry, adding a voucher and applying all vouchers.
claim.zh: 特定活動資料顯示，從付款入口到新增優惠券，再到套用全部優惠券之間存在明顯流失。

heroVisualBrief.problemSignal: Fragmented discovery, eligibility and redemption across the journey
heroVisualBrief.systemSignal: Wallet, PDP/cart guidance and shared voucher-card/state model
heroVisualBrief.outcomeSignal: Reusable incentive capabilities across customer and supplier-funded journeys

title.en: Scaling incentives meant aligning different rules, states and behaviours across multiple shopping journeys.
title.zh: 擴展獎勵體驗，代表必須對齊多條購物旅程中的不同規則、狀態與行為。

description.en: Campaign-specific logic had accumulated across channels, creating repeated interpretation for teams and inconsistent expectations for customers.
description.zh: 各通路長期累積活動專屬邏輯，讓團隊必須重複解讀，也使顧客對體驗產生不一致預期。

intervention.en: Shared voucher rules and decision layer
intervention.zh: 共用優惠券規則與決策層

after.en: Consistent behaviour across product, cart, checkout, wallet, and store journeys
after.zh: 商品、購物車、結帳、票券錢包與門市旅程能一致運作

supportingCopy.en: I connected recurring voucher rules, states, and interactions across journeys so teams could build on a shared product foundation instead of redefining them for each touchpoint.
supportingCopy.zh: 我將不同旅程中反覆出現的優惠券規則、狀態與操作整理成共用產品基礎，讓團隊不必在每個接觸點重新定義。

cardTitle.en: Building a reusable cross-channel incentive system
cardTitle.zh: 建立可重用的跨通路獎勵系統

title.en: From fragmented campaign logic to a reusable incentive system
title.zh: 從分散的活動規則，到可重用的獎勵系統

atAGlance.en: Led the three-year evolution of FairPrice’s incentive experience, turning campaign-specific Voucher logic into reusable product rules and capabilities across product, cart, checkout, Wallet and in-store journeys.
atAGlance.zh: 主導 FairPrice 三年獎勵體驗演進，將各活動獨立的 Voucher 邏輯轉化為可重用的產品規則與能力，涵蓋商品、購物車、結帳、優惠券錢包 與門市旅程。

whyItMattered.en: Voucher rules had evolved separately by campaign and channel, leaving discovery, eligibility, redemption, and internal setup inconsistent across the retail ecosystem.
whyItMattered.zh: 優惠券規則隨活動與通路各自發展，使探索、資格判斷、兌換與內部設定在整個零售生態中缺乏一致性。

businessImpact.en: Established shared incentive rules and reusable product foundations, reducing the need to reinterpret and rebuild voucher behaviour for every campaign.
businessImpact.zh: 建立共享獎勵規則與可重用產品基礎，降低每次活動都必須重新解讀與重建優惠券行為的依賴。

rationale.en: Uses eligibility, rewards and behavioural mechanics to influence participation or repeat behaviour.
rationale.zh: 透過資格、獎勵與行為機制影響參與或重複行為。

criticalProblem.en: Voucher rules had evolved separately by campaign and channel, leaving discovery, eligibility, redemption, and internal setup inconsistent across the retail ecosystem.
criticalProblem.zh: 優惠券規則隨活動與通路各自發展，使探索、資格判斷、兌換與內部設定在整個零售生態中缺乏一致性。

title.en: Scaling incentives meant aligning different rules, states and behaviours across multiple shopping journeys.
title.zh: 擴展獎勵體驗，代表必須對齊多條購物旅程中的不同規則、狀態與行為。

description.en: Campaign-specific logic had accumulated across channels, creating repeated interpretation for teams and inconsistent expectations for customers.
description.zh: 各通路長期累積活動專屬邏輯，讓團隊必須重複解讀，也使顧客對體驗產生不一致預期。

title.en: I turned fragmented incentive work into a reusable system that made rewards more visible, easier to act on and capable of driving repeated engagement across five shopping stages.
title.zh: 我將分散的獎勵工作整合為可重用系統，讓獎勵更容易被看見與採取行動，並能在五個購物階段支持重複參與。

text.en: Fragmented incentives were easy to miss, inconsistent across journeys and repeatedly redefined by teams.
text.zh: 分散的獎勵容易被錯過，在不同旅程中不一致，也需要團隊反覆重新定義。

text.en: Connected discovery, reward visibility, progress and redemption into one incentive journey, while standardising the shared rules, states and reusable product foundations behind it.
text.zh: 將探索、獎勵可見度、進度與兌換串成行為導向的獎勵旅程，同時標準化背後的共享規則、狀態與可重用產品基礎。

text.en: A more compelling incentive experience designed to support repeated engagement, backed by a reusable system across five shopping stages.
text.zh: 一套以重複參與為目標、更具吸引力的獎勵體驗，並由橫跨五個購物階段的可重用系統支撐。

text.en: Prioritise against one journey
text.zh: 依完整旅程排序

text.en: Reuse established rules and components
text.zh: 重用規則與元件

text.en: Start from shared states and patterns
text.zh: 從共享狀態與模式開始

text.en: Use consistent condition language
text.zh: 使用一致條件語言

text.en: Configure and diagnose from shared logic
text.zh: 依共享邏輯設定與診斷

title.en: Value had to appear in the shopping journey—not outside it
title.zh: 優惠價值必須出現在購物旅程中，而不是旅程之外

statement.en: Customers did not need more Vouchers. They needed value to appear in the right shopping context, with clear eligibility and a trustworthy path to application.
statement.zh: 顧客需要的不是更多優惠券，而是讓價值在正確購物情境中出現，並具備清楚資格與可信任的套用路徑。

signals.en: Value appeared outside the shopping flow
signals.zh: 優惠價值出現在購物流程之外
資格條件直到太晚才被理解

signals.en: One action did not fit every Voucher mechanic
signals.zh: 單一操作無法適用所有優惠券機制
手動套用造成漏用優惠的焦慮

signals.en: States and terminology changed across channels
signals.zh: 狀態與名詞隨通路改變

keyInsight.en: Voucher value often appeared outside the moment customers were deciding what to buy.
keyInsight.zh: Voucher 價值經常出現在顧客決定購買內容的決策時刻之外。

whatChanged.en: Surface relevant value within product, search and in-store contexts.
whatChanged.zh: 在商品、搜尋與門市情境中呈現相關價值。

shipped.en: Connected relevant Voucher visibility to shopping contexts such as PDP and Voucher Details, rather than relying on Wallet discovery alone.
shipped.zh: 將相關 Voucher 曝光連結至 PDP 與 Voucher Details 等購物情境，而非只依賴 Wallet 探索。

title.en: Surface applicable Voucher value directly on PDP
title.zh: 直接在商品頁呈現適用 Voucher 價值

whatIDecided.en: Added contextual eligible Voucher visibility to PDP so customers could see relevant value while evaluating a product.
whatIDecided.zh: 在 PDP 加入情境式適用 Voucher 曝光，讓顧客在評估商品時看見相關價值。

whyThisChoice.en: Voucher discovery previously sat outside the product decision. Bringing eligibility into PDP reduced the need to leave the shopping journey to search for relevant value.
whyThisChoice.zh: Voucher 探索原先位於商品決策之外。將資格資訊帶入 PDP，減少顧客離開購物旅程另行搜尋相關價值的需要。

whatThisRequired.en: Aligned Voucher, offer and product data so eligibility and visibility states could remain consistent from product evaluation through cart and checkout.
whatThisRequired.zh: 對齊 Voucher、offer 與商品資料，使資格與可見狀態能從商品評估一致延續至購物車與結帳。

outcome.en: Relevant Voucher value became visible closer to purchase intent, reducing the effort required to discover applicable savings before adding a product to cart.
outcome.zh: 相關 Voucher 價值更接近購買意圖出現，降低顧客在加入商品前探索適用優惠所需的操作與理解成本。

title.en: Connect Voucher Details to eligible products
title.zh: 將 Voucher Details 連結至適用商品

whatIDecided.en: Reframed Voucher Details from static redemption instructions into an actionable shopping surface showing eligible products.
whatIDecided.zh: 將 Voucher Details 從靜態兌換說明重構為呈現適用商品、可直接採取購物行動的介面。

whyThisChoice.en: Customers previously had to interpret Voucher conditions and then search separately for qualifying products. Bringing eligible products into the same context made the next action clearer.
whyThisChoice.zh: 顧客原先必須先解讀 Voucher 條件，再另行搜尋符合資格的商品。將適用商品帶入同一情境，讓下一步更明確。

whatThisRequired.en: Connected Voucher conditions with product eligibility so Voucher Details could surface relevant products without introducing a separate discovery model.
whatThisRequired.zh: 連結 Voucher 條件與商品資格，使 Voucher Details 能呈現相關商品，而不必建立另一套探索模型。

outcome.en: In the Voucher Details flow, observed add-to-cart rate trended from ~1.5% to ~4% after eligible products were surfaced in context.
outcome.zh: 在 Voucher Details 流程中，情境式呈現適用商品後，觀察到的加入購物車率由約 1.5% 上升至約 4%。

evidenceNote.en: Observed add-to-cart rate increased from ~1.5% to ~4%. Observational trend, not a controlled causal experiment.
evidenceNote.zh: 觀察到的加入購物車率由約 1.5% 上升至約 4%。屬觀察趨勢，非受控因果實驗。

keyInsight.en: Voucher value often appeared outside the moment customers were deciding what to buy.
keyInsight.zh: Voucher 價值經常出現在顧客決定購買內容的決策時刻之外。

designDirection.en: Surface relevant value within product, search and in-store contexts.
designDirection.zh: 在商品、搜尋與門市情境中呈現相關價值。

designSolution.en: Connected relevant Voucher visibility to shopping contexts such as PDP and Voucher Details, rather than relying on Wallet discovery alone.
designSolution.zh: 將相關 Voucher 曝光連結至 PDP 與 Voucher Details 等購物情境，而非只依賴 Wallet 探索。

outcome.en: Relevant Voucher value became visible closer to purchase intent, reducing the need to leave the shopping journey to find or interpret applicable offers.
outcome.zh: 相關 Voucher 價值更接近購買意圖出現，減少顧客為尋找或理解適用優惠而離開購物旅程的需要。

problem.en: Voucher value often appeared outside the moment customers were deciding what to buy.
problem.zh: Voucher 價值經常出現在顧客決定購買內容的決策時刻之外。

direction.en: Surface relevant value within product, search and in-store contexts.
direction.zh: 在商品、搜尋與門市情境中呈現相關價值。

representativeShippedSignal.en: Connected relevant Voucher visibility to shopping contexts such as PDP and Voucher Details, rather than relying on Wallet discovery alone.
representativeShippedSignal.zh: 將相關 Voucher 曝光連結至 PDP 與 Voucher Details 等購物情境，而非只依賴 Wallet 探索。

keyInsight.en: Customers had to interpret product, channel and threshold conditions before knowing whether a Voucher was useful.
keyInsight.zh: 顧客必須先解讀商品、通路與門檻條件，才能判斷 Voucher 是否有用。

whatChanged.zh: 在投入前讓資格判定清楚易懂。

shipped.en: Linked Voucher conditions to eligible items, channel requirements, savings and remaining thresholds.
shipped.zh: 將 Voucher 條件連結至適用商品、通路要求、節省金額與剩餘門檻。

title.en: Turn Voucher conditions into visible qualification guidance
title.zh: 將 Voucher 條件轉化為可見的資格引導

whatIDecided.en: Translated Voucher conditions into contextual qualification guidance by connecting eligible products with visible savings, channel requirements and remaining thresholds.
whatIDecided.zh: 連結適用商品、可節省金額、通路要求與剩餘門檻，將 Voucher 條件轉化為情境式資格引導。

whyThisChoice.en: Customers previously had to interpret Voucher rules and then work out for themselves which products qualified and what conditions remained. Eligibility needed to become part of the shopping decision rather than a separate rule-reading task.
whyThisChoice.zh: 顧客原先必須解讀 Voucher 規則，再自行判斷哪些商品符合資格及仍缺少哪些條件。資格判斷需要成為購物決策的一部分，而非獨立的規則閱讀工作。

whatThisRequired.en: Connected product eligibility, channel requirements and threshold states into a shared qualification model that could distinguish what qualified, what remained and when a Voucher became usable.
whatThisRequired.zh: 將商品資格、通路要求與門檻狀態連結成共享的資格模型，區分已符合、仍缺少與 Voucher 可使用的狀態。

outcome.en: Customers could understand both which products qualified and what remained before commitment, reducing interpretation effort and making Voucher eligibility more predictable before checkout.
outcome.zh: 顧客能在投入前同時理解哪些商品符合資格及仍需完成的條件，降低解讀成本，並讓結帳前的 Voucher 資格更可預期。

keyInsight.en: Customers had to interpret product, channel and threshold conditions before knowing whether a Voucher was useful.
keyInsight.zh: 顧客必須先解讀商品、通路與門檻條件，才能判斷 Voucher 是否有用。

designDirection.zh: 在投入前讓資格判定清楚易懂。

designSolution.en: Linked Voucher conditions to eligible items, channel requirements, savings and remaining thresholds.
designSolution.zh: 將 Voucher 條件連結至適用商品、通路要求、節省金額與剩餘門檻。

outcome.en: Eligibility became explicit at the point of decision, reducing interpretation effort and making remaining qualification requirements visible before checkout.
outcome.zh: 資格判定在決策節點變得明確，降低解讀負擔，並在結帳前呈現尚待完成的資格要求。

problem.en: Customers had to interpret product, channel and threshold conditions before knowing whether a Voucher was useful.
problem.zh: 顧客必須先解讀商品、通路與門檻條件，才能判斷 Voucher 是否有用。

direction.zh: 在投入前讓資格判定清楚易懂。

representativeShippedSignal.en: Linked Voucher conditions to eligible items, channel requirements, savings and remaining thresholds.
representativeShippedSignal.zh: 將 Voucher 條件連結至適用商品、通路要求、節省金額與剩餘門檻。

keyInsight.en: High-volume campaign participation depended on continuity across entry, browsing and return access—not a single campaign touchpoint.
keyInsight.zh: 高流量活動的參與仰賴入口、瀏覽與返回存取之間的連續性，而非單一活動接觸點。

whatChanged.en: Create a continuous path from campaign entry to repeat Voucher access.
whatChanged.zh: 建立從活動入口到重複存取 Voucher 的連續路徑。

shipped.en: Connected campaign entry points, the dedicated Save Every Day Voucher experience and Wallet access into one repeatable participation path.
shipped.zh: 將活動入口、專屬 Save Every Day Voucher 體驗與 Wallet 存取串成可重複使用的參與路徑。

title.en: Connect campaign entry, browsing and return access into one participation journey
title.zh: 將活動入口、瀏覽與返回存取串成單一參與旅程

whatIDecided.en: Connected campaign entry points, the dedicated Save Every Day Voucher experience and Wallet access into one continuous participation path.
whatIDecided.zh: 將活動入口、專屬 Save Every Day Voucher 體驗與 Wallet 存取串成一條連續的參與路徑。

whyThisChoice.en: A high-volume Voucher campaign could not depend on a single exposure. Customers needed a clear way to enter the campaign, understand what was available and return to distributed Vouchers later without rediscovering the campaign from scratch.
whyThisChoice.zh: 高流量 Voucher 活動不能依賴單次曝光。顧客需要清楚進入活動、理解可用內容，並能在之後返回已發放的 Voucher，而不必重新探索活動。

whatThisRequired.en: Aligned campaign entry, Voucher availability and Wallet states so the same campaign value remained coherent across initial discovery, browsing and later return access.
whatThisRequired.zh: 對齊活動入口、Voucher 可用性與 Wallet 狀態，使相同活動價值能在首次探索、瀏覽與後續返回時保持一致。

outcome.en: Campaign Vouchers remained easier to discover and return to across the campaign lifecycle, reducing re-entry friction after first exposure.
outcome.zh: 活動 Voucher 在整個活動生命週期中更容易被發現與再次存取，降低首次曝光後重新進入的阻力。

keyInsight.en: High-volume campaign participation depended on continuity across entry, browsing and return access—not a single campaign touchpoint.
keyInsight.zh: 高流量活動的參與仰賴入口、瀏覽與返回存取之間的連續性，而非單一活動接觸點。

designDirection.en: Create a continuous path from campaign entry to repeat Voucher access.
designDirection.zh: 建立從活動入口到重複存取 Voucher 的連續路徑。

designSolution.en: Connected campaign entry points, the dedicated Save Every Day Voucher experience and Wallet access into one repeatable participation path.
designSolution.zh: 將活動入口、專屬 Save Every Day Voucher 體驗與 Wallet 存取串成可重複使用的參與路徑。

outcome.en: Campaign Vouchers remained easier to rediscover after first exposure, reducing re-entry friction across the campaign lifecycle.
outcome.zh: 活動 Voucher 在首次曝光後仍更容易再次找到，降低整個活動生命週期的重新進入阻力。

problem.en: High-volume campaign participation depended on continuity across entry, browsing and return access—not a single campaign touchpoint.
problem.zh: 高流量活動的參與仰賴入口、瀏覽與返回存取之間的連續性，而非單一活動接觸點。

direction.en: Create a continuous path from campaign entry to repeat Voucher access.
direction.zh: 建立從活動入口到重複存取 Voucher 的連續路徑。

representativeShippedSignal.en: Connected campaign entry points, the dedicated Save Every Day Voucher experience and Wallet access into one repeatable participation path.
representativeShippedSignal.zh: 將活動入口、專屬 Save Every Day Voucher 體驗與 Wallet 存取串成可重複使用的參與路徑。

keyInsight.en: Customers had to judge Voucher applicability and selection rules on their own.
keyInsight.zh: 顧客必須自行判斷 Voucher 適用性與選取規則。

whatChanged.en: Move redemption logic from customer judgment into system guidance.
whatChanged.zh: 將兌換邏輯從顧客自行判斷轉為系統引導。

shipped.en: Grouped applicable and unavailable Vouchers, enabled Select all for bulk selection, and surfaced non-stackable conflicts before checkout.
shipped.zh: 將適用與不可用 Voucher 分組，提供 Select all 批次選取，並在結帳前呈現不可疊加衝突。

title.en: Make Voucher selection system-guided from applicability through conflict recovery
title.zh: 從適用性到衝突復原，讓 Voucher 選擇由系統引導

whatIDecided.en: Reframed Voucher selection around system-known applicability by separating usable and unavailable Vouchers, supporting bulk selection with Select all, and surfacing non-stackable conflicts before checkout.
whatIDecided.zh: 以系統已知的適用性重構 Voucher 選擇：分開可用與不可用 Voucher、提供 Select all 批次選取，並在結帳前呈現不可疊加衝突。

whyThisChoice.en: Customers were being asked to interpret rules the system already knew. As Voucher volume increased, manually checking applicability, selecting Vouchers one by one and discovering conflicts late created unnecessary decision and recovery effort.
whyThisChoice.zh: 顧客被要求自行解讀系統已知的規則。當 Voucher 數量增加，手動檢查適用性、逐一選取及延後發現衝突，造成不必要的決策與復原成本。

whatThisRequired.en: Standardised applicability, selection and stacking states across Voucher types so bulk actions and conflict handling could follow the same underlying redemption logic.
whatThisRequired.zh: 統一不同 Voucher 類型的適用、選取與疊加狀態，使批次操作與衝突處理遵循同一套兌換邏輯。

outcome.en: Redemption became more predictable and less manually intensive: customers could identify usable Vouchers faster, apply valid combinations more efficiently and resolve conflicts before progressing into checkout.
outcome.zh: 兌換變得更可預期且減少手動操作：顧客可更快辨識可用 Voucher、更有效率地套用有效組合，並在進入結帳前解決衝突。

keyInsight.en: Customers had to judge Voucher applicability and selection rules on their own.
keyInsight.zh: 顧客必須自行判斷 Voucher 適用性與選取規則。

designDirection.en: Move redemption logic from customer judgment into system guidance.
designDirection.zh: 將兌換邏輯從顧客自行判斷轉為系統引導。

designSolution.en: Grouped applicable and unavailable Vouchers, enabled Select all for bulk selection, and surfaced non-stackable conflicts before checkout.
designSolution.zh: 將適用與不可用 Voucher 分組，提供 Select all 批次選取，並在結帳前呈現不可疊加衝突。

outcome.en: Redemption became more system-guided, reducing manual applicability checks and surfacing invalid combinations before checkout.
outcome.zh: 兌換流程轉為更明確的系統引導，減少手動適用性檢查，並在結帳前揭露無效組合。

problem.en: Customers had to judge Voucher applicability and selection rules on their own.
problem.zh: 顧客必須自行判斷 Voucher 適用性與選取規則。

direction.en: Move redemption logic from customer judgment into system guidance.
direction.zh: 將兌換邏輯從顧客自行判斷轉為系統引導。

representativeShippedSignal.en: Grouped applicable and unavailable Vouchers, enabled Select all for bulk selection, and surfaced non-stackable conflicts before checkout.
representativeShippedSignal.zh: 將適用與不可用 Voucher 分組，提供 Select all 批次選取，並在結帳前呈現不可疊加衝突。

keyInsight.en: High-volume Voucher use made payment harder when customers had to work out which Vouchers could actually be applied.
keyInsight.zh: 在大量使用 Voucher 時，若顧客必須自行判斷哪些 Voucher 能實際套用，付款決策會更加困難。

whatChanged.en: Make Voucher application status explicit inside payment.
whatChanged.zh: 在付款流程中明確呈現 Voucher 套用狀態。

shipped.en: Owned the Voucher interaction and rule logic, partnering with the Payment designer to integrate Voucher access and added / not-added review into the payment flow.
shipped.zh: 負責 Voucher 互動與規則邏輯，並與 Payment designer 協作，將 Voucher 存取及已加入／未加入檢視整合至付款流程。

title.en: Make Voucher application status verifiable before payment
title.zh: 讓付款前的 Voucher 套用狀態可被確認

whatIDecided.en: Defined the Voucher interaction and review logic so customers could see which Vouchers had been applied and which remained unapplied before continuing with payment.
whatIDecided.zh: 定義 Voucher 互動與檢視邏輯，使顧客在繼續付款前看見哪些 Voucher 已套用、哪些仍未套用。

whyThisChoice.en: With many Vouchers available, customers needed confirmation of the system’s selection rather than relying on memory or inferring savings from the final payable amount.
whyThisChoice.zh: 當可用 Voucher 很多時，顧客需要確認系統的選擇，而不是依賴記憶或從最終應付金額推測節省內容。

whatThisRequired.en: Defined Voucher selection and review states, then partnered with the Payment designer to integrate those states into the existing payment journey.
whatThisRequired.zh: 定義 Voucher 選取與檢視狀態，並與 Payment designer 協作，將這些狀態整合進既有付款旅程。

outcome.en: Customers could verify Voucher application before payment, increasing transparency and reducing uncertainty around which savings had been applied.
outcome.zh: 顧客可在付款前確認 Voucher 套用狀態，提高透明度，並降低對哪些優惠已套用的不確定性。

ownership.en: Shulin owned Voucher interaction and rule logic; the Payment designer owned the payment flow; integration was collaborative.
ownership.zh: Shulin 負責 Voucher 互動與規則邏輯；Payment designer 負責付款流程；整合由雙方協作完成。

keyInsight.en: High-volume Voucher use made payment harder when customers had to work out which Vouchers could actually be applied.
keyInsight.zh: 在大量使用 Voucher 時，若顧客必須自行判斷哪些 Voucher 能實際套用，付款決策會更加困難。

designDirection.en: Make Voucher application status explicit inside payment.
designDirection.zh: 在付款流程中明確呈現 Voucher 套用狀態。

designSolution.en: Owned the Voucher interaction and rule logic, partnering with the Payment designer to integrate Voucher access and added / not-added review into the payment flow.
designSolution.zh: 負責 Voucher 互動與規則邏輯，並與 Payment designer 協作，將 Voucher 存取及已加入／未加入檢視整合至付款流程。

outcome.en: Customers could verify applied and unapplied Vouchers before continuing, increasing transparency at the payment decision point.
outcome.zh: 顧客可在繼續付款前確認已套用與未套用的 Voucher，提高付款決策節點的透明度。

problem.en: High-volume Voucher use made payment harder when customers had to work out which Vouchers could actually be applied.
problem.zh: 在大量使用 Voucher 時，若顧客必須自行判斷哪些 Voucher 能實際套用，付款決策會更加困難。

direction.zh: 在付款流程中明確呈現 Voucher 套用狀態。

representativeShippedSignal.zh: 負責 Voucher 互動與規則邏輯，並與 Payment designer 協作，將 Voucher 存取及已加入／未加入檢視整合至付款流程。

title.en: Reusable system across journey stages
title.zh: 橫跨旅程階段的可重用系統

text.en: Eligibility, thresholds and application logic shared across Voucher types and journey stages.
text.zh: 跨 Voucher 類型與旅程階段共享的資格、門檻與套用邏輯。

text.en: Available, applicable, selected, redeemed and error states defined consistently across touchpoints.
text.zh: 在各接觸點一致定義可用、適用、已選取、已兌換與錯誤狀態。

text.en: Discovery, qualification, selection and recovery patterns reused across the incentive journey.
text.zh: 探索、資格判定、選取與復原模式在獎勵旅程中重複使用。

text.en: Voucher variants mapped to shared components and Operations configuration.
text.zh: Voucher variants 對應共享元件與營運配置。

history.en: Existing white Voucher Card → colour evolution → reusable Tangram component abstraction → Operations mapping.
history.zh: 既有白色 Voucher Card → 色彩演進 → Tangram 元件抽象化 → 營運對應。

insight.en: Colour differentiated variants, but colour could not carry meaning alone.
insight.zh: 色彩可區分版本，但不能單獨承載意義。

bridge.en: Findings informed information hierarchy and variant differentiation before the evolved Voucher Card became a reusable Tangram component mapped to Operations configuration.
bridge.zh: 研究發現先形塑資訊層級與 variant 區分，之後演進後的 Voucher Card 成為可重用 Tangram 元件，並對應至營運配置。

headline.en: What this foundation enabled
headline.zh: 這套基礎帶來的可能性

thesis.en: The shared taxonomy, eligibility logic, state model and behavioural signals created a foundation for a more intent-led incentive platform—one that could capture intent earlier, reduce application effort and support stronger cross-channel measurement.
thesis.zh: 共享分類架構、資格判定邏輯、狀態模型與行為訊號，為更意圖導向的獎勵平台建立基礎，使其能更早捕捉意圖、降低套用負擔，並支援更完整的跨通路衡量。

content.en: Relevant discovery, clear criteria, visible savings and lower redemption effort.
content.zh: 相關探索、清楚條件、可見節省金額與較低兌換負擔。

content.en: Flexible targeting, measurable behaviour change and lower campaign setup and redemption overhead.
content.zh: 彈性分眾設定、可衡量行為改變，以及較低的從設定到請款負擔。

content.en: Shared taxonomy, eligibility, states, behaviour signals and cross-channel measurement.
content.zh: 共享分類架構、資格判斷、狀態、行為訊號與跨通路衡量。

title.en: The programme improved discovery, action and repeatable delivery.
title.zh: 計畫改善探索、行動與可重複交付。

label.en: relative growth in digital redemption share
label.zh: 數位兌換占比相對成長

primaryCopy.en: digital redemption share growth after PDP enhancements surfaced eligible Vouchers in context
primaryCopy.zh: PDP 優化在情境中呈現適用 Voucher 後，數位兌換占比成長

evidenceNote.en: from 43.9% in the previous SEC campaign to 83.8% during CNY; internal campaign reporting linked the improvement to eligible Voucher swimlanes and Voucher badges on product imagery.

evidenceNote.zh: 觀察到的加入購物車率約由 1.5% 上升至 4%。屬約略增幅與觀察趨勢，非受控因果實驗。

label.en: digital redemptions during Save Every Day

evidenceNote.en: Campaign-scale operational result.
evidenceNote.zh: 活動規模營運成果。

evidenceNote.zh: 由 2 週縮短至 2 天。

systemChange.zh: 共享規則、狀態與可重用模式降低跨團隊重複解讀。

intro.en: A clear line between outcomes I drove and decisions made with partners.
intro.zh: 清楚區分我推動的成果與夥伴共同決策。

title.en: Turn fragmented incentive signals into one journey strategy
title.zh: 將分散獎勵訊號整合為單一旅程策略

text.en: Led research synthesis, system framing, end-to-end journey strategy, interaction architecture and recurring validation.
text.zh: 主導研究統整、系統定義、端到端旅程策略、互動架構與持續驗證。

title.en: Make the strategy buildable, measurable and operationally viable
title.zh: 讓策略可建置、可衡量且具營運可行性

text.en: Joint prioritisation, feasibility, rules and measurement with cross-functional partners.
text.zh: 與跨職能夥伴共同進行優先排序、可行性、規則與衡量決策。

title.en: Programme-wide research and validation
title.zh: 全計畫研究與驗證

summary.en: Research across Voucher discovery, qualification and redemption shaped the system.
summary.zh: 橫跨 Voucher 探索、資格判定與兌換的研究形塑了這套系統。

voucher-center.home_title_zh: 常設優惠券探索與領取
voucher-center.transformation: From fragmented campaign discovery to a persistent Voucher claim product
voucher-center.transformation_zh: 從分散的活動型探索，到常設優惠券領取產品
voucher-center.summary: A persistent Voucher Center made discovery, claiming and post-claim states explicit beyond campaign-specific destinations.
voucher-center.summary_zh: 常設 Voucher Center 讓探索、領取與領取後狀態清楚可見，不再只仰賴活動專屬目的地。
voucher-center.owned: End-to-end Voucher Center discovery and claim model, research synthesis, interaction states and shipped-scope definition
voucher-center.owned_zh: 端到端 Voucher Center 探索與領取模型、研究統整、互動狀態與上線範圍定義
voucher-center.at_glance: Led product structure and interaction design for a 5-month Voucher Center, turning fragmented campaign discovery into a persistent claim surface. A 20-participant study shaped the first release and reusable Claim → View states.
voucher-center.at_glance_zh: 主導為期 5 個月的 Voucher Center 產品架構與互動設計，將分散的活動型探索轉化為常設領取入口；20 位參與者研究塑造第一階段上線範圍與可重用的領取 → 查看狀態。
voucher-center.scope: Persistent Voucher discovery and access, from homepage entry to category access and explicit Claim → View states.
voucher-center.scope_zh: 常設優惠券探索與領取，涵蓋首頁入口、分類存取與明確的領取 → 查看狀態。
voucher-center.audience:
Primary: Customers discovering and claiming Vouchers
Secondary: Campaign / Voucher Operations, Business / Sponsor stakeholders
voucher-center.audience_zh:
主要：探索並領取優惠券的顧客
次要：活動／優惠券營運、商務／贊助利害關係人
voucher-center.why: Voucher discovery depended on campaign destinations and passive deposits, making claimable value easy to miss before shopping and forcing new programmes to rely on another campaign-specific entry point.
voucher-center.why_zh: 優惠券探索仰賴活動目的地與被動存入，使可領取價值在購物前容易被忽略，也迫使新計畫再次依賴活動專屬入口。
voucher-center.impact: Established a scalable entry, eligibility, and state model that supported multiple voucher campaigns without creating another disconnected customer journey.
voucher-center.impact_zh: 建立可擴充的入口、資格與狀態模型，支援多種優惠券活動，不必持續新增彼此分離的使用旅程。

productEvolutionImplementationContract.implementationRule: Audit the existing reusable Evidence/Journey components first. Extend the actual owner with a safe variant; do not duplicate the Project Detail shell, page, CSS owner, or media viewer.

title.en: From pilot proof to a permanent claim surface
title.zh: 從前導驗證到常設領取入口

role.en: Shipped in-market precursor and sponsor proof point
role.zh: 已上線的市場前導與贊助論證

evidence.en: Flash Voucher showed that a focused Voucher journey, explicit availability states and direct shopping actions could ship in production.
evidence.zh: Flash Voucher 證明聚焦的優惠券旅程、明確可用狀態與直接購物操作能在正式環境上線。

boundary.en: ~S$1.5M GMV and ~15× ROI are proposal-era modelled targets—not actual results, post-launch performance or measured ROI.
boundary.zh: 約 150 萬新幣 GMV 與約 15 倍 ROI 是提案階段的模型化目標，並非實際成果、上線後成效或實測 ROI。

role.en: Persistent Voucher discovery and claim product
role.zh: 常設優惠券探索與領取產品

evidence.en: A 20-participant architecture study informed the shipped homepage entry, claimable count, red/green hierarchy and Claim → View card states.
evidence.zh: 20 位參與者的架構研究推動首頁入口、可領取數量、紅綠層級與領取 → 查看卡片狀態上線。

boundary.en: Claim all and the full consolidated architecture did not ship.
boundary.zh: 全部領取與完整整合架構未上線。

carryForward.en: Move from temporary campaign destinations to a persistent product entry.
carryForward.zh: 從暫時活動目的地，轉為常設產品入口。

carryForward.en: Make claimable value and post-claim state visible.
carryForward.zh: 讓可領取價值與領取後狀態清楚可見。

carryForward.en: Generalise selected behaviours instead of copying campaign screens.
carryForward.zh: 將特定行為一般化，而不是直接複製活動畫面。

title.en: Research changed what we shipped
title.zh: 研究改變了最終上線內容

focus.en: Entry visibility, one-page versus two-page architecture and claim-action semantics.
focus.zh: 入口可見性、單頁／雙頁架構與領取操作語意。

evidence.en: preferred the stronger Voucher Center entry
evidence.zh: 偏好更醒目的 Voucher Center 入口

evidence.en: preferred consolidated navigation among the architecture alternatives
evidence.zh: 在架構方案中偏好整合式導覽，相較分開頁面為 7 比 4

productChange.en: The evidence established a persistent entry and explicit Claim → View states for the first release, while preserving consolidated navigation as the target architecture.
productChange.zh: 研究證據促成第一階段的常設入口與明確領取 → 查看狀態，並將整合式導覽保留為目標架構。

interpretation.en: Customers needed a visible place to discover claimable value, a clear participation action and a coherent way to move across Voucher categories.
interpretation.zh: 顧客需要可見的入口來探索可領取價值、清楚的參與操作，以及一致的優惠券分類導覽方式。

title.en: Separate participation from application
title.zh: 將參與領取與購買套用分開

principle.en: Claiming creates ownership; application remains contextual to purchase.
principle.zh: 領取建立擁有狀態；套用仍保留在購買情境中。

whatIDecided.en: Defined Claim as the participation action and View as the post-claim state, creating a reusable Claim → View model while keeping Voucher application contextual to purchase.
whatIDecided.zh: 將「領取」定義為參與操作，將「查看」定義為領取後狀態，形成可重用的領取 → 查看模型；優惠券套用仍留在購買情境中。

whyThisChoice.en: 18 / 20 participants misunderstood “Use now” as an automatic later action, showing that one CTA could not truthfully represent both ownership and application.
whyThisChoice.zh: 18／20 位參與者誤解「立即使用」會在之後自動執行，顯示單一操作無法如實代表擁有與套用兩種狀態。

resultingModel.zh: 領取 → 查看狀態模型

title.en: Preserve the target architecture without blocking launch
title.zh: 不阻礙上線，同時保留目標架構

whatIDecided.en: Shipped the persistent entry, claimable count and Claim → View states within available launch capacity, while preserving consolidated navigation as the next product direction.
whatIDecided.zh: 在可用上線資源內交付常設入口、可領取數量與領取 → 查看狀態，同時將整合式導覽保留為下一階段產品方向。

whyThisChoice.en: Paid retail-media homepage placement had already been committed as the first priority, while Engineering capacity could not support the complete target architecture for launch.
whyThisChoice.zh: 付費零售媒體首頁版位已承諾並需維持第一順位；工程資源無法在上線時支援完整目標架構。

constraintManaged.en: Commercial homepage placement had to remain first priority, and Engineering capacity limited the first-release architecture.
constraintManaged.zh: 商業首頁版位必須維持第一順位，且工程資源限制第一階段可交付的架構。

content.en: We chose to ship within launch capacity, accepting lower entry prominence and some cross-page navigation to protect existing commercial commitments and avoid blocking launch on the complete architecture.
content.zh: 我們選擇在現實上線資源內交付，接受較低的入口醒目度與部分跨頁導覽，以保護既有商業承諾，並避免完整架構阻礙上線。

tradeOff.acceptedLoss: Lower entry prominence and some cross-page navigation
tradeOff.protectedValue: Existing commercial commitments and an unblocked launch
tradeOff.constraint: Committed paid retail-media homepage placement and limited Engineering capacity

preservedDirection.en: Consolidated navigation remained the target architecture for the next phase.
preservedDirection.zh: 整合式導覽仍保留為下一階段目標架構。

shippedOutcome: Count of Vouchers available to claim

confirmedShipped: Number of Vouchers available to claim

nextDirection.en: asked for Claim all without prompting
nextDirection.zh: 在未提示下主動提出全部領取

title.en: Turning product evolution into shared infrastructure
title.zh: 將產品演進轉化為共享基礎

thesis.en: A feature-specific evolution became a reusable shared capability.
thesis.zh: 將功能情境中的演進，轉化為可重用的共享能力。

title.en: Original white Voucher Card
title.zh: 原有白色優惠券卡片

content.en: The white Voucher Card already existed in the Design System before Voucher Center.
content.zh: 白色優惠券卡片在 Voucher Center 之前已存在於設計系統中。

title.en: Voucher Center state expression
title.zh: Voucher Center 狀態表達

content.en: I evolved the existing component with stronger visual differentiation, explicit Claim → View states and campaign / Voucher state expression.
content.zh: 我將既有元件演進為更清楚的視覺區分、明確的領取 → 查看狀態，以及活動／優惠券狀態表達。

title.en: Reusable Tangram component
title.zh: 可重用的 Tangram 元件

content.en: I persuaded the team to abstract the updated model into a reusable Tangram component for cross-product reuse.
content.zh: 我推動團隊將更新後的模型抽象成可重用的 Tangram 元件，支援跨產品使用。

ownership.en: I led the feature-specific evolution and influenced the team-level abstraction; I did not create the original Voucher Card system from scratch.
ownership.zh: 我主導功能情境中的元件演進，並推動團隊層級的抽象；原始優惠券卡片系統並非由我從零建立。

cta.en: View the broader Voucher / Offer Vision
cta.zh: 查看完整優惠券／優惠願景

continueExploring.independentProjectRule: Voucher Center remains an independent project card and route.

showInPrimaryNarrative: Two-stage Flash Voucher → Voucher Center validation path
Confirmed shipped foundation and explicit non-shipped boundary

executiveSummary.problem: Temporary campaign destinations and passive visibility prevented customers from reliably discovering claimable voucher value.
executiveSummary.strategy: Use a shipped campaign precursor, then validate a permanent discovery and claim architecture.
executiveSummary.outcome: Shipped a persistent homepage entry, claimable count, red/green hierarchy and Claim → View states.

flashVoucher2024.name: Flash Voucher

relationshipBoundary.en: Flash Voucher did not become Voucher Center unchanged. It shipped a campaign-scoped implementation of selected behaviours that were later generalised in the persistent Voucher Center product.
relationshipBoundary.zh: Flash Voucher 並非原封不動變成 Voucher Center；它先以活動範圍上線部分行為，之後再被一般化為持續型 Voucher Center 的產品能力。

publicLine.en: Led product design and partnered with the Product Manager to deliver the campaign and reward progression.
publicLine.zh: 主導產品設計，並與產品經理共同推進活動與獎勵進程正式上線。

objective.en: Acquire new online-grocery customers and shape behaviour towards four or more orders.
objective.zh: 取得線上雜貨新客，並培養四次以上的下單習慣。

gmvIntent.en: Use reward Vouchers after qualifying orders to encourage continued spend and support GMV growth.
gmvIntent.zh: 在完成符合條件的訂單後發放獎勵優惠券，鼓勵持續消費並支援 GMV 成長。

businessStrategy.outcomeBoundary: The business strategy and mechanic shipped; no performance metrics were provided.

shippedMechanic.model: Initial Flash Voucher followed by three reward Vouchers across qualifying orders

description.en: Targeted Omni modal or campaign entry for eligible customers.
description.zh: 透過 Omni 彈出視窗或活動入口觸及符合條件的顧客。

description.en: Dedicated Flash Voucher page with Save, availability states and direct shopping action.
description.zh: 在專屬 Flash Voucher 頁面完成儲存、查看可用狀態並直接開始購物。

description.en: Use the Voucher on a qualifying online-grocery order.
description.zh: 在符合條件的線上雜貨訂單中使用優惠券。

description.en: Reward Vouchers return through receipt and next-session messaging.
description.zh: 獎勵券透過收據與下次使用訊息返回旅程。

scope: Voucher availability and fully redeemed states

phase2.publicRule: Only label individual Phase 2 screens as shipped after production evidence is mapped.

sourceScope: Future Flash Product Deals and monetisation direction

dateEvidence.publicRule: Do not publish an exact launch period until the user confirms the final in-market dates.

title.en: Use a focused Voucher POC to move in-store customers into repeat e-commerce behaviour
title.zh: 以聚焦型優惠券前導驗證，將門市顧客帶入重複電商消費

customerSegments: Customers with no Online Grocery orders
Existing e-commerce customers needing higher order frequency
businessObjectives: Move customers from first order towards four or more orders
Create daily urgency and repeat visits without committing immediately to a full Flash Deal platform

publicCopyDraft.en: The proposal was modelled against roughly S$1.5M in GMV at about 15x ROI, with targets of around 7k new users and 11k customers progressing through the 1-4 order segment.
publicCopyDraft.zh: 此提案以約新台幣換算前的 150 萬新加坡元 GMV、約 15 倍 ROI 為商業模型，並設定約 7 千名新客及約 1.1 萬名顧客推進 1–4 次下單階段的目標。

claimBoundary: Always label these as proposal targets or modelled business case.
Do not present them as achieved outcomes.
Use approximate values only in public content.
Confirm that these targets are safe to disclose before publication.

entry: Segment-aware entry for new and existing customers
discoverAndCollect: Dedicated page for time-bound Flash Vouchers
shop: Direct link into e-commerce home or a Product Details Page
Post-Voucher-price visibility explored across the shopping journey
redeemAndReturn: Cart reminder to apply the Voucher
Return Voucher after qualifying orders to support the second, third and fourth order

systemLogic: Different Voucher treatment for zero-order and 1-3 order customers
Different handling for recent and lapsed zero-order customers
Stackability rules across CRM, Flash and Partnership Vouchers
Same-day collection and use proposed to create urgency
Service-fee-waiver and tiered cart-level rewards considered for different segments

publicSummary.en: The model treated acquisition and repeat-order customers differently, coordinating segment eligibility, stackability and reward return instead of exposing one campaign mechanic to everyone.
publicSummary.zh: 此模型依新客取得與重複下單階段提供不同處理，整合客群資格、疊加規則與回流獎勵，而不是讓所有顧客看到同一套活動機制。

segmentedMechanic.claimBoundary: Do not publish exact discount tiers, segment windows or stackability rules without explicit approval.

title.en: From a full Flash Deal platform to a staged Voucher POC
title.zh: 從完整限時優惠平台，到分階段優惠券前導驗證

whatIDecided.en: Split the opportunity into two phases: launch the targeted cart-level Flash Voucher journey first, then defer supplier-funded product deals and deeper SKU-level pricing controls until the product and technical foundations were ready.
whatIDecided.zh: 將機會拆成兩個階段：先上線分眾購物車層級的 Flash Voucher 旅程，再將供應商出資的商品優惠與更深入的商品層級定價控制延後至產品與技術基礎成熟後。

whyThisChoice.en: The team had a short POC timeline, while segmented pricing, inventory limits, customer-level redemption rules, post-discount pricing and personalised SKU surfacing required broader system changes.
whyThisChoice.zh: 團隊面臨較短的前導驗證時程，而分眾定價、庫存限制、顧客層級兌換規則、折後價格及個人化商品呈現都需要更廣泛的系統改動。

content.en: We accepted less SKU-level merchandising and pricing control in the first release to validate traffic and repeat-order behaviour sooner, while reducing dependency on a new rule engine and multiple product teams.
content.zh: 第一階段接受較少的商品層級陳列與定價控制，以更快驗證流量及重複下單行為，並降低對新規則引擎與多個產品團隊的依賴。

tradeOff.notChosen: Full supplier-funded Flash Product Deal platform
tradeOff.acceptedLoss: Less SKU-level pricing, inventory and merchandising control in the first release
tradeOff.protectedValue: Faster validation, lower delivery risk and clearer learning
tradeOff.constraint: Short timeline and cross-system technology dependencies

opportunities: Premium supplier listings and featured deal placements
Segmented pricing for new and existing customers
Future monetisation after traffic and habit formation were proven
futurePlatformDirection.publicRule: Present only as future platform direction, not as delivered scope.

principalThesis.en: Established a permanent Voucher discovery and claim system across entry, visual hierarchy and card states, then used product-architecture evidence to define the next model.

publicSummary.zh: 主導產品架構、原型方向、可用性測試統整與最終互動設計；上線範圍與產品路線圖則與產品經理、工程、商務及設計系統夥伴共同決定。

ledByMe.zh: 領取、查看與優惠券數量狀態

claim.en: The phase-one homepage entry, claimable count, Claim-to-View card state and red/green status system launched.

after.en: One place to understand and manage vouchers
after.zh: 使用者能在同一處理解並管理票券

supportingCopy.en: I brought voucher visibility, applicability, and key actions into one tested flow so users no longer had to piece together information across separate journeys.
supportingCopy.zh: 我將票券資訊、適用狀態與關鍵操作整合進同一個經過測試的流程，讓使用者不必再從不同旅程拼湊資訊。

title.zh: 從分散的活動型探索，到常設優惠券領取產品

atAGlance.en: Led product structure and interaction design for a 5-month Voucher Center, turning fragmented campaign discovery into a persistent claim surface. A 20-participant study shaped the first release and reusable Claim → View states.
atAGlance.zh: 主導為期 5 個月的 Voucher Center 產品架構與互動設計，將分散的活動型探索轉化為常設領取入口；20 位參與者研究塑造第一階段上線範圍與可重用的領取 → 查看狀態。

whyItMattered.en: Voucher discovery depended on campaign destinations and passive deposits, making claimable value easy to miss before shopping and forcing new programmes to rely on another campaign-specific entry point.
whyItMattered.zh: 優惠券探索仰賴活動目的地與被動存入，使可領取價值在購物前容易被忽略，也迫使新計畫再次依賴活動專屬入口。

businessImpact.en: Established a scalable entry, eligibility, and state model that supported multiple voucher campaigns without creating another disconnected customer journey.
businessImpact.zh: 建立可擴充的入口、資格與狀態模型，支援多種優惠券活動，不必持續新增彼此分離的使用旅程。

rationale.en: Uses eligibility, rewards and behavioural mechanics to influence participation or repeat behaviour.
rationale.zh: 透過資格、獎勵與行為機制影響參與或重複行為。

scope.en: Persistent Voucher discovery and access, from homepage entry to category access and explicit Claim → View states.
scope.zh: 常設優惠券探索與領取，涵蓋首頁入口、分類存取與明確的領取 → 查看狀態。

primary.zh: 探索並領取優惠券的顧客

criticalProblem.en: Voucher discovery depended on campaign destinations and passive deposits, making claimable value easy to miss before shopping and forcing new programmes to rely on another campaign-specific entry point.
criticalProblem.zh: 優惠券探索仰賴活動目的地與被動存入，使可領取價值在購物前容易被忽略，也迫使新計畫再次依賴活動專屬入口。

headline.en: Defined the reusable Claim → View state model and the launch boundary that separated shipped capability from research-supported next steps.
headline.zh: 定義可重用的領取 → 查看狀態模型與上線邊界，清楚區分已上線能力和研究支持的下一步。

supportingStatement.en: Kept Flash Voucher as in-market precursor evidence while preserving ~S$1.5M GMV and ~15× ROI strictly as proposal-era modelled targets.
supportingStatement.zh: 將 Flash Voucher 保持為市場前導證據，並嚴格把約 150 萬新幣 GMV 與約 15 倍 ROI 標示為提案階段的模型化目標。

title.en: Separate participation from application
title.zh: 將參與領取與購買套用分開

principle.en: Claiming creates ownership; application remains contextual to purchase.
principle.zh: 領取建立擁有狀態；套用仍保留在購買情境中。

whatIDecided.en: Defined Claim as the participation action and View as the post-claim state, creating a reusable Claim → View model while keeping Voucher application contextual to purchase.
whatIDecided.zh: 將「領取」定義為參與操作，將「查看」定義為領取後狀態，形成可重用的領取 → 查看模型；優惠券套用仍留在購買情境中。

whyThisChoice.en: 18 / 20 participants misunderstood “Use now” as an automatic later action, showing that one CTA could not truthfully represent both ownership and application.
whyThisChoice.zh: 18／20 位參與者誤解「立即使用」會在之後自動執行，顯示單一操作無法如實代表擁有與套用兩種狀態。

resultingModel.zh: 領取 → 查看狀態模型

effectOrResult.zh: 領取 → 查看狀態模型

title.en: Preserve the target architecture without blocking launch
title.zh: 不阻礙上線，同時保留目標架構

whatIDecided.en: Shipped the persistent entry, claimable count and Claim → View states within available launch capacity, while preserving consolidated navigation as the next product direction.
whatIDecided.zh: 在可用上線資源內交付常設入口、可領取數量與領取 → 查看狀態，同時將整合式導覽保留為下一階段產品方向。

whyThisChoice.en: Paid retail-media homepage placement had already been committed as the first priority, while Engineering capacity could not support the complete target architecture for launch.
whyThisChoice.zh: 付費零售媒體首頁版位已承諾並需維持第一順位；工程資源無法在上線時支援完整目標架構。

constraintManaged.en: Commercial homepage placement had to remain first priority, and Engineering capacity limited the first-release architecture.
constraintManaged.zh: 商業首頁版位必須維持第一順位，且工程資源限制第一階段可交付的架構。

content.en: We chose to ship within launch capacity, accepting lower entry prominence and some cross-page navigation to protect existing commercial commitments and avoid blocking launch on the complete architecture.
content.zh: 我們選擇在現實上線資源內交付，接受較低的入口醒目度與部分跨頁導覽，以保護既有商業承諾，並避免完整架構阻礙上線。

tradeOff.acceptedLoss: Lower entry prominence and some cross-page navigation
tradeOff.protectedValue: Existing commercial commitments and an unblocked launch
tradeOff.constraint: Committed paid retail-media homepage placement and limited Engineering capacity

preservedDirection.en: Consolidated navigation remained the target architecture for the next phase.
preservedDirection.zh: 整合式導覽仍保留為下一階段目標架構。

shippedOutcome: Count of Vouchers available to claim

effectOrResult.en: Consolidated navigation remained the target architecture for the next phase.
effectOrResult.zh: 整合式導覽仍保留為下一階段目標架構。

statusAndDisclosure.renderRule: Resolve only fields that exist; do not synthesize missing claims.

title.en: A campaign mechanic had to become a permanent product
title.zh: 活動機制必須轉化為常設產品

description.en: Flash Voucher proved a campaign-scoped journey could ship, but Voucher Center needed a stable entry and state model without copying the campaign experience unchanged.
description.zh: Flash Voucher 證明活動型旅程可以上線，但 Voucher Center 必須建立穩定入口與狀態模型，不能直接照搬活動體驗。

title.en: Action labels changed users’ expectations
title.zh: 操作文字會改變使用者預期

description.en: Participants interpreted Claim, View and Use now as different system outcomes, so wording and state transitions had to describe the real product behaviour precisely.
description.zh: 參與者會將領取、查看與立即使用理解為不同系統結果，因此文字與狀態轉換必須精準對應真實產品行為。

title.en: The preferred architecture could not ship in full
title.zh: 研究偏好的架構無法完整上線

description.en: Commercial placement and Engineering timing required a narrower first release than the consolidated model preferred in research.
description.zh: 商業版位與工程時程，使第一階段必須比研究偏好的整合模型更聚焦。

title.en: From a shipped precursor to a permanent product
title.zh: 從已上線前導，到常設產品

evidence.en: Validated that a targeted voucher journey, clear availability states and direct shopping actions could operate in production.
evidence.zh: 驗證聚焦的優惠券旅程、清楚的可用狀態與直接購物操作能在正式環境運作。

boundary.en: No verified performance metric is published, and the full Flash Voucher experience did not become Voucher Center unchanged.
boundary.zh: 未公開缺少驗證的成效數據；完整 Flash Voucher 體驗也未原樣成為 Voucher Center。

evidence.en: A 20-participant architecture study informed the shipped homepage entry, claimable count, red/green hierarchy and Claim → View card states.
evidence.zh: 20 位參與者的架構研究推動首頁入口、可領取數量、紅綠層級與領取 → 查看卡片狀態上線。

boundary.en: Claim all and the full consolidated architecture did not ship.
boundary.zh: 全部領取與完整整合架構未上線。

carryForward.en: Move from temporary campaign destinations to a persistent product entry.
carryForward.zh: 從暫時活動目的地，轉為常設產品入口。

carryForward.en: Make claimable value and post-claim state visible.
carryForward.zh: 讓可領取價值與領取後狀態清楚可見。

carryForward.en: Generalise selected behaviours instead of copying campaign screens.
carryForward.zh: 將特定行為一般化，而不是直接複製活動畫面。

evidence: Modelled GMV, cost, ROI and acquisition/progression targets
Customer journey and two-phase POC plan

sourceFiles.filename: JIRA_Voucher landing page for flash voucher to drive new customer acquisition for Ecomm(1).pages
evidence: Phase 1 landing page, save action, content update, tracking and direct-shopping deep links
Phase 2 redemption tracker and fully-redeemed / expiry states
Campaign entitlement persistence and new-customer eligibility

sourceFiles.filename: OMNI ticket_Voucher landing page for flash voucher to drive new customer acquisition for Ecomm(1).pages
evidence: Landing page, countdown and deep-link requirements
Success-criteria template contains no measured result

publicCopy.en: The POC was prioritised against a modelled business case of approximately S$1.5M GMV at about 15× ROI, with targets of around 7K new users and 11K customers progressing through the one-to-four-order segment.
publicCopy.zh: 此前導驗證以約 150 萬新幣 GMV、約 15 倍 ROI 的模型化商業案例作為優先排序依據，目標約為 7 千名新客，以及約 1.1 萬名顧客推進一至四筆訂單階段。

phase1: Campaign entitlement persistence handled by the parent Voucher / Offer ecosystem
confirmedDeliveryScope.screenLevelBoundary: Phase 2 source scope must not be labelled shipped without production-screen evidence.

metricBoundary.en: The three uploaded files provide a modelled business case and delivery scope, but no post-launch GMV, conversion, new-user or repeat-order result.
metricBoundary.zh: 三份上傳檔案提供模型化商業案例與交付範圍，但未提供上線後 GMV、轉換、新客或重複下單成果。

dateBoundary.publicRule: Do not publish an exact in-market period until the final launch window is confirmed.

ownershipBoundary.en: Voucher Center owns the persistent discovery-and-claim product. Wallet organisation, Search, filtering, Select all, applicability states and partner integration remain in the Voucher / Offer parent case.
ownershipBoundary.zh: Voucher Center 負責常設探索與領取產品；Wallet 整理、搜尋、篩選、全選、適用狀態與合作夥伴整合仍歸屬 Voucher／Offer 母案。
ownershipBoundary.publicProjectionRule: Render this boundary as ownership clarification only. Do not render parent-case evidence as Voucher Center capability.

confirmedShipped: Number of Vouchers available to claim

nextDirection.en: asked for Claim all without prompting
nextDirection.zh: 在未提示下主動提出全部領取

title.en: Turning product evolution into shared infrastructure
title.zh: 將產品演進轉化為共享基礎

thesis.en: A feature-specific evolution became a reusable shared capability.
thesis.zh: 將功能情境中的演進，轉化為可重用的共享能力。

title.en: Original white Voucher Card
title.zh: 原有白色優惠券卡片

content.en: The white Voucher Card already existed in the Design System before Voucher Center.
content.zh: 白色優惠券卡片在 Voucher Center 之前已存在於設計系統中。

title.en: Voucher Center state expression
title.zh: Voucher Center 狀態表達

content.en: I evolved the existing component with stronger visual differentiation, explicit Claim → View states and campaign / Voucher state expression.
content.zh: 我將既有元件演進為更清楚的視覺區分、明確的領取 → 查看狀態，以及活動／優惠券狀態表達。

title.en: Reusable Tangram component
title.zh: 可重用的 Tangram 元件

content.en: I persuaded the team to abstract the updated model into a reusable Tangram component for cross-product reuse.
content.zh: 我推動團隊將更新後的模型抽象成可重用的 Tangram 元件，支援跨產品使用。

ownership.en: I led the feature-specific evolution and influenced the team-level abstraction; I did not create the original Voucher Card system from scratch.
ownership.zh: 我主導功能情境中的元件演進，並推動團隊層級的抽象；原始優惠券卡片系統並非由我從零建立。

whatThisProves.en: Turning campaign-based discovery into a persistent claiming product through evidence-led release decisions.
whatThisProves.zh: 透過證據導向的上線決策，將活動型探索轉化為常設領取產品。

impactEvidence.recommendedHeadline: Research directly changed the first release: stronger entry, explicit Claim states and a preserved consolidated architecture.
impactEvidence.boundary: Research ratios are decision evidence, not business growth.

title.en: One live game to a scalable multi-game Game Center
title.zh: 從單一上線遊戲，到可擴展的多遊戲 Game Center

atAGlance.en: As primary product designer, I replaced a single live-game slot with a 0→1 Game Center for concurrent multi-game discovery; 70% of tracked mini-game players engaged with 2+ games in the reported after period.
atAGlance.zh: 作為主要產品設計師，我以支援並行多遊戲探索的 0→1 Game Center 取代單一上線遊戲位置；在報告的後期觀察期間，70% 受追蹤的小遊戲玩家參與了 2 個以上的遊戲。

rationale.en: Establishes a new product capability and operating model where no equivalent product previously existed.
rationale.zh: 建立先前不存在的新產品能力與運作模式。

scope.en: Multi-game discovery, game-state communication and configurable campaign presentation.
scope.zh: 涵蓋多遊戲探索、遊戲狀態溝通與可配置的活動呈現。

whyItMattered.en: A single live-game slot limited discovery, variety and the ability to run sponsor campaigns concurrently.
whyItMattered.zh: 單一上線遊戲位置限制探索、內容多樣性，以及多個贊助活動並行的能力。

businessImpact.en: Established a centralized discovery and configuration layer for presenting multiple active games through one reusable Game Center model.
businessImpact.zh: 建立中央探索與配置層，以一套可重用的 Game Center 模型呈現多個進行中的遊戲。

confidentialityNote.en: *Metrics are rounded or abstracted for confidentiality.*
confidentialityNote.zh: *基於保密考量，數據已進行四捨五入或抽象化處理。*

singleGameConstraint.en: The existing direct entry supported one game at a time, creating fatigue risk, limiting preference coverage and preventing concurrent sponsor campaigns.
singleGameConstraint.zh: 既有直接入口一次只支援一個遊戲，造成疲乏風險、無法涵蓋不同偏好，也限制多個贊助單位活動同時進行。

upperFunnel.conflict: A separate JIRA preview states 19% of active users were players.

signals: Only about 1,000 users clicked into mini games from the X4U / Explore surface.
Game awareness depended heavily on push notifications and EDM.
Only about 50% of mini-game users also used Scan@Door.
Only about 15% of Scan@Door users played mini games.

vision.en: Create a central Game Center where customers can discover multiple reward-earning experiences and parallel campaigns can be presented through one shared model.
vision.zh: 建立中央 Game Center，讓顧客探索多個獎勵體驗，並以一套共享模型呈現並行活動。

primary: CTR from Game Center to an activity
Number of games played per user

upperFunnelMindsets: Recovery after failing to earn a reward
Continuous success after order or payment completion

phase1_1.name: Concurrent mini-games foundation
scope: Up to four games in the first rollout
Login prompt when a logged-out user starts a game
Support for single-play and repeatable games
Reuse of existing game-play and reward-result flows
Rewarded Voucher placed first in the Voucher swimlane
Existing deeplink, start date, provider URL, campaign ID and daily limit retained
knownLimitations: Repeat taps could return users to the reward-result page
No multi-category structure in the first rollout

phase1_2.name: Lifecycle communication and resilient game-card states
finalAgreedScope: Cooldown timer showing when a single-play game becomes available again
Sort completed single-play games to the bottom of the list
Return a game to the active state when it becomes playable again
No completed state for immediately repeatable games
Reward-result continuity with View Voucher and Shop Now actions
Reward Voucher returned to the first card in the Voucher swimlane
Responsive behaviour across supported screen widths
explicitlyParkedOrRemovedFromThisScope: 2x2 card layout - parked as a separate continuous-improvement item
Category title - removed because only one category existed
notConfirmedInFinalDeploymentScope: Long-term reward variants such as Linkpoints and Lucky Draw

publicBoundary.en: Design, alignment and Engineering development were completed; deployment was planned for early 2026, but final production release is not confirmed.
publicBoundary.zh: 設計、對齊與工程團隊 development 均已完成，原定於 2026 年初部署，但目前尚未確認最終正式環境上線。

scope: Integration of challenges and lucky draws

title.en: From a single direct entry to a central multi-game hub
title.zh: 從單一直接入口，到中央多遊戲中心

whatIDecided.en: Replace the single-game entry with a dedicated listing page that could expose multiple active games and preserve each game's existing play flow.
whatIDecided.zh: 以專屬列表頁取代單一遊戲入口，讓多個進行中的遊戲可同時被探索，並保留各遊戲既有的遊玩流程。

whyThisChoice.en: One featured game could not serve different preferences or multiple sponsors, and changing the featured game caused customers to miss other opportunities.
whyThisChoice.zh: 單一主打遊戲無法同時服務不同偏好與多個贊助單位；替換主打遊戲也會讓顧客錯過其他機會。

title.en: From a broad gamification vision to a focused concurrent-games release
title.zh: 從廣泛遊戲化願景，到聚焦多遊戲並行的首版

whatIDecided.en: Prioritised multi-game hosting and configurable listing content, while reusing existing gameplay and reward-result flows for the first release.
whatIDecided.zh: 首版優先交付多遊戲承載與可配置的列表內容，同時沿用既有遊玩與獎勵結果流程。

whyThisChoice.en: Concurrent hosting was the immediate customer and sponsor bottleneck; completion tracking, reward history, filters and richer categorisation would add dependencies without solving that core constraint.
whyThisChoice.zh: 並行承載是當下最直接的顧客與贊助單位瓶頸；完成追蹤、獎勵歷史紀錄、篩選與更多分類會增加依賴，卻不直接解決核心限制。

content.en: We accepted one category, no completion state and limited game metadata in exchange for launching concurrent game discovery quickly and preserving existing game integrations.
content.zh: 我們接受單一分類、沒有完成狀態與較少的遊戲中繼資料，以換取更快上線多遊戲探索，並保留既有遊戲整合。

title.en: From a fixed game tile to an operator-configured listing
title.zh: 從固定遊戲卡片，到由營運團隊配置列表

whatIDecided.en: Extended the existing back office with game image, description and visibility controls while retaining existing campaign and deep-link fields.
whatIDecided.zh: 在既有後台加入遊戲圖片、說明與顯示控制，同時保留活動與深層連結欄位。

whyThisChoice.en: Running several games in parallel required Operations to control what appeared in the listing without a new front-end release for every campaign change.
whyThisChoice.zh: 多個遊戲平行執行時，營運團隊必須能控制列表顯示內容，而不需每次活動改動都重新發布前端。

title.en: From identical game cards to lifecycle-aware states
title.zh: 從狀態相同的遊戲卡片，到理解遊戲生命週期的狀態

whatIDecided.en: Defined distinct active, expiring, completed, cooldown, empty, loading and failure states, with different behaviour for single-play and immediately repeatable games.
whatIDecided.zh: 定義進行中、即將到期、已完成、冷卻中、空白、載入中與失敗狀態，並為單次遊玩與可立即重玩的遊戲設定不同邏輯。

whyThisChoice.en: The first release could not explain whether a game was still playable, already completed or temporarily unavailable. Single-play games needed recovery timing and reward access, while repeatable games needed to remain immediately actionable.
whyThisChoice.zh: 首版無法清楚說明遊戲是否仍可玩、已完成或暫時不可用；單次遊玩遊戲需要恢復時間與獎勵存取，而可重複遊戲則必須維持立即可操作。

title.en: From adding more layout density to clarifying urgency within the existing list
title.zh: 從增加版面密度，到在既有列表中強化急迫性

whatIDecided.en: Kept the full-width list for the Phase 1.2 delivery, removed an unnecessary category heading and moved expiry information into prominent card-level states; the proposed 2x2 layout was separated into another improvement initiative.
whatIDecided.zh: 第 1.2 階段維持全寬列表，移除不必要的分類標題，並將到期資訊提升為明顯的卡片狀態；2×2 版面則拆分為另一項改善。

whyThisChoice.en: Scroll analysis showed a visibility gap for lower-positioned games, while the active product still had only one category. The agreed release focused on clearer game status and urgency without mixing in a separate layout redesign.
whyThisChoice.zh: 捲動分析顯示較後方遊戲存在可見性落差，而產品當時仍只有一個分類；本次交付聚焦於更清楚的遊戲狀態與急迫性，不混入另一套版面改版。

headline.en: Game discovery could not scale while each mini-game behaved like a standalone destination.
headline.zh: 當每個小遊戲仍像獨立目的地運作時，遊戲探索就無法擴展。

supportingCopy.en: The product needed a shared discovery and configuration layer so multiple games could coexist, communicate availability clearly and support parallel campaign operations without redesigning the experience each time.
supportingCopy.zh: 產品需要共享的探索與配置層，讓多個遊戲得以共存、清楚傳達可玩狀態，並支援並行活動營運，而不必每次重新設計體驗。

title.en: Evidence that shaped the decisions
title.zh: 塑造設計決策的證據

heading.en: Before → after: one direct game became a multi-game listing
heading.zh: 前後轉變：從單一直接遊戲到多遊戲列表

summary.en: The performance report documents the product change from one featured game to a listing where customers could discover several mini games through one destination.
summary.zh: 績效報告記錄了產品從單一主打遊戲轉變為多遊戲列表，讓顧客可透過同一目的地探索多個小遊戲。

heading.en: Discovery required explicit game categories and availability states
heading.zh: 探索需要明確的遊戲分類與可玩狀態

summary.en: The PRD defines simultaneous games, limited-time and evergreen grouping, New and Ending Soon tags, once-per-day labels and next-available-play timing.
summary.zh: PRD 定義了多遊戲並行、限時與常駐分類、New 與 Ending Soon 標籤、每日一次提示，以及下次可玩時間。

heading.en: Concurrent campaigns required configurable presentation
heading.zh: 並行活動需要可配置的呈現方式

summary.en: The PRD and concurrent-mini-games JIRA establish the need to host several games together and give Platform Operations control over listing order and campaign presentation.
summary.zh: PRD 與並行小遊戲 JIRA 證明，系統需要同時承載多個遊戲，並讓平台營運團隊控制列表順序與活動呈現。

heading.en: The reported after period showed broader multi-game engagement
heading.zh: 報告後期顯示更廣泛的多遊戲參與

summary.en: Across the reported after period, 70% of tracked mini-game players engaged with 2+ mini games and Gamification MAU / MAU was reported at 23%.

game-center.transformation: From one live game to a scalable multi-game Game Center
game-center.at_glance: As primary product designer, I replaced a single live-game slot with a 0→1 Game Center for concurrent multi-game discovery; 70% of tracked mini-game players engaged with 2+ games in the reported after period.
game-center.at_glance_zh: 作為主要產品設計師，我以支援並行多遊戲探索的 0→1 Game Center 取代單一上線遊戲位置；在報告的後期觀察期間，70% 受追蹤的小遊戲玩家參與了 2 個以上的遊戲。
game-center.why: A single live-game slot limited discovery, variety and the ability to run sponsor campaigns concurrently.
game-center.why_zh: 單一上線遊戲位置限制探索、內容多樣性，以及多個贊助活動並行的能力。
game-center.impact: Established a centralized discovery and configuration layer for presenting multiple active games through one reusable Game Center model.
game-center.impact_zh: 建立中央探索與配置層，以一套可重用的 Game Center 模型呈現多個進行中的遊戲。

criticalProblem.en: A single-game entry point constrained customer choice, game visibility and the ability to present concurrent campaigns.
criticalProblem.zh: 單一遊戲入口限制顧客選擇、遊戲可見性與並行活動呈現能力。

headline.en: I designed the 0→1 Game Center that moved discovery from one live game to a centralized multi-game model.
headline.zh: 我設計了 0→1 Game Center，將探索方式從單一上線遊戲轉為中央多遊戲模型。

supportingStatement.en: The shared listing, categorisation and state model let multiple games coexist while keeping discovery understandable for customers and presentation configurable for operations.
supportingStatement.zh: 共享列表、分類與狀態模型讓多個遊戲得以共存，同時維持顧客易懂的探索方式與營運可配置的呈現。

metricBoundary.en: Performance metrics are presented only in Outcomes and retain their reported-period labels.
metricBoundary.zh: 績效數據僅於成果區呈現，並保留報告期間標示。

title.en: From single-game entry to centralized multi-game discovery
title.zh: 從單一遊戲入口，到中央多遊戲探索

whatIDecided.en: Created one Game Center that surfaces multiple active reward-earning experiences.
whatIDecided.zh: 建立一個 Game Center，呈現多個進行中的獎勵遊戲體驗。

whyThisChoice.en: Single-game entry limited relevance, variety and the ability to support parallel campaigns.
whyThisChoice.zh: 單一遊戲入口限制相關性、內容多樣性與並行活動承載能力。

content.en: Multiple simultaneous games, limited-time and evergreen grouping, logged-in and logged-out discovery, and login gating when a user enters or starts a game.
content.zh: 支援多遊戲同時呈現、限時與常駐分類、登入與未登入探索，以及進入或開始遊戲時的登入門檻。

outcome.en: A reusable multi-game discovery model.
outcome.zh: 一套可重用的多遊戲探索模型。

title.en: From undifferentiated games to explicit availability and play states
title.zh: 從無差異的遊戲卡片，到明確的可玩與遊玩狀態

whatIDecided.en: Exposed meaningful status and timing signals for each game.
whatIDecided.zh: 為每個遊戲呈現具意義的狀態與時間訊號。

whyThisChoice.en: Once multiple games coexist, customers need to understand what is new, urgent, available and replayable.
whyThisChoice.zh: 當多個遊戲共存時，顧客需要理解哪些是新推出、即將結束、目前可玩或可再次遊玩。

content.en: New and Ending Soon tags, Play Once Per Day communication, next-available-play timing and availability periods where supported.
content.zh: New 與 Ending Soon 標籤、每日一次遊玩提示、下次可玩時間，以及支援時顯示可玩期間。

outcome.en: A consistent game-state communication model.
outcome.zh: 一套一致的遊戲狀態溝通模型。

title.en: From fixed game placement to configurable campaign operations
title.zh: 從固定遊戲位置，到可配置的活動營運

whatIDecided.en: Defined operational control over which games are shown and how they are ordered.
whatIDecided.zh: 定義營運團隊控制顯示哪些遊戲及其排序的方式。

whyThisChoice.en: Multiple sponsors and longer-running campaigns required presentation flexibility without redesigning the customer experience for every campaign.
whyThisChoice.zh: 多個贊助單位與較長週期活動需要彈性呈現，而不必為每次活動重新設計顧客體驗。

content.en: Backoffice-configurable display order, multiple concurrent games and support for different campaign timings and durations.
content.zh: 後台可配置顯示順序、多遊戲並行，以及支援不同活動時程與期間。

outcome.en: A scalable operational model for concurrent game presentation.
outcome.zh: 一套可擴展的並行遊戲呈現營運模型。

title.en: Multiple games introduced state, timing and relevance complexity

title.en: Customer discovery and operator control had to work as one system
title.zh: 顧客探索與營運控制必須成為同一套系統

description.en: Platform Operations needed configurable ordering and presentation while customers needed one clear way to discover several active games.

whatThisProves.en: Designing a scalable discovery and operational model for multiple concurrent game experiences in a 0→1 product.
whatThisProves.zh: 在 0→1 產品中，為多個並行遊戲體驗設計可擴展的探索與營運模型。

supportingStatement.zh: 我釐清案件脈絡、責任、交接與決策權，將不完整報表與人工協調，轉成更可追蹤的營運模式。
