dbs.transformation_zh: 從分散的例外處理，到六個市場共用的授信決策系統
dbs.transformation: From fragmented exception handling to a shared six-market decision system
dbs.at_glance: Led end-to-end design of a credit-exception operating system, replacing fragmented report-driven workflows with role-based case management and a shared decision model launched across six markets.
dbs.at_glance_zh: 主導授信例外案件管理系統的問題定義與端到端設計，將不完整報表與人工協調轉化為可直接決策的案件，並為六個市場、四種角色建立明確權責。
dbs.scope: End-to-end exception handling across monitoring, review, delegated approval and case closure
dbs.scope_zh: 端到端例外分流、案件審查、決策脈絡、責任、核准與下一步行動
dbs.audience:
Primary: CCU, RM, CRM
Secondary: Operations
dbs.audience_zh:
主要：CCU、RM、CRM
次要：營運團隊
dbs.why: Daily credit exceptions depended on incomplete reports, email histories, manual authority checks, and local workarounds, making decisions slow, inconsistent, and difficult to trace.
dbs.why_zh: 每日授信例外案件依賴不完整報表、電子郵件紀錄、人工權限查核與各市場自行補救，使決策緩慢、不一致且難以追溯。
dbs.impact: Established a shared, traceable operating model for exception review, decision history, and monitoring across six regulated markets.
dbs.impact_zh: 為六個受監管市場建立共享且可追溯的例外審查、決策紀錄與監控模式。

title.en: Two fundamentally different operating modes
title.zh: 角色需求衝突

description.en: End-of-day monitoring and real-time exceptions had different triggers, urgency, evidence needs and response expectations, so they could not be treated as one workflow.
description.zh: CCU、RM、CRM 與營運團隊在同一流程中需要不同脈絡、責任、核准與下一步。

title.en: Fragmented operational context
title.zh: 跨市場差異

description.en: Exception handling relied on offline reports, manual filtering and incomplete approval history, forcing teams to reconstruct case context before acting.
description.zh: 六個市場具有不同營運方式，仍需要共用同一套例外審查與決策模型。

title.en: Decisions crossed roles, authority levels and markets
title.zh: 可追溯但不能拖慢

description.en: RM, CRM, CCU and Operations each owned different parts of the case, while decisions still needed clear authority routing, traceability and consistency across six regulated markets.
description.zh: 受監管的內部營運必須保留決策稽核性，同時不能增加日常案件處理阻力。

intervention.en: Role-based case queues and explicit decision ownership
intervention.zh: 依角色分流案件並明確決策責任

after.en: A shared cross-role workflow adopted across six markets
after.zh: 六個市場使用共同案件管理流程

supportingCopy.en: I defined how case context, ownership, handoffs and decision rights should work together, then translated that model into role-based queues, workbenches and one traceable cross-role workflow.
supportingCopy.zh: 我釐清四種角色如何接收、審查、決策與追蹤例外案件，建立可供六個受監管市場共同採用的流程。

cardTitle.en: Creating one credit-decision system across six markets
cardTitle.zh: 建立六市場共用的授信決策系統

criticalProblem.en: Daily credit exceptions depended on incomplete reports, email histories, manual authority checks, and local workarounds, making decisions slow, inconsistent, and difficult to trace.
criticalProblem.zh: 每日授信例外案件依賴不完整報表、電子郵件紀錄、人工權限查核與各市場自行補救，使決策緩慢、不一致且難以追溯。

title.en: From one exception concept to distinct end-of-day and real-time operating models

whatIDecided.en: Separated end-of-day monitoring and real-time exception handling into two operating models, each with its own triggers, urgency, actors and evidence needs.

whyThisChoice.en: End-of-day work centred on report quality, filtering and follow-up. Real-time work required immediate trigger interpretation, authority routing and customer-response decisions.

outcome.en: Two cross-market journeys established the operating logic and priority pain points for each mode.

whatThisRequired.en: Mapped separate cross-market journeys, clarified the actors and evidence needs in each mode, and aligned the product structure to reflect those distinct operating paths.

title.en: From report-centric work to role-based exception queues

whatIDecided.en: Structured CRM and CCU workbenches around prioritised case queues, borrower and facility context, supporting documents, delegated authority, actions and decision history.

whyThisChoice.en: Manual filtering and fragmented case information forced each role to reconstruct the situation before making or escalating a decision.

outcome.en: Role-based workbenches gave teams a consistent way to review, act on and track exception cases across the operating flow.

whatThisRequired.en: Defined role-based workbench structures, case hierarchy, action patterns and status visibility so the same case could be understood and progressed consistently.

title.en: From departmental handoffs to one traceable decision architecture

whatIDecided.en: Mapped one cross-role workflow connecting exception triggers, RM, CRM, CCU and Operations through review, delegated approval, refer-back, rejection and closure.

whyThisChoice.en: Each function saw only part of the case. Delivery teams needed one shared model for ownership, decision rights, evidence requirements and next actions.

outcome.en: The cross-role architecture became the shared implementation reference connecting product behaviour with operational decision ownership.

whatThisRequired.en: Aligned cross-role workflow states, ownership boundaries, escalation logic and implementation references so Product, Engineering and operational teams worked from one shared model.

statusAndDisclosure.renderRule: Resolve only fields that exist; do not synthesize missing claims.

whatThisProves.en: Standardising multi-market operations through shared decision states, ownership and escalation rules.
whatThisProves.zh: 透過共享決策狀態、責任與升級規則，標準化多市場營運流程。

impactEvidence.recommendedHeadline: Standardised one excess-management operating model across 6 markets, aligning shared decision states, ownership and escalation.
impactEvidence.boundary: Do not invent efficiency or turnaround uplift.

caption.en: End-of-day operating journey mapped across report generation, monitoring, approvals and follow-up, with cross-market pain points layered onto each stage.
The reporting experience moved from manually monitored spreadsheets to a centralised exception workspace that surfaced case status, trends and decision context in one place.
The proposed operating architecture connected data triggers, CCU, RM, CRM and Operations through one shared approval and follow-up model.

headline.en: Connected immediate conversion optimisation with a longer-term model for reusing trip context across Booking.com’s transport journey.
headline.zh: 將短期轉換優化與長期旅程脈絡重用模型串接，建立 Booking.com 交通預訂的共同方向。

supportingStatement.en: Led the research roadmap, evidence synthesis, interaction model, rapid validation and post-launch learning loop.
supportingStatement.zh: 主導研究路線圖、證據統整、互動模型、快速驗證與上線後學習循環。

title.zh: 同步推進交付與策略

copy.en: Immediate experience optimisation and future transport integration were developed as two connected tracks.
copy.zh: 即時體驗優化與未來交通整合以兩條相互連結的路線同步推進。

title.en: Align decisions through critique
title.zh: 透過設計評圖對齊決策

copy.en: Recurring critique connected research, product constraints and cross-functional implementation decisions.
copy.zh: 持續設計評圖串接研究、產品限制與跨職能實作決策。

principalThesis.en: Delivered a globally consistent experience across more than 40 countries while navigating language, colour and market constraints.
principalThesis.zh: 在處理語言、色彩與市場限制的同時，為四十多個國家交付一致的全球體驗。

principalSignalsConfirmed: Conversion growth across desktop, mobile and tablet
Approximately 150 additional rides per day after launch
Connected Accommodation, Flight and Taxi context
Evidence-led option comparison and pickup guidance

title.en: Connecting the global taxi-booking journey
title.zh: 串連全球計程車預訂旅程

atAGlance.en: Led research, system framing and iterative design for Booking.com’s connected taxi journey, reusing trip context and simplifying decisions across 40+ countries to increase conversion and add about 150 rides per day.
atAGlance.zh: 主導 Booking.com 串連計程車旅程的研究、系統定義與迭代設計，重用旅程脈絡並簡化決策，於 40 多個國家提升轉換，平均每天增加約 150 趟行程。

scope.en: Connected accommodation, flight and taxi booking journey
scope.zh: 串連住宿、航班與計程車的預訂旅程

primary.en: Travellers booking airport and city transport
primary.zh: 預訂機場與城市交通的旅客

zh: 產品、工程、數據與研究團隊

measurementPeriod.en: Conversion measured within two weeks of launch
measurementPeriod.zh: 轉換成效於上線後兩週內衡量

whyItMattered.en: Taxi booking sat outside accommodation and flight journeys, forcing travellers to compare unclear options, re-enter known trip details, and interpret market-specific pickup rules without enough context.
whyItMattered.zh: 計程車預訂與住宿、航班旅程彼此分離，使旅客必須比較不清楚的選項、重複輸入已知行程資料，並在脈絡不足下理解各市場的接送規則。

businessImpact.en: Established a cross-vertical trip-context model that allowed transport booking to reuse known itinerary and passenger data instead of operating as an isolated add-on.
businessImpact.zh: 建立跨產品線旅程脈絡模型，讓交通預訂能重用已知行程與乘客資料，而不是作為孤立附加功能。

strengths: Approximate device-level conversion lift within two weeks
Research, analytics, rapid validation and design-system integration
remainingGaps: Definition of the historical device-level conversion figures
Exact relationship between device conversion movement and additional rides per day
Formal historical title if it must be displayed
Shipment status of individual supplier-dependent pre-pickup extensions

executiveSummary.problem: Customers could not quickly compare taxi types, repeated information already held by Booking.com and received generic pickup guidance that did not fit global airport variation.
executiveSummary.strategy: Run current-flow optimisation and future transport integration in parallel, then merge validated hypotheses into the main roadmap.
executiveSummary.outcome: The one-page experience added approximately 150 rides per day within the first two weeks, while the team continued post-launch optimisation.

primaryDecisions.title: From one suggested taxi to scanable option comparison
primaryDecisions.title_zh: 從單一建議計程車，到可快速掃描的選項比較
primaryDecisions.whatIDecided: Tested a focused single recommendation against a horizontal option model, then selected the comparison approach and simplified card hierarchy, repetitive selling points, default selection and sorting logic.
primaryDecisions.whatIDecided_zh: 測試聚焦式單一建議與橫向選項模型後，選擇比較方案，並簡化卡片層級、重複賣點、預設選擇與排序邏輯。
primaryDecisions.whyThisChoice: Travellers needed to understand available choices at a glance and compare price, capacity and value before committing.
primaryDecisions.whyThisChoice_zh: 旅客需要一眼理解可用選項，並在確認前比較價格、乘載量與價值。

optionalBlock.content: We accepted greater on-screen density instead of a tightly focused recommendation in exchange for faster cross-option comparison and less hidden choice.
optionalBlock.content_zh: 我們接受較高的畫面資訊密度，而非高度聚焦的單一建議，以換取更快的跨選項比較與更少被隱藏的選擇。

primaryDecisions.outcome: Established a faster comparison model grounded in observed ride behaviour, with Standard taxis representing about two-thirds of analysed bookings and the redesigned journey contributing to conversion improvement across devices.
primaryDecisions.outcome_zh: 建立以實際行程行為為依據的快速比較模型；Standard taxi 約佔分析預訂的三分之二，而重新設計的旅程也共同促成各裝置的轉換改善。
supportingEvidence: The comparison model prioritised decision-critical information rather than presenting every vehicle attribute equally.
Default behaviour was grounded in observed booking patterns across approximately 944K analysed rides.

ownership.en: Led the comparison model, hierarchy and interaction design; ordering and release logic were aligned with product, data and engineering.
ownership.zh: 主導比較模型、層級與互動設計；排序與上線邏輯則與產品、數據及工程團隊對齊。

primaryDecisions.title: From repeated form entry to connected itinerary confirmation
primaryDecisions.title_zh: 從重複填寫表單，到串連旅程資訊的確認流程
primaryDecisions.whatIDecided: Reused accommodation, flight, passenger and taxi context so signed-in travellers could confirm known journey information instead of recreating it.
primaryDecisions.whatIDecided_zh: 重用住宿、航班、乘客與計程車脈絡，讓已登入旅客確認已知旅程資訊，而不必重新建立資料。
primaryDecisions.whyThisChoice: Accommodation, Flight and Taxi were organisationally separate, but customers experienced them as one continuous trip.
primaryDecisions.whyThisChoice_zh: 住宿、航班與計程車在組織內彼此分立，但顧客經歷的是一段連續旅程。

optionalBlock.content: Accommodation, Flight and Taxi teams had to align on which trusted itinerary and passenger data could carry forward, and where customers still needed explicit confirmation or edit control.
optionalBlock.content_zh: 住宿、航班與計程車團隊必須對齊哪些可信的行程與乘客資料可沿用，以及顧客在哪些環節仍需明確確認或修改。

primaryDecisions.outcome: Reduced avoidable re-entry and connected taxi booking more closely to the wider trip, contributing to a shorter booking path and measurable post-launch growth.
primaryDecisions.outcome_zh: 減少可避免的重複輸入，使計程車預訂更緊密連結整體旅程，並共同促成更短的預訂路徑與可衡量的上線後成長。
supportingEvidence: Trusted itinerary and passenger context carried forward only where explicit confirmation and edit control remained available.
primaryDecisions.evidence: Flight-related findings were brought into weekly cross-vertical design sessions for alignment, brainstorming and critique.

ownership.en: Led the UX model for reusing trip data; data availability and cross-vertical integration were co-decided with adjacent product teams.
ownership.zh: 主導旅程資料重用的使用者體驗模型；資料可用性與跨產品整合則與相鄰產品團隊共同決定。

primaryDecisions.title: From universal pickup promises to context-aware guidance
primaryDecisions.title_zh: 從通用接送承諾，到具情境的接送指引
primaryDecisions.whatIDecided: Prioritised pickup information supported by Customer Service and behavioural evidence, translated baggage capacity into traveller-native language, and staged higher-cost market-specific guidance rather than forcing one universal promise.
primaryDecisions.whatIDecided_zh: 優先處理由客服與行為證據支持的接送資訊，將行李容量轉譯為旅客熟悉的語言，並分階段處理成本較高的市場特定引導，而非強套單一通用承諾。
primaryDecisions.whyThisChoice: Airport layout, traffic, supplier dispatch and parking regulations made one universal pickup or waiting-time promise unreliable across markets.
primaryDecisions.whyThisChoice_zh: 機場動線、交通、供應商派車與停車規定，使單一接送或等候時間承諾無法可靠套用於各市場。

optionalBlock.content: We accepted less personalised timing in the first step rather than introducing false precision, while providing clearer precautions and access to support until supplier-specific logic became feasible.
optionalBlock.content_zh: 第一階段接受較不個人化的時間資訊，而非導入錯誤精準度；在供應商特定邏輯可行前，以更清楚的注意事項與客服管道補足。

primaryDecisions.outcome: Created a clearer framework for handling pickup uncertainty across markets and helped expose Spain as the main outlier requiring deeper behavioural investigation.
primaryDecisions.outcome_zh: 建立更清楚的跨市場接送不確定性處理框架，並辨識西班牙為需要進一步行為調查的主要離群市場。
supportingEvidence: The direction translated operational and supplier constraints into customer-facing language while separating globally reusable guidance from market-specific exceptions.

ownership.en: Led the evidence synthesis and staged guidance direction; supplier-specific feasibility and rollout were shared product and operational decisions.
ownership.zh: 主導證據統整與分階段引導方向；供應商特定可行性與推行則為共同的產品與營運決策。

postLaunchMeasurement: Google Analytics event and conversion tracking

title.en: A two-horizon roadmap connected immediate conversion work with future transport strategy
title.zh: 以雙軌產品路線圖連結短期轉換改善與未來交通策略

horizon1.label: MAIN ROADMAP
horizon1.focus: Optimise the April 2019 experience through hierarchy review, drop-off analysis, Customer Service tickets, Hotjar, UserTesting and sprint delivery.

horizon2.label: EXPERIMENT ROADMAP
horizon2.focus: Explore how transport could integrate with accommodation and other Booking.com verticals through market and user research.

strategyModel.transition: After the high-level strategy was validated with cross-channel stakeholders, the hypotheses were merged into the main roadmap.

continuousEvidenceLoop.claimBoundary: Do not claim formal accessibility certification. These are documented accessibility design considerations.

title.en: Outcomes
title.zh: 成果

statement.en: The redesign improved conversion across devices while making the taxi journey easier to compare, confirm and act on across markets.
statement.zh: 重新設計後，各裝置的轉換表現皆獲改善，也讓旅客在不同市場中更容易比較、確認並採取下一步。

evidenceNote.en: Approximate reported increase within the initial two-week measurement window.
evidenceNote.zh: 上線後初期兩週衡量期間的約略回報增幅。

evidenceNote.en: Approximate reported increase within the initial two-week measurement window.
evidenceNote.zh: 上線後初期兩週衡量期間的約略回報增幅。

evidenceNote.en: Approximate reported increase within the initial two-week measurement window.
evidenceNote.zh: 上線後初期兩週衡量期間的約略回報增幅。

label.en: additional rides per day after launch

evidenceNote.en: Approximate additional daily rides observed during the initial post-launch measurement period.
evidenceNote.zh: 上線後初期衡量期間觀察到的約略每日新增行程。

text.en: 6 of 7 analysed markets improved, with an unweighted average reported uplift of about ~6%; Spain was the clear outlier and became the focus for follow-up investigation.
text.zh: 七個分析市場中有六個改善，未加權平均回報增幅約為 ~6%；西班牙是明顯離群市場，並成為後續調查焦點。

text.en: Spain was the only analysed market to decline. Behavioural review surfaced unresolved location, field-entry and pickup-information friction, giving the team a concrete follow-up direction.
text.zh: 西班牙是唯一衰退的分析市場。行為檢視揭示尚未解決的地點、欄位輸入與接送資訊摩擦，為團隊提供具體的後續方向。

text.en: Conversion improved, while a higher cancellation rate exposed the next optimisation problem around prefilled-field communication and pickup clarity.
text.zh: 轉換獲得改善，但較高的取消率也揭示下一個優化問題：預填欄位溝通與接送資訊清晰度。

closingStatement.en: The work also established a clearer model for reusing trip context and adapting pickup guidance across a service operating in 40+ countries.
closingStatement.zh: 這項工作也為服務於 40 多個國家的產品，建立更清楚的旅程脈絡重用與接送引導調整模型。

storyStructure: Leadership expected both conversion growth and a connected trip
Research and data exposed comparison, repetition and sorting problems
Rapid validation shaped taxi-card hierarchy, defaults and sorting
Connected Booking.com trip data reduced repeated entry
Pre-pickup concepts addressed luggage and airport uncertainty
A/B tests and event tracking prioritised the next iterations
Accessibility work included VoiceOver sequence and AA-oriented checks
interviewDeckEvidence.publicUse: Use selected redrawn evidence, not the full interview deck.

title.en: Connecting the global taxi-booking journey
title.zh: 串連全球計程車預訂旅程

atAGlance.en: Led research, system framing and iterative design for Booking.com’s connected taxi journey, reusing trip context and simplifying decisions across 40+ countries to increase conversion and add about 150 rides per day.
atAGlance.zh: 主導 Booking.com 串連計程車旅程的研究、系統定義與迭代設計，重用旅程脈絡並簡化決策，於 40 多個國家提升轉換，平均每天增加約 150 趟行程。

scope.en: Connected accommodation, flight and taxi booking journey
scope.zh: 串連住宿、航班與計程車的預訂旅程

audience.en:
Primary: Travellers
Secondary: Taxi suppliers, Accommodation and Flight teams, Product, Engineering, Data and Research
audience.zh:
主要：旅客
次要：計程車供應商、住宿與航班團隊、產品、工程、數據與研究團隊

headline.en: The booking journey became clearer when known trip context and market-specific pickup guidance worked as one system.
headline.zh: 當已知旅程脈絡與市場特定接送引導形成同一套系統，預訂旅程才真正清楚。

supportingCopy.en: Customers should not rebuild information Booking.com already knows. Reusing itinerary and passenger data reduced effort, while airport-native language and staged guidance handled uncertainty without false precision.
supportingCopy.zh: 顧客不應重新輸入 Booking.com 已知的資訊。重用行程與乘客資料可降低操作負擔；以機場熟悉用語與分階段引導處理不確定性，則能避免錯誤精準度。

title.en: Design beyond the transaction
title.zh: 設計延伸至交易之外

copy.en: The journey curve exposed uncertainty before pickup and after booking, not only inside checkout.
copy.zh: 旅程曲線揭示不確定性存在於接送前與預訂後，而不只是在結帳流程內。

title.en: Evidence that shaped the decisions
title.zh: 影響設計決策的證據

title.en: Synthesize booking criteria across teams
title.zh: 跨團隊統整預訂準則

copy.en: Workshop synthesis connected customer needs, product constraints and implementation criteria.
copy.zh: 工作坊統整串接顧客需求、產品限制與實作準則。

booking.transformation_zh: 串連全球計程車預訂旅程
booking.at_glance: Led research, system framing and iterative design for Booking.com’s connected taxi journey, reusing trip context and simplifying decisions across 40+ countries to increase conversion and add about 150 rides per day.
booking.at_glance_zh: 主導 Booking.com 串連計程車旅程的研究、系統定義與迭代設計，重用旅程脈絡並簡化決策，於 40 多個國家提升轉換，平均每天增加約 150 趟行程。
booking.scope: Cross-market readiness across language, content, colour, interaction, and governed exceptions
booking.scope_zh: 跨市場的語言、內容、色彩、互動與受治理例外準備度
booking.audience:
Primary: Travellers
Secondary: Localisation, product, engineering, and market teams
booking.audience_zh:
主要：旅客
次要：在地化、產品、工程與市場團隊
booking.why: Taxi booking sat outside accommodation and flight journeys, forcing travellers to compare unclear options, re-enter known trip details, and interpret market-specific pickup rules without enough context.
booking.why_zh: 計程車預訂與住宿、航班旅程彼此分離，使旅客必須比較不清楚的選項、重複輸入已知行程資料，並在脈絡不足下理解各市場的接送規則。
booking.impact: Established a repeatable research, experimentation, and measurement loop for global booking optimisation after launch.
booking.impact_zh: 建立可重複的研究、實驗與衡量循環，支援全球預訂體驗在上線後持續優化。

intro.en: The work had to improve conversion without treating a globally variable transport journey as one uniform checkout.
intro.zh: 這項工作必須提升轉換，同時不能把全球差異極大的交通旅程視為單一一致的結帳流程。

title.en: Trip context crossed product boundaries
title.zh: 旅程脈絡跨越不同產品線

description.en: Accommodation, flight and taxi data were owned separately even though travellers experienced them as one connected trip.
description.zh: 住宿、航班與計程車資料分屬不同產品線，但旅客實際經歷的是同一段串連旅程。

title.en: Comparison and defaults affected conversion
title.zh: 比較方式與預設值會影響轉換

description.en: Price, capacity, passenger count and repeated selling points changed how quickly customers could identify a suitable ride.
description.zh: 價格、容量、乘客人數與重複賣點會影響顧客辨識合適車款的速度。

title.en: Pickup certainty varied by market
title.zh: 接送確定性因市場而異

description.en: Airport layout, traffic, supplier dispatch and baggage language made one universal pickup promise unreliable across 40+ countries.
description.zh: 機場動線、交通、供應商派車與行李用語，使單一接送承諾無法可靠套用於 40 多個國家。

before.en: Isolated taxi flow with repeated trip entry
before.zh: 孤立的計程車流程與重複輸入

intervention.en: Connected trip context, comparable options and context-aware guidance
intervention.zh: 串連旅程脈絡、可比較選項與情境式引導

after.en: A clearer global booking journey with measurable conversion growth
after.zh: 更清楚的全球預訂旅程與可衡量的轉換成長

supportingCopy.en: I connected research, analytics and cross-vertical product context to redesign how travellers compared, confirmed and prepared for a taxi journey.
supportingCopy.zh: 我串接研究、分析資料與跨產品旅程脈絡，重新設計旅客比較、確認並準備計程車行程的方式。

cardTitle.zh: 串連全球計程車預訂旅程

criticalProblem.en: Taxi booking sat outside accommodation and flight journeys, forcing travellers to compare unclear options, re-enter known trip details and interpret market-specific pickup rules without enough context.
criticalProblem.zh: 計程車預訂與住宿、航班旅程彼此分離，使旅客必須比較不清楚的選項、重複輸入已知行程資料，並在脈絡不足下理解各市場的接送規則。

primaryDecisions.title: From one suggested taxi to scanable option comparison
primaryDecisions.title_zh: 從單一建議計程車，到可快速掃描的選項比較
primaryDecisions.whatIDecided: Tested a focused single recommendation against a horizontal option model, then selected the comparison approach and simplified card hierarchy, repetitive selling points, default selection and sorting logic.
primaryDecisions.whatIDecided_zh: 測試聚焦式單一建議與橫向選項模型後，選擇比較方案，並簡化卡片層級、重複賣點、預設選擇與排序邏輯。
primaryDecisions.whyThisChoice: Travellers needed to understand available choices at a glance and compare price, capacity and value before committing.
primaryDecisions.whyThisChoice_zh: 旅客需要一眼理解可用選項，並在確認前比較價格、乘載量與價值。

optionalBlock.content: We accepted greater on-screen density instead of a tightly focused recommendation in exchange for faster cross-option comparison and less hidden choice.
optionalBlock.content_zh: 我們接受較高的畫面資訊密度，而非高度聚焦的單一建議，以換取更快的跨選項比較與更少被隱藏的選擇。

primaryDecisions.outcome: Established a faster comparison model grounded in observed ride behaviour, with Standard taxis representing about two-thirds of analysed bookings and the redesigned journey contributing to conversion improvement across devices.
primaryDecisions.outcome_zh: 建立以實際行程行為為依據的快速比較模型；Standard taxi 約佔分析預訂的三分之二，而重新設計的旅程也共同促成各裝置的轉換改善。
supportingEvidence: The comparison model prioritised decision-critical information rather than presenting every vehicle attribute equally.
Default behaviour was grounded in observed booking patterns across approximately 944K analysed rides.

ownership.en: Led the comparison model, hierarchy and interaction design; ordering and release logic were aligned with product, data and engineering.
ownership.zh: 主導比較模型、層級與互動設計；排序與上線邏輯則與產品、數據及工程團隊對齊。

primaryDecisions.title: From repeated form entry to connected itinerary confirmation
primaryDecisions.title_zh: 從重複填寫表單，到串連旅程資訊的確認流程
primaryDecisions.whatIDecided: Reused accommodation, flight, passenger and taxi context so signed-in travellers could confirm known journey information instead of recreating it.
primaryDecisions.whatIDecided_zh: 重用住宿、航班、乘客與計程車脈絡，讓已登入旅客確認已知旅程資訊，而不必重新建立資料。
primaryDecisions.whyThisChoice: Accommodation, Flight and Taxi were organisationally separate, but customers experienced them as one continuous trip.
primaryDecisions.whyThisChoice_zh: 住宿、航班與計程車在組織內彼此分立，但顧客經歷的是一段連續旅程。

optionalBlock.content: Accommodation, Flight and Taxi teams had to align on which trusted itinerary and passenger data could carry forward, and where customers still needed explicit confirmation or edit control.
optionalBlock.content_zh: 住宿、航班與計程車團隊必須對齊哪些可信的行程與乘客資料可沿用，以及顧客在哪些環節仍需明確確認或修改。

primaryDecisions.outcome: Reduced avoidable re-entry and connected taxi booking more closely to the wider trip, contributing to a shorter booking path and measurable post-launch growth.
primaryDecisions.outcome_zh: 減少可避免的重複輸入，使計程車預訂更緊密連結整體旅程，並共同促成更短的預訂路徑與可衡量的上線後成長。
supportingEvidence: Trusted itinerary and passenger context carried forward only where explicit confirmation and edit control remained available.
primaryDecisions.evidence: Flight-related findings were brought into weekly cross-vertical design sessions for alignment, brainstorming and critique.

ownership.en: Led the UX model for reusing trip data; data availability and cross-vertical integration were co-decided with adjacent product teams.
ownership.zh: 主導旅程資料重用的使用者體驗模型；資料可用性與跨產品整合則與相鄰產品團隊共同決定。

primaryDecisions.title: From universal pickup promises to context-aware guidance
primaryDecisions.title_zh: 從通用接送承諾，到具情境的接送指引
primaryDecisions.whatIDecided: Prioritised pickup information supported by Customer Service and behavioural evidence, translated baggage capacity into traveller-native language, and staged higher-cost market-specific guidance rather than forcing one universal promise.
primaryDecisions.whatIDecided_zh: 優先處理由客服與行為證據支持的接送資訊，將行李容量轉譯為旅客熟悉的語言，並分階段處理成本較高的市場特定引導，而非強套單一通用承諾。
primaryDecisions.whyThisChoice: Airport layout, traffic, supplier dispatch and parking regulations made one universal pickup or waiting-time promise unreliable across markets.
primaryDecisions.whyThisChoice_zh: 機場動線、交通、供應商派車與停車規定，使單一接送或等候時間承諾無法可靠套用於各市場。

optionalBlock.content: We accepted less personalised timing in the first step rather than introducing false precision, while providing clearer precautions and access to support until supplier-specific logic became feasible.
optionalBlock.content_zh: 第一階段接受較不個人化的時間資訊，而非導入錯誤精準度；在供應商特定邏輯可行前，以更清楚的注意事項與客服管道補足。

primaryDecisions.outcome: Created a clearer framework for handling pickup uncertainty across markets and helped expose Spain as the main outlier requiring deeper behavioural investigation.
primaryDecisions.outcome_zh: 建立更清楚的跨市場接送不確定性處理框架，並辨識西班牙為需要進一步行為調查的主要離群市場。
supportingEvidence: The direction translated operational and supplier constraints into customer-facing language while separating globally reusable guidance from market-specific exceptions.

ownership.en: Led the evidence synthesis and staged guidance direction; supplier-specific feasibility and rollout were shared product and operational decisions.
ownership.zh: 主導證據統整與分階段引導方向；供應商特定可行性與推行則為共同的產品與營運決策。

measurementBoundary.rule: The measurement window does not replace the project timeline.

latestConfirmedCorrection.r1625: Recruiter-first approximate outcomes, cross-market outlier framing, complete decisions, and confidentiality-safe ride-mix evidence approved on 2026-08-14.

whatThisProves.en: Turning localisation and usability risk into explicit launch decisions across 40+ countries.
whatThisProves.zh: 將在地化與可用性風險轉化為明確決策，支援 40+ 國家的同步上線。

primaryMetrics.label: additional rides per day after launch

impactEvidence.recommendedHeadline: Improved conversion across devices and added approximately 150 rides per day after launch.
impactEvidence.boundary: Public values are rounded approximations; cross-market ~6% is an unweighted mean of supplied market differences, not a traffic-weighted global result.

caption.en: Across ~944K analysed rides, Standard taxis represented the majority of observed bookings.
caption.zh: 在約 944K 趟分析行程中，Standard taxi 佔觀察預訂的多數。

caption.en: Behavioural evidence showed travellers reviewing and editing known trip information.
caption.zh: 行為證據顯示旅客會檢視並修改已知旅程資訊。

caption.en: Supplier specifications were translated into carry-on and checked-baggage language familiar to travellers.
caption.zh: 將供應商規格轉譯為旅客熟悉的隨身與托運行李用語。

headline.en: I turned an early-stage learning concept into a released cross-device product and implementation-ready UX foundation.
headline.zh: 我把尚未成形的學習概念，建立成正式上架的跨裝置產品與可直接落地的體驗基礎。

supportingStatement.en: In five months, I used eight interviews and tests to define the structure and deliver specifications for 12 core functions across mobile and tablet.
supportingStatement.zh: 我在五個月內透過 8 場訪談與測試，定義產品架構，並完成手機與平板共 12 項核心功能規格。

title.en: From fragmented learning content to a connected cross-device learning product
title.zh: 從零散學習內容，到串連的跨裝置學習產品

atAGlance.en: Independently defined the UX for mobile and tablet piano-learning products, translating eight interviews and tests into specifications for 12 core functions and shipping content discovery, sheet-music practice, and level-based learning journeys.
atAGlance.zh: 獨立定義手機與平板鋼琴學習產品的使用體驗，將 8 場訪談與測試轉化為 12 項核心功能規格，並上線內容探索、樂譜練習與分級學習旅程。

rationale.en: Bandzo manages a stateful learning transaction across discovery, purchase, entitlement, practice and assessment. The label does not imply a payment-only product.
rationale.zh: Bandzo 管理從探索、購買、內容權限、練習到檢定的具狀態學習流程；此分類不代表它只是付款產品。

scope.en: End-to-end learning journey across discovery, purchase, entitlement, practice and assessment.
scope.zh: 涵蓋探索、購買、內容權限、練習與檢定的端到端學習旅程。

whyItMattered.en: Learners lacked a reliable way to judge their level and choose suitable content, while discovery, purchase, access, and practice were split across disconnected flows.
whyItMattered.zh: 學習者缺乏可靠方式判斷程度與選擇合適內容，探索、購買、存取與練習也分散在彼此脫節的流程中。

businessImpact.en: Established a reusable learning-content and entitlement model that supported continued catalogue growth without redesigning the core product.
businessImpact.zh: 建立可重用的學習內容與存取權限模型，讓產品能持續擴充內容，不必重做核心架構。

title.en: From automated skill recognition to a shippable five-level model
title.zh: 從自動程度辨識，到可上線的五級模型

whatIDecided.en: Ship a five-level onboarding model and examination-category levels before investing in score recognition, music recognition and fingering assessment.
whatIDecided.zh: 先上線五級初始引導與檢定分類級別，再投入樂譜辨識、音樂辨識與指法評估。

whyThisChoice.en: Copyright, content classification and delivery constraints made recognition-dependent onboarding too risky for the first release.
whyThisChoice.zh: 版權、內容分類與交付限制，使依賴辨識技術的初始引導不適合首版。

content.en: Accepted a less personalised initial assessment to launch a coherent learning path earlier and avoid blocking the product on unresolved recognition and content dependencies.
content.zh: 接受較不個人化的初始評估，以更早上線完整學習路徑，避免產品被未解決的辨識與內容依賴阻塞。

title.en: From third-party payment to a governed P2P marketplace
title.zh: 從第三方支付服務，到具交易治理的 P2P 拍賣平台

atAGlance.en: Co-led research and UX definition for Taishin Bank’s P2P marketplace, translating 30 interviews into 7 logic-flow sheets and 25 functional documents that aligned buyer, seller, payment, logistics and notification states across the bank and software vendor.
atAGlance.zh: 共同主導台新銀行 P2P 拍賣平台的研究與使用者體驗定義，將 30 場訪談轉化為 7 份邏輯流程表與 25 份功能文件，對齊銀行與軟體供應商之間的買方、賣方、付款、物流與通知狀態。

rationale.en: Coordinates supply, demand, trust, transaction states and multi-party responsibilities.
rationale.zh: 協調供需、信任、交易狀態與多方責任。

scope.en: End-to-end marketplace transaction model spanning buyer, seller, payment, logistics and notifications
scope.zh: 涵蓋買方、賣方、付款、物流與通知的端到端市集交易模型

whyItMattered.en: A payment feature alone could not govern buyer protection, seller operations, logistics, notifications, and implementation across multiple organisations.
whyItMattered.zh: 單一付款功能無法同時治理買家保障、賣家營運、物流、通知，以及跨組織實作。

businessImpact.en: Established a shared transaction model that reduced interpretation gaps between Taishin Bank and its software vendor and made the broader marketplace service implementable.
businessImpact.zh: 建立跨台新銀行與軟體供應商的共用交易模型，降低解讀落差，並讓更完整的市集服務具備可實作基礎。

title.en: From a payment service to a trusted P2P marketplace
title.zh: 從支付服務，到值得信任的 P2P 市集

whatIDecided.en: Expanded the initial third-party payment brief into a marketplace model that guided sellers stage by stage and protected buyers throughout the transaction.
whatIDecided.zh: 將原本的第三方支付需求擴展為市集模型，分階段引導賣家，並在交易過程中保障買家。

whyThisChoice.en: Market research showed that Taishin Bank’s trust advantage could create more value through a governed end-to-end service than through an isolated payment function.
whyThisChoice.zh: 市場研究顯示，台新銀行的信任優勢透過受治理的端到端服務，能比單一付款功能創造更完整的價值。

content.en: We accepted a broader service-definition scope instead of a faster payment-only delivery to protect buyer–seller trust and transaction coherence.
content.zh: 我們接受較廣的服務定義範圍，而非更快交付單一付款功能，以保障買賣信任與交易一致性。

title.en: From screen rules to one end-to-end transaction regulation
title.zh: 從逐頁規則，到一套端到端交易規範

whatIDecided.en: Mapped payment, logistics, notifications, service states and response actions into one shared regulation across the bank and software vendor.
whatIDecided.zh: 將付款、物流、通知、服務狀態與回應動作整理為銀行與軟體供應商共用的一套規範。

whyThisChoice.en: Buyer and seller journeys crossed organisational responsibilities; inconsistent state logic would create operational and implementation risk.
whyThisChoice.zh: 買賣雙方旅程橫跨不同組織責任；狀態邏輯不一致會增加營運與實作風險。

content.en: This required shared transaction states and responsibility boundaries before interface specifications could remain consistent.
content.zh: 這需要先建立共用交易狀態與責任邊界，介面規格才能維持一致。

title.en: From separate UX and UI production to reusable patterns
title.zh: 從分離的 UX／UI 製作，到可重用模式

whatIDecided.en: Applied UI-defined patterns inside high-fidelity UX specifications so the broader platform could be documented consistently despite limited UI capacity.
whatIDecided.zh: 在高擬真 UX 規格中套用 UI 已定義的模式，使有限 UI 資源下仍能一致記錄更廣的平台範圍。

whyThisChoice.en: The platform scope exceeded the available UI resource and needed a shared pattern model to protect delivery consistency.
whyThisChoice.zh: 平台範圍超過現有 UI 資源，需要共享模式來維持交付一致性。

content.en: We accepted heavier UX specification effort in exchange for reducing the UI bottleneck and preserving implementation consistency.
content.zh: 我們接受較高的 UX 規格投入，換取降低 UI 瓶頸並維持實作一致性。

taishin-p2p-marketplace-platform.transformation_zh: 從第三方支付服務，到具交易治理的 P2P 拍賣平台
taishin-p2p-marketplace-platform.transformation: From third-party payment to a governed P2P marketplace
taishin-p2p-marketplace-platform.at_glance: Co-led research and UX definition for Taishin Bank’s P2P marketplace, translating 30 interviews into 7 logic-flow sheets and 25 functional documents that aligned buyer, seller, payment, logistics and notification states across the bank and software vendor.
taishin-p2p-marketplace-platform.at_glance_zh: 共同主導台新銀行 P2P 拍賣平台的研究與使用者體驗定義，將 30 場訪談轉化為 7 份邏輯流程表與 25 份功能文件，對齊銀行與軟體供應商之間的買方、賣方、付款、物流與通知狀態。
taishin-p2p-marketplace-platform.why: A payment feature alone could not govern buyer protection, seller operations, logistics, notifications, and implementation across multiple organisations.
taishin-p2p-marketplace-platform.why_zh: 單一付款功能無法同時治理買家保障、賣家營運、物流、通知，以及跨組織實作。
taishin-p2p-marketplace-platform.impact: Established an end-to-end transaction regulation that became the shared delivery reference for the banking client and software vendor.
taishin-p2p-marketplace-platform.impact_zh: 建立端到端交易規範，成為銀行客戶與軟體供應商共用的交付依據。

cardTitle.zh: 台新 P2P 拍賣平台

criticalProblem.en: Taishin Bank initially planned a third-party payment service, but payment alone could not create buyer–seller trust or govern protection, fulfilment, logistics and notifications across organisations.
criticalProblem.zh: 台新銀行最初規劃第三方支付服務，但單一付款能力無法建立買賣雙方信任，也無法跨組織治理保障、履約、物流與通知。

title.en: From a payment service to a trusted P2P marketplace
title.zh: 從支付服務，到值得信任的 P2P 市集

whatIDecided.en: Expanded the initial third-party payment brief into a marketplace model that guided sellers stage by stage and protected buyers throughout the transaction.
whatIDecided.zh: 將原本的第三方支付需求擴展為市集模型，分階段引導賣家，並在交易過程中保障買家。

whyThisChoice.en: Market research showed that Taishin Bank’s trust advantage could create more value through a governed end-to-end service than through an isolated payment function.
whyThisChoice.zh: 市場研究顯示，台新銀行的信任優勢透過受治理的端到端服務，能比單一付款功能創造更完整的價值。

content.en: We accepted a broader service-definition scope instead of a faster payment-only delivery to protect buyer–seller trust and transaction coherence.
content.zh: 我們接受較廣的服務定義範圍，而非更快交付單一付款功能，以保障買賣信任與交易一致性。

title.en: From screen rules to one end-to-end transaction regulation
title.zh: 從逐頁規則，到一套端到端交易規範

whatIDecided.en: Mapped payment, logistics, notifications, service states and response actions into one shared regulation across the bank and software vendor.
whatIDecided.zh: 將付款、物流、通知、服務狀態與回應動作整理為銀行與軟體供應商共用的一套規範。

whyThisChoice.en: Buyer and seller journeys crossed organisational responsibilities; inconsistent state logic would create operational and implementation risk.
whyThisChoice.zh: 買賣雙方旅程橫跨不同組織責任；狀態邏輯不一致會增加營運與實作風險。

content.en: This required shared transaction states and responsibility boundaries before interface specifications could remain consistent.
content.zh: 這需要先建立共用交易狀態與責任邊界，介面規格才能維持一致。

title.en: From separate UX and UI production to reusable patterns
title.zh: 從分離的 UX／UI 製作，到可重用模式

whatIDecided.en: Applied UI-defined patterns inside high-fidelity UX specifications so the broader platform could be documented consistently despite limited UI capacity.
whatIDecided.zh: 在高擬真 UX 規格中套用 UI 已定義的模式，使有限 UI 資源下仍能一致記錄更廣的平台範圍。

whyThisChoice.en: The platform scope exceeded the available UI resource and needed a shared pattern model to protect delivery consistency.
whyThisChoice.zh: 平台範圍超過現有 UI 資源，需要共享模式來維持交付一致性。

content.en: We accepted heavier UX specification effort in exchange for reducing the UI bottleneck and preserving implementation consistency.
content.zh: 我們接受較高的 UX 規格投入，換取降低 UI 瓶頸並維持實作一致性。

statusAndDisclosure.renderRule: Resolve only fields that exist; do not infer launch, adoption or revenue.

recoveryUnresolved.reason: Two uploaded source screenshots are registered, but public-safe production derivatives and final asset paths are not yet verified.

headline.en: 30 interviews, 7 logic-flow sheets and 25 functional documents became one shared transaction model for Taishin Bank and its software vendor.
headline.zh: 30 場訪談、7 份邏輯流程表與 25 份功能文件，最終整合為台新銀行與軟體供應商共用的交易模型。

supportingStatement.en: The model aligned buyer payment, seller notification, logistics and transaction states across organisational boundaries.
supportingStatement.zh: 這套模型跨越組織邊界，對齊買方付款、賣方通知、物流與交易狀態。

title.en: Payment was only one layer of trust
title.zh: 付款只是信任機制的一層

description.en: A payment function could move money, but it could not by itself protect buyers, guide sellers or define what happened when fulfilment changed.
description.zh: 付款功能可以完成資金移轉，卻無法單獨保障買家、引導賣家，或定義履約狀態改變時的處理方式。

title.en: Every action changed multiple transaction states
title.zh: 每個操作都會改變多個交易狀態

description.en: Buyer actions affected seller tasks, payment status, logistics, notifications and service recovery, so screen-level rules were insufficient.
description.zh: 買方操作會連動賣方任務、付款狀態、物流、通知與服務復原，因此逐頁規則不足以支撐整體交易。

title.en: Two organisations needed one implementation reference
title.zh: 兩個組織需要同一套實作依據

description.en: The bank and software vendor owned different decisions and delivery responsibilities, making a shared transaction regulation essential.
description.zh: 銀行與軟體供應商分別承擔不同決策與交付責任，因此必須建立共用的交易規範。

title.en: Taishin Research and Definition Model
title.zh: 台新研究與定義模型

description.en: Reframed the initial third-party payment brief through market research.
description.zh: 透過市場研究重新界定原本的第三方支付需求。

description.en: Synthesised 30 interviews into trust, fulfilment and transaction needs.
description.zh: 將 30 場訪談整合為信任、履約與交易需求。

description.en: Connected payment, logistics, notifications and service states.
description.zh: 串接付款、物流、通知與服務狀態。

description.en: Documented 7 shared logic-flow sheets for cross-team alignment.
description.zh: 以 7 份邏輯流程表完成跨團隊對齊。

description.en: Converted the model into 25 functional documents for implementation.
description.zh: 將模型轉化為 25 份功能文件供實作使用。

description.zh: 銀行與軟體供應商分別承擔不同決策與交付責任，因此必須建立共用的交易規範。

whatThisProves.en: Defining an ambiguous two-sided marketplace through transaction logic and detailed platform rules.
whatThisProves.zh: 透過交易邏輯與平台規則，定義模糊的雙邊市場模式。

impactEvidence.recommendedHeadline: Converted 30 interviews into a governed marketplace transaction model, 7 shared logic flows and 25 implementation documents.

doNotMergeWith: Any current mortgage case using a different client, period or product boundary

title.en: From a rigid tablet script to a flexible mortgage consultation flow
title.zh: 從僵化的平板腳本，到彈性的房貸諮詢流程

atAGlance.en: Led UX redesign of an internal tablet mortgage app, turning a rigid sales script into tested, scenario-based guidance across customer needs, loan estimation, and implementation handoff.
atAGlance.zh: 主導內部平板房貸工具的體驗改版，將僵化的銷售腳本轉化為經測試的情境式引導，涵蓋客戶需求、房貸估算與開發交接。

rationale.en: Coordinates internal roles, rules, approvals, exceptions or operational decisions.
rationale.zh: 協調內部角色、規則、核准、例外或營運決策。

scope.en: End-to-end tablet consultation across customer needs assessment, mortgage estimation, scenario guidance, validation and implementation handoff
scope.zh: 涵蓋客戶需求評估、房貸估算、情境引導、驗證與實作交接的端到端平板諮詢流程

timeline.displayRule: Hide Timeline until an exact duration is confirmed.

whyItMattered.en: The existing app did not match real mortgage conversations and could not organise fragmented departmental inputs into one practical consultation experience.
whyItMattered.zh: 既有工具不符合真實房貸諮詢情境，也無法將分散在不同部門的資訊整理成一套可實際使用的諮詢體驗。

businessImpact.en: Established and launched a consultation model that connected needs assessment, mortgage estimation, and implementation-ready guidance.
businessImpact.zh: 建立並上線一套串接需求評估、房貸估算與可實作引導的諮詢模式。

constraints.en: Changing the interface also changed the employee orientation process.
constraints.zh: 介面改動也會影響員工原有的操作引導與培訓流程。

constraints.en: Required information was distributed across departmental databases and could not be treated as one integrated backend source.
constraints.zh: 所需資訊分散於不同部門資料庫，不能被視為已完成整合的單一後端來源。

constraints.en: The redesign had to extend Cathay’s established component system.
constraints.zh: 改版必須延伸國泰既有的元件系統。

work: Research and concept workshop with client

sourceClaims.measurementBoundary: Historical qualitative claims only; no quantified outcome is available.

remainingGaps: Exact month range and duration if Timeline should be displayed
Quantified employee adoption or sales outcome

en: How do you redesign an employee sales tool?
How do you make mortgage consultation more flexible?
How do you connect data across a guided workflow?
zh: 如何重新設計員工銷售工具？
如何讓房貸諮詢更有彈性？
如何在引導式流程中連結跨系統資料？

researcher.en: Arranged and conducted the in-depth interviews and partnered on synthesis and usability planning.
researcher.zh: 安排並執行深度訪談，並共同參與研究統整與可用性測試規劃。

uiDesigner.en: Collaborated on interface design and prototype production.
uiDesigner.zh: 共同合作介面設計與原型製作。

clientAndDelivery.en: Aligned concepts with the client and handed implementation-ready flows and wireframes to development.
clientAndDelivery.zh: 與客戶對齊概念，並將可實作的流程與線框稿交付開發。

title.en: From a fixed tablet orientation to a flexible consultation flow
title.zh: 從固定的平板引導，到彈性的房貸諮詢流程

whatIDecided.en: Reorganised the existing app around scenario-based conversations so sales staff could assess customer needs, explain mortgage estimates and move between relevant guidance without following one rigid script.
whatIDecided.zh: 以情境式對話重新組織既有 App，讓銷售人員能評估客戶需求、說明房貸估算，並依實際對話切換相關引導，而不是被單一路徑限制。

whyThisChoice.en: The original orientation did not match how sales staff developed real customer conversations and created unnecessary cognitive workload during consultation.
whyThisChoice.zh: 原本的操作引導不符合銷售人員與客戶實際互動的方式，也在諮詢過程中增加不必要的認知負擔。

content.en: The redesign had to simplify the consultation experience without breaking the employee orientation process tied to the existing app.
content.zh: 改版必須在不破壞既有員工操作引導的前提下，降低諮詢流程的負擔。

zh: 訪談逐字稿與 Empathy maps
四項任務的可用性測試

impactAndOwnership.en: I led the concept, prototype, wireframes and developer handoff; the redesigned app launched for internal use.
impactAndOwnership.zh: 我主導概念、原型、線框稿與開發交接；改版後的 App 已正式上線供內部使用。

title.en: From fragmented departmental inputs to one consultation structure
title.zh: 從分散的部門資訊，到一套共享的諮詢結構

whatIDecided.en: Defined the app structure, function tree and information requirements that organised available customer, mortgage and marketing inputs into one consultation sequence, while documenting data dependencies for delivery.
whatIDecided.zh: 定義 App 架構、功能樹與資訊需求，將可用的客戶、房貸與行銷資訊整理進同一套諮詢順序，並清楚記錄交付所需的資料依賴。

whyThisChoice.en: Relevant information was distributed across departmental databases, so the team needed one shared model before interface and development decisions could stay consistent.
whyThisChoice.zh: 相關資訊分散在不同部門資料庫，因此團隊需要先建立共同模型，才能讓介面與開發決策保持一致。

content.en: This required clarifying which information was available, which dependencies remained outside the app and how each input supported the consultation.
content.zh: 這項決策需要先釐清哪些資訊可取得、哪些依賴仍在 App 之外，以及各項資訊如何支援諮詢流程。

zh: 供開發使用的註解式 Wireframe

impactAndOwnership.en: I created the UX structure and delivery specification used by the UI Designer, client and development team.
impactAndOwnership.zh: 我建立 UX 架構與交付規格，供 UI 設計師、客戶與開發團隊共同使用。

title.en: From research handoff to a validated, system-aligned delivery
title.zh: 從研究交接，到經驗證且符合既有系統的設計交付

whatIDecided.en: Translated interview findings into user scenarios, a prototype and implementation-ready wireframes, then refined the direction through a four-task usability test before handoff.
whatIDecided.zh: 將訪談發現轉化為使用情境、原型與可實作線框稿，並在交接前透過四項任務的可用性測試修正方向。

whyThisChoice.en: The redesign had to work in real sales conversations, satisfy client expectations and remain compatible with Cathay’s established component system.
whyThisChoice.zh: 改版必須能用於真實銷售對話、符合客戶期待，並與國泰既有元件系統相容。

content.en: This required close collaboration with the Researcher, UI Designer, Project Manager and client across synthesis, workshops, prototype production and final alignment.
content.zh: 這需要與研究員、UI 設計師、專案經理與客戶密切合作，完成研究統整、工作坊、原型製作與最終對齊。

zh: 客戶 Ideation 與 Alignment workshops
可供開發使用的狀態與流程說明

impactAndOwnership.en: I owned the UX concept, prototype, wireframes and handoff, collaborating with the UI Designer on visual execution.
impactAndOwnership.zh: 我負責 UX 概念、原型、線框稿與交接，並與 UI 設計師協作視覺執行。

confidentialityNote.en: *For confidentiality reasons, exact client metrics and system details are not disclosed.*
confidentialityNote.zh: *基於保密考量，不公開精確的客戶數據與系統細節。*

publicSummary.en: Owned concept, scenarios, prototype, wireframes and developer handoff as the UX Designer; the UI Designer co-developed interface execution, while the researcher led interview scheduling and facilitation.
publicSummary.zh: 以使用者體驗設計師身分負責概念、情境、原型、線框稿與開發交接；介面設計師共同完成介面執行，研究員則主責訪談安排與執行。

partnerOwned.en: Interview recruitment and facilitation by Researcher
partnerOwned.zh: 研究員負責訪談招募與執行
與介面設計師共同完成視覺細節

claim.zh: 改版後的內部平板諮詢 App 已正式上線。

claim.en: Employee adoption, consultation efficiency and mortgage-sales outcomes were not measured in the available engagement evidence.
claim.zh: 現有專案證據未包含員工採用率、諮詢效率或房貸銷售成果。

headline.en: I turned a rigid tablet sales script into a launched scenario-based mortgage consultation flow.

whatThisProves.en: Restructuring rigid internal tools around real frontline consultation scenarios.

headline.en: I reframed payment from channel-specific interactions into one end-to-end transaction model.
headline.zh: 我將依通路分離的付款互動，重新定義為一套端到端交易模型。

supportingStatement.en: By connecting customer behaviour with POS execution, benefit logic and recovery states, I gave the team a shared structure for deciding how the experience should behave across App, cashier and self-checkout.
supportingStatement.zh: 我串接顧客行為、POS 執行、權益邏輯與復原狀態，讓團隊能依據同一套結構，決定體驗在 App、人工收銀與自助結帳之間應如何運作。

title.en: Transaction continuity across App and in-store checkout

zh: 優惠券與會員權益不清

atAGlance.en: Led the 0→1 product design of FairPrice’s in-store payment system, connecting App payment entry with cashier and self-checkout execution, benefit visibility and transaction recovery across ~190 stores.
atAGlance.zh: 主導 FairPrice 門市付款系統的 0→1 產品設計，串接 App 付款入口、人工收銀與自助結帳執行、權益顯示及交易復原，推展至約 190 間門市。

rationale.en: Manages a stateful exchange such as payment, booking, entitlement, purchase or account completion.
rationale.zh: 管理付款、預訂、內容權限、購買或帳戶完成等具狀態的交換流程。

scope.en: App-to-store payment journey across cashier and self-checkout
scope.zh: 串接 App、人工收銀與自助結帳的門市付款旅程

whyItMattered.en: FairPrice was digitising in-store checkout across its retail network, but payment, membership benefits, vouchers, store operations and transaction review were split across teams and systems.
whyItMattered.zh: FairPrice 正在推動零售網路的門市結帳數位化，但付款、會員權益、優惠券、門市營運與交易審查分散在不同團隊與系統中。

businessImpact.en: Established a reusable payment standard and shared guidelines across App, POS, self-checkout and other FairPrice verticals, connecting customer checkout with frontline and internal transaction operations.
businessImpact.zh: 建立可重用的付款標準與共享規範，橫跨 App、POS、自助結帳與 FairPrice 其他產品線，串接顧客結帳、第一線與內部交易營運。

designDecisions.title: From separate loyalty and payment steps to one checkout identity
designDecisions.whatIDecided: Connected app QR payment, LinkPoints, discounts and available vouchers so customers could see applied value and complete checkout with fewer cards and fewer visible steps.
designDecisions.whyThisChoice: Research showed checkout decisions were shaped by speed, reassurance and queue pressure, while customers struggled to understand LinkPoints and voucher use at self-checkout.
designDecisions.title_zh: 從分離的忠誠與付款步驟，到單一結帳識別
designDecisions.whatIDecided_zh: 連結 App QR 付款、LinkPoints、折扣與可用優惠券，讓顧客能看見已套用價值，並以更少卡片與更少步驟完成結帳。
designDecisions.whyThisChoice_zh: 研究顯示，結帳決策受到速度、安心感與排隊壓力影響；顧客也難以理解在自助結帳時如何使用 LinkPoints 與優惠券。
designDecisions.evidence: The visible self-checkout journey was reduced from 9 to 6 steps and cardless checkout scaled across about 190 stores.

designDecisions.title: From ambiguous QR interactions to channel-specific guidance
designDecisions.whatIDecided: Refined SCO entry placement, changed instructions from scanning to showing a QR code, simplified value-proposition copy and reduced competing CTA attention during kiosk processing.
designDecisions.whyThisChoice: Testing showed users noticed the entry but hesitated, confused Scan & Go with QR generation, tapped the wrong screen and did not understand the Go Back path.
designDecisions.title_zh: 從模糊的 QR 互動，到依通路設計的操作引導
designDecisions.whatIDecided_zh: 調整自助結帳入口位置，將指示從「掃描」改為「出示 QR Code」，簡化價值說明，並降低其他操作按鈕對付款任務的干擾。
designDecisions.whyThisChoice_zh: 測試顯示，使用者雖看見入口卻仍會猶豫，混淆 Scan & Go 與 QR 產生方式、點錯畫面，也不了解返回路徑。
designDecisions.evidence: Version C was noticed by 4/6 users versus 2/6 for Version B; the revised Show your QR code instruction improved action comprehension.

designDecisions.title: From a successful payment screen to an end-to-end recovery and operations model
designDecisions.whatIDecided: Designed customer recovery, refund, internal transaction-review and email communication flows as one connected operating model around the core payment journey.
designDecisions.whyThisChoice: A dependable payment foundation had to remain understandable and actionable when transactions failed, required refunds, or moved into staff, support and finance workflows.
designDecisions.title_zh: 從付款成功畫面，到端到端恢復與營運模型
designDecisions.whatIDecided_zh: 將顧客復原、退款、內部交易審查與電子郵件溝通流程設計成圍繞核心付款旅程的一套連續營運模型。
designDecisions.whyThisChoice_zh: 可靠的付款基礎必須在交易失敗、需要退款，或進入門市、客服與財務流程時，仍然清楚且可採取行動。
designDecisions.evidence: The launched Payment service included customer recovery, refunds, transaction records, internal transaction lookup and supporting operational workflows.

outcomes.label: SHIPPED OUTCOMES

publicSummary.en: By September 2021, the system processed about 228k monthly transactions at a 98.5% success rate across about 57k users. It launched across about 190 stores, achieved an NPS of 70.2, and won the 2021 Singapore User Experience Award of the Year - Retail.
publicSummary.zh: 截至 2021 年 9 月，系統單月處理約 22.8 萬筆交易，付款成功率為 98.5%，涵蓋約 5.7 萬名使用者；產品推展至約 190 間門市、NPS 達 70.2，並獲得 2021 Singapore User Experience Award of the Year - Retail。

headline.en: The transaction—not the screen or channel—had to remain coherent from entry through confirmation and recovery.
headline.zh: 必須保持連續的是整筆交易，而不是單一畫面或通路；這份連續性要從進入付款延伸至確認與復原。

supportingCopy.en: Customers could begin in the App and complete payment at a cashier or self-checkout, while benefits, failures and records crossed other systems. Trust depended on preserving transaction continuity across those boundaries.
supportingCopy.zh: 顧客可從 App 開始，並在人工收銀或自助結帳完成付款；權益、失敗與紀錄則跨越其他系統。信任取決於能否在這些邊界之間維持交易連續性。

title.en: Transaction continuity across systems
title.zh: 跨系統的交易連續性

copy.en: A simplified public-safe map of the customer, App, payment and loyalty logic, POS/SCO execution, completion and exception loop.
copy.zh: 經簡化且適合公開的系統圖，呈現顧客、App、付款與會員邏輯、POS／SCO 執行、完成與例外循環。

title.en: Evidence that shaped the decisions
title.zh: 影響設計決策的證據

title.en: Live checkout fieldwork
title.zh: 門市結帳實地研究

copy.en: Three days with eight shoppers exposed the pressure, assurance and timing needs at cashier and self-checkout.
copy.zh: 三天、八位購物者的實地研究，揭示人工收銀與自助結帳中的壓力、安心感與時間需求。

title.en: Repeated self-checkout entry validation
title.zh: 多輪自助結帳入口驗證

copy.en: Structured and guerrilla testing clarified entry recognition, QR guidance and the handoff into payment.
copy.zh: 結構化與游擊測試釐清入口辨識、QR 指示及進入付款的交接方式。

title.en: Value and transaction-history validation
title.zh: 價值與交易紀錄驗證

copy.en: Copy and concept tests made benefits, confirmation and post-transaction records easier to interpret.
copy.zh: 文案與概念測試讓權益、確認及交易後紀錄更容易理解。

heading.en: Queue pressure made the App-to-checkout handoff trust-critical
heading.zh: 排隊壓力使 App 至結帳交接成為信任關鍵

summary.en: Live cashier and self-checkout validation showed that unclear instructions and delayed recognition created hesitation at a time-sensitive checkout moment.
summary.zh: 人工收銀與自助結帳驗證顯示，不清楚的指示與延遲辨識會在時間敏感的結帳時刻造成猶豫。

heading.en: Customers could not assume benefits carried across payment contexts
heading.zh: 顧客無法確定權益會跨付款情境延續

summary.en: Fieldwork and loyalty validation showed that customers were unsure when LinkPoints, vouchers and discounts had actually carried into payment.
summary.zh: 實地研究與會員權益驗證顯示，顧客不確定 LinkPoints、優惠券與折扣何時真正帶入付款。

heading.en: Payment exceptions continued beyond the failure screen
heading.zh: 付款例外會延續至失敗畫面之後

summary.en: Failure-path mapping, refund design and transaction-record testing showed that recovery needed clear next actions and traceable records.
summary.zh: 失敗路徑梳理、退款設計與交易紀錄測試顯示，復原需要清楚的下一步與可追溯紀錄。

title.en: Research and validation
title.zh: 研究與驗證

intro.en: I led field research and repeated validation across live checkout, loyalty, self-checkout entry and transaction history.
intro.zh: 我主導實體結帳、會員權益、自助結帳入口與交易紀錄的實地研究及多輪驗證。

supportingCopy.zh: 驗證權益可見性與收銀指示

evidenceNote.zh: 設計師主導的會員權益與收銀指示驗證。

supportingCopy.en: customers needed transparency and visible alternatives
supportingCopy.zh: 顧客需要透明度與可見替代方案

evidenceNote.en: Seven of eight live-store participants surfaced assurance as a payment need.
evidenceNote.zh: 8 位門市研究參與者中有 7 位顯示安心感是付款需求。

supportingCopy.en: hesitation increased when others were waiting
supportingCopy.zh: 他人等待時，猶豫感會增加

evidenceNote.en: Seven of eight live-store participants described social pressure at checkout.
evidenceNote.zh: 8 位門市研究參與者中有 7 位描述結帳時的社交壓力。

supportingCopy.en: shorter, clearer checkout paths mattered
supportingCopy.zh: 更短且更清楚的結帳路徑很重要

evidenceNote.en: Seven of eight live-store participants treated checkout time as a key concern.
evidenceNote.zh: 8 位門市研究參與者中有 7 位將結帳時間視為關鍵考量。

label.zh: 偏好更清楚的交易紀錄

supportingCopy.zh: 分開且標示清楚的紀錄結構

evidenceNote.en: Twelve of fourteen Order History participants preferred the clearer separated structure.
evidenceNote.zh: 14 位訂單紀錄測試參與者中有 12 位偏好更清楚的分開結構。

measuredLabel.zh: 付款系統已推展至零售規模，並在實際使用中展現可靠性。

text.zh: 這項工作也為 FairPrice 相關產品情境建立了可重用的付款標準與互動規範。

title.zh: Singapore User Experience Award of the Year, Retail

attributionBoundary.zh: 交易量、成功率、NPS、速度與推展規模皆以實際使用中量測的產品與團隊成果呈現。

title.zh: 結帳加快 12.49 秒

copy.zh: 已上線的 0→1 付款體驗將量測時間由 19.78 秒降至 7.29 秒。

zeroToOneMandate.programmeNeed: Create the company’s dependable in-store digital-payment baseline and bring the product from exploration to launch.
leadershipScope: In-store shadowing and live checkout observation

programmeLeadership.en: Built the product’s shared direction across customer experience, store operations and technology rather than treating payment as an isolated app feature.
programmeLeadership.zh: 將付款視為顧客 experience、門市營運與 Technology 的共同產品，而非單一 App feature，建立跨團隊共享方向。

operationalReadiness: Coordinated in-store access and frontline participation for research
Translated cashier and customer findings into product and failure-state decisions
Aligned rollout implications with offline teams
Participated in employee-training discussions for launch readiness
Supported business-strategy meetings and CEO-level reporting
Connected launch instrumentation with operational dashboards
teamImpactEvidence: Customer-research and behaviour-sharing sessions were recognised in team retrospectives.
The MVP workshop assigned next-step ownership across POS, Loyalty and Payments technology teams.

title.en: Extended the product beyond checkout into recovery and operations
title.zh: 將產品從結帳延伸至復原與營運團隊

summary.en: I independently designed the Payment recovery, refund, internal transaction portal and email communication flows, so the 0→1 foundation covered customer exceptions, staff action and operational follow-up rather than only the happy-path payment.
summary.zh: 我獨立完成付款復原、退款、內部交易入口與電子郵件溝通流程，讓 0→1 基礎不只處理正常付款，也涵蓋顧客例外、員工操作與營運後續追蹤。

operationalSystemOwnership.shipmentBoundary: Capability-level production status still requires confirmation; all design ownership is confirmed.

supportingValidatedDecisions.title: From one generic order list to labeled transaction histories
supportingValidatedDecisions.whatIDecided: Used separate labeled histories for Online Grocery, Scan & Go and app payment as the interim model, while preserving a future path toward a unified labeled history.
supportingValidatedDecisions.whyThisChoice: Users wanted clear category differences during transition; 85.7% found the separate labeled version more intuitive than mixing new payment records into the existing list.

optionalThirdBlock.content: We prioritised immediate discoverability and lower transition risk, while deferring a unified one-page history model because the future-direction sample was not sufficient for a final architecture decision.

supportingValidatedDecisions.title_zh: 從單一通用訂單清單，到有清楚標籤的交易紀錄
supportingValidatedDecisions.whatIDecided_zh: 過渡期間先使用 Online Grocery、Scan & Go 與 App 付款的分開標籤紀錄，同時保留未來整合成單一有標籤歷史紀錄的方向。
supportingValidatedDecisions.whyThisChoice_zh: 用戶在轉換期間需要清楚辨識不同類別；85.7% 認為分開且有標籤的版本，比把新付款紀錄混入既有清單更直覺。

visualEvidenceStatus.remainingVisualNeed: No launch or employee-training photograph is required. Only capability-level production confirmation remains.

Voucher integration was co-delivered with Retail, Membership / Voucher, POS and Engineering teams: I owned the App-facing experience, not the underlying eligibility or backend rules.

intro.en: Two forms of leverage: defining the transaction model and making it implementable across customer, payment and operational constraints.
intro.zh: 兩種關鍵影響力：定義交易模型，並使其能在顧客、付款與營運限制下落實。

title.en: Defined the transaction model behind FairPrice’s 0→1 in-store payment capability
title.zh: 定義 FairPrice 0→1 門市付款能力背後的交易模型

text.en: As the only dedicated product designer on the core team, I led product framing, field research, transaction architecture, interaction design and validation across App, cashier and self-checkout contexts.
text.zh: 作為核心團隊唯一的專職產品設計師，我主導產品定義、實地研究、交易架構、互動設計與驗證，涵蓋 App、人工收銀與自助結帳情境。

title.en: Turned payment, retail and operational constraints into one buildable direction
title.zh: 將付款、零售與營運限制轉化為一個可實作方向

text.en: I connected customer behaviour, POS dependencies, benefit logic, recovery needs and frontline constraints into product decisions the team could implement consistently.
text.zh: 我將顧客行為、POS 相依關係、權益邏輯、復原需求與第一線限制，轉化為團隊能一致實作的產品決策。

claim.en: In the second month after launch, the source reported approximately 129% more transactions, 116% more unique users and 26% higher average order value against an undisclosed comparison baseline.
claim.zh: 上線後第二個月，來源顯示交易數約增加 129%、不重複使用者約增加 116%、平均訂單金額約增加 26%；比較基準未公開。

claim.en: ~228k monthly transactions at 98.5% success across ~57k users by September 2021.
claim.zh: 截至 2021 年 9 月，單月約 22.8 萬筆交易，成功率達 98.5%，涵蓋約 5.7 萬名使用者。

claim.en: NPS 70.2 from 1,798 responses.
claim.zh: NPS 達 70.2，樣本為 1,798 份回覆。

claim.en: Rolled out across about 190 stores and received the 2021 Singapore User Experience Award of the Year — Retail.
claim.zh: 推展至約 190 間門市，並獲得 2021 Singapore User Experience Award of the Year — Retail。

heroVisualBrief.problemSignal: App, cashier, SCO and recovery states were fragmented

payment.transformation_zh: 從分散的門市結帳，到單一全通路付款系統

before.zh: 依通路分離的付款互動

after.en: Continuous behaviour across App, cashier and self-checkout
after.zh: 跨 App、人工收銀與自助結帳的連續行為

supportingCopy.en: By connecting customer behaviour with POS execution, benefit logic and recovery states, I gave the team a shared structure for deciding how the experience should behave across App, cashier and self-checkout.
supportingCopy.zh: 我串接顧客行為、POS 執行、權益邏輯與復原狀態，讓團隊能依據同一套結構，決定體驗在 App、人工收銀與自助結帳之間應如何運作。

payment.transformation: From fragmented in-store checkout to one omni payment system
problem_types_zh: 優惠券與會員權益不清
payment.at_glance: Led 0→1 research and end-to-end design of FairPrice’s in-store payment system, connecting App, cashier and self-checkout while integrating LinkPoints, vouchers and recovery flows across 100+ stores.
payment.at_glance_zh: 主導 FairPrice 門市付款系統的 0→1 研究與端到端設計，串接 App、人工收銀與自助結帳，並整合 LinkPoints、優惠券與失敗復原流程，推展至 100 多家門市。
payment.why: Customers moved between queue, App, cashier and self-checkout as separate experiences, while voucher and loyalty availability varied by channel and payment failures or refunds lacked one clear recovery path.
payment.why_zh: 顧客在排隊、App、人工收銀與自助結帳之間面對彼此分離的體驗；優惠券與會員權益依通路而異，付款失敗與退款也缺乏一條清楚的復原路徑。
payment.impact: Established a reusable payment standard and shared guidelines across App, POS, self-checkout and other FairPrice verticals, connecting customer checkout with frontline and internal transaction operations.
payment.impact_zh: 建立可重用的付款標準與共享規範，橫跨 App、POS、自助結帳與 FairPrice 其他產品線，串接顧客結帳、第一線與內部交易營運。

criticalProblem.en: Customers moved between queue, App, cashier and self-checkout as separate experiences, while voucher and loyalty availability varied by channel and payment failures or refunds lacked one clear recovery path.
criticalProblem.zh: 顧客在排隊、App、人工收銀與自助結帳之間面對彼此分離的體驗；優惠券與會員權益依通路而異，付款失敗與退款也缺乏一條清楚的復原路徑。

title.en: Structure one coherent transaction across App and checkout
title.zh: 建構一條貫穿 App 與結帳的完整交易

whatIDecided.en: Define one clear sequence for generating, presenting and completing payment from the App at cashier or self-checkout.
whatIDecided.zh: 定義一條清楚順序，讓顧客在 App 產生付款資訊、於人工收銀或自助結帳出示並完成付款。

whyThisChoice.en: Queue pressure and unclear QR instructions created hesitation at the most time-sensitive moment in the journey.
whyThisChoice.zh: 排隊壓力與不清楚的 QR 操作指示，會在旅程中時間最敏感的時刻造成猶豫。

content.en: The handoff crossed the customer’s device, POS/SCO state and frontline behaviour.
content.zh: 這段交接跨越顧客裝置、POS／SCO 狀態與第一線人員行為。

outcome.en: A validated and shipped handoff that made the transition between App and physical checkout understandable.
outcome.zh: 經驗證並上線的交接模式，讓 App 與實體結帳之間的轉換更容易理解。

title.en: Keep payment value visible inside the transaction
title.zh: 讓付款價值在交易中保持可見

whatIDecided.en: Surface LinkPoints, vouchers, applied discounts and payable value within payment and confirmation states.
whatIDecided.zh: 在付款與確認狀態中呈現 LinkPoints、優惠券、已套用折扣與應付金額。

whyThisChoice.en: Customers needed confidence that the benefits they expected had actually carried into the transaction.
whyThisChoice.zh: 顧客需要確信原本預期的權益確實已帶入交易。

content.en: Membership, voucher, payment and POS logic were distributed across different systems and teams.
content.zh: 會員、優惠券、付款與 POS 邏輯分布在不同系統與團隊。

outcome.en: A shipped integration that made benefits and final payable value legible at checkout.
outcome.zh: 已上線的整合方案，讓顧客能在結帳時理解權益與最終應付金額。

title.en: Treat recovery and traceability as part of payment
title.zh: 將復原與可追溯性納入付款本身

whatIDecided.en: Connect failure alternatives, transaction records and recovery paths to the same transaction model.
whatIDecided.zh: 將失敗替代方案、交易紀錄與復原路徑連接至同一套交易模型。

whyThisChoice.en: A payment problem could continue after the customer-facing error state, requiring both customers and staff to understand what happened and what came next.
whyThisChoice.zh: 付款問題可能在顧客端錯誤狀態之後持續發生，因此顧客與員工都需要理解發生了什麼及下一步。

content.en: Recovery crossed customer experience, cashier support, customer service and financial operations.
content.zh: 復原流程跨越顧客體驗、收銀支援、客服與財務營運。

outcome.en: The shipped Payment service covered customer-facing failure alternatives, recovery and refund flows, transaction records, internal transaction lookup and supporting operational workflows.
outcome.zh: 已上線的付款服務涵蓋顧客端失敗替代方案、復原與退款流程、交易紀錄、內部交易查詢及支援營運流程。

title.en: Payment crossed systems customers could not see
title.zh: 付款跨越顧客看不見的系統

description.en: A transaction could begin in the App but complete at a cashier or self-checkout, requiring several systems to behave like one continuous experience.
description.zh: 一筆交易可以從 App 開始，卻在人工收銀或自助結帳完成，因此多個系統必須呈現為一段連續體驗。

title.en: Benefits and payable value depended on separate product logic
title.zh: 權益與應付金額取決於不同產品邏輯

description.en: LinkPoints, vouchers, discounts and payment execution crossed different systems and ownership boundaries, while customers still needed one trustworthy payable state.
description.zh: LinkPoints、優惠券、折扣與付款執行跨越不同系統及責任邊界，但顧客仍需要一個可信任的應付金額狀態。

title.en: A failed payment did not end at the error screen
title.zh: 付款失敗不會停在錯誤畫面

description.en: Recovery could continue through retry, refunds, transaction records and staff support, making failure a cross-system service problem rather than a single UI state.
description.zh: 復原可能延續至重試、退款、交易紀錄與員工支援，使失敗成為跨系統服務問題，而非單一介面狀態。

latestConfirmedCorrection.summary: Migrated Payment into the canonical shared Project Detail IA with a transaction-continuity decision spine.

zh: 優惠券與會員權益不清

customerProblem.en: Customers could not easily tell which e-vouchers or coupons worked at self-checkout or cashier counters.
customerProblem.zh: 顧客難以判斷哪些電子優惠券或折價券可用於自助結帳或人工收銀。

myContribution.en: Shared research findings with Retail and Membership stakeholders.
myContribution.zh: 將研究洞察提供給 Retail 與 Membership 利害關係人。

myContribution.en: Designed the App payment-page voucher section and available-voucher selection experience.
myContribution.zh: 設計 App 付款頁的優惠券區塊與可用優惠券選擇體驗。

myContribution.en: Defined applied-discount visibility in confirmation and transaction records.
myContribution.zh: 定義確認頁與交易紀錄中的已套用折扣顯示方式。

partnerOwnership.en: Membership and Voucher teams owned eligibility rules and underlying benefit logic.
partnerOwnership.zh: Membership 與 Voucher 團隊負責資格規則與底層權益邏輯。

partnerOwnership.en: POS and engineering teams owned counter-level and backend integration.

partnerOwnership.en: Retail and store teams supported operating rules and frontline validation.
partnerOwnership.zh: Retail 與門市團隊支援營運規則與第一線驗證。

ownershipBoundary.en: This project includes checkout-level Voucher integration. Voucher discovery, Wallet organisation, Search, filters and broader eligibility systems remain owned by the Voucher / Offer parent case.
ownershipBoundary.zh: 此專案包含結帳層級的優惠券整合；優惠券探索、Wallet 整理、搜尋、篩選與更廣泛的資格系統仍歸屬 Voucher／Offer 母專案。

title.en: From fragmented requirements to one end-to-end account-opening journey
title.zh: 從分散的申請要求，到完整的線上開戶旅程

atAGlance.en: Led a two-month redesign of the end-to-end online account-opening journey, aligning fragmented requirements into one flow and delivering complete UI specifications for implementation.
atAGlance.zh: 主導為期兩個月的端到端線上開戶改版，將分散的申請要求整合為一套流程，並交付可供實作的完整介面規格。

rationale.en: Manages a stateful exchange such as payment, booking, entitlement, purchase or account completion.
rationale.zh: 管理付款、預訂、內容權限、購買或帳戶完成等具狀態的交換流程。

scope.zh: 端到端跨裝置線上開戶

primary.zh: 準備申請投資帳戶的客戶

whyItMattered.en: Applicants had to interpret fragmented requirements and move through a flow whose sequence and information needs were not consistently aligned.
whyItMattered.zh: 申請人必須自行解讀分散的要求，流程順序與資料需求也缺乏一致對齊。

businessImpact.en: Established one implementation-ready account-opening flow that aligned journey logic, interface states, and delivery specifications.
businessImpact.zh: 建立可直接實作的線上開戶流程，對齊旅程邏輯、介面狀態與交付規格。

ownership: Led internal and external discovery of existing problems
Synthesised pain points and opportunities into a customer journey
Created a concept-led user flow grounded in the existing operational process
Delivered complete UI specifications and screen-level UX explanations for client development
roleAndOwnership.teamAndStakeholderBoundary: Exact internal team, client stakeholders and development ownership need confirmation.

title.en: From isolated complaints to an end-to-end opportunity model
title.zh: 從零散抱怨，到端到端機會模型

whatIDecided.en: Combine existing research, customer pain points, traffic signals and stakeholder constraints into one journey spanning referral, identity verification, KYC, account verification and completion.
whatIDecided.zh: 將既有研究、顧客痛點、流量訊號與利害關係人限制整合成一條旅程，涵蓋推薦、身分驗證、KYC、帳戶驗證與完成。

whyThisChoice.en: Bank authentication, document upload and invisible referral binding crossed screens and teams; isolated screen redesigns could not resolve their shared causes.
whyThisChoice.zh: 銀行驗證、文件上傳與不可見的推薦綁定橫跨多個畫面與團隊；單獨改版畫面無法處理其共同成因。

title.en: From late account constraints to upfront routing and resumable stages
title.zh: 從後段才出現的帳戶限制，到前置分流與可續辦階段

whatIDecided.en: Move account requirements and preparation earlier, route applicants through bank, e-payment or paper paths, and define stage-level progress and resume behavior.
whatIDecided.zh: 將帳戶要求與準備說明前移，依銀行、電子支付或紙本路徑分流，並定義階段層級的進度與續辦行為。

whyThisChoice.en: Applicants discovered restrictions late, while authentication or system failures could otherwise force full-flow restarts.
whyThisChoice.zh: 申請人過去在後段才發現限制，而驗證或系統失敗可能迫使其重新開始整段流程。

content.en: We chose stage-level persistence over continuous field-level saving, accepting re-entry within an unfinished stage to protect feasible, compliant recovery without forcing applicants to restart the full journey. Only completed stages could be retained for one month.
content.zh: 我們選擇階段層級保存而非持續保存每個欄位，接受申請人需重新輸入未完成階段，以保護可行且符合法遵的續辦能力，避免整段旅程重來。僅已完成階段可保留一個月。

tradeOff.acceptedLoss: Applicants may need to re-enter an unfinished stage
tradeOff.protectedValue: Feasible, compliant recovery without full-flow restart
tradeOff.constraint: Only completed stages could be retained for one month

constraint.en: Only completed stages could be retained for one month.
constraint.zh: 只有已完成的階段可保留一個月。

title.en: From opaque verification failures to explicit handoffs and recovery states
title.zh: 從不透明的驗證失敗，到明確交接與復原狀態

whatIDecided.en: Define preparation, phone matching, document purpose, OCR review, retry limits, redirects and fallback actions across identity, bank and e-payment verification.
whatIDecided.zh: 針對身分、銀行與電子支付驗證，定義事前準備、電話比對、文件用途、OCR 審查、重試限制、重新導向與替代操作。

whyThisChoice.en: Generic errors and hidden external conditions prevented applicants from understanding whether to retry, change route or resume later.
whyThisChoice.zh: 通用錯誤與隱藏的外部條件，使申請人無法判斷應重試、改走其他路徑或稍後續辦。

content.en: Reduced repeated failure and abandonment risk by making external dependencies, retry boundaries and fallback actions explicit.
content.zh: 透過明確呈現外部依賴、重試邊界與替代操作，降低重複失敗與放棄申請的風險。

publicContent.confidentialityNote: *Metrics are rounded or abstracted for confidentiality.*

headline.en: Self-service account opening only worked when eligibility, path and recovery became explicit early in the journey.
headline.zh: 只有在資格、路徑與中斷後恢復方式能夠提早被說清楚時，自助開戶才真正成立。

supportingCopy.en: I reframed the experience from a sequence of application screens into a routed transaction model — clarifying which path applicants could take, what dependencies applied and how progress could recover when verification failed.
supportingCopy.zh: 我將體驗從一連串申請畫面重構為具分流的交易模型，說清楚申請人可走的路徑、適用的依賴條件，以及驗證失敗後如何恢復進度。

before.en: Fragmented account-opening requirements. Applicants had to interpret eligibility, referral, identity, document, KYC and account-verification requirements across disconnected stages and support touchpoints.
before.zh: 分散的開戶要求。申請人必須在彼此斷裂的階段與支援接觸點之間，自行理解資格、推薦、身分、文件、KYC 與帳戶驗證要求。

intervention.en: Reframed the end-to-end application flow. I synthesised research, mapped the multi-actor journey, consolidated stakeholder constraints and defined a cross-device target flow with explicit routing, stage recovery and exception handling.
intervention.zh: 重整端到端申請流程。我統整研究、描繪多角色旅程、整合利害關係人限制，並定義具明確分流、階段續辦與例外處理的跨裝置目標流程。

after.en: A clearer path to completing the application. The client received one aligned account-opening model with explicit routes, recovery states and complete UI specifications for development.
after.zh: 一條更清楚的開戶完成路徑。客戶獲得一套已對齊的開戶模型，包含明確路徑、恢復狀態與供開發使用的完整介面規格。

commonPainPoints: Cathay United Bank online-banking authentication failed or was difficult to complete.
Identity-document photography, upload and cropping were unreliable or unclear.
Referral information was not visibly carried into the application or traceable.

journeyPainPointClusters.label: Entry and expectation
examples: Applicants could not find the application entry.
Some arrived from unrelated activities without understanding the product.
Account and phone-number requirements were discovered too late.

journeyPainPointClusters.label: Identity and document capture
examples: OTP could not be received despite correct bank records.
Photo upload, cropping and camera use failed.
Generic parameter errors did not explain the failure.
The purpose of dual-ID upload and signature files was unclear.

journeyPainPointClusters.label: Forms and KYC
examples: Occupation and organisation choices were unclear for self-employed applicants.
Question volume felt excessive compared with securities onboarding.
Missing or invalid fields were not clearly anchored.

journeyPainPointClusters.label: External account authentication
examples: Available debit accounts were limited and discovered late.
External WebView and App redirects required credentials and matching phone numbers.
Forgotten credentials and time limits caused abandonment.

journeyPainPointClusters.label: Interruption and recovery
examples: Applicants could be forced to restart the full flow.
Incomplete stages and next actions were not clear.
Completion credentials and status communications were fragmented.

entryRoutes: Referral link generated by an agent
accountRoutes: Paper application fallback for applicants without an eligible account
crossDeviceCoverage: Mobile and tablet: camera capture, upload and online signature
Desktop: file upload and signature-file upload
recoveryModel: Completed stages can be saved for one month.
Applicants re-enter through identity and mobile OTP verification.
Progress view shows completed and incomplete stages.
Incomplete applicants can receive reminder communication.
External-authentication failure provides retry or later-resume paths.
exceptionCoverage: External WebView/App timeout or failed return

stakeholderConstraints.decisionEffect: Only completed stages are saved; incomplete fields within a stage are not retained. Records are retained for one month.

stakeholderConstraints.constraint: No referral-agent completion on behalf of applicants
stakeholderConstraints.decisionEffect: Stakeholders advised against agent-assisted application because of regulatory requirements.
Investment-risk information must be completed again for the investment-trust application and cannot simply be reused.
No separate high-risk-occupation journey was added; AML rejection remained rare, and manual calls for high-risk occupations were retained for audit evidence.
Cathay United Bank authentication could not be pre-opened or preserved because its link was not publicly accessible.
The flow had to prepare applicants for WebView/App redirects, credentials, matching phone numbers and explicit return actions.

included: Identity, document, OCR and signature flows
excludedOrNotPrioritised: Referral-agent application completion on behalf of customers
Reusing previously completed KYC instead of mandatory re-entry
Unconfirmed automated post-submission notifications to referral agents

publicSummary.zh: 主導顧問設計工作，從探索、路徑定義到原型與交付；客戶政策、法遵與實作決策則為共同依賴。

partnerOwned.zh: 實作與合作結束後的衡量
