intro.zh: 我主導開戶產品模型與規格交付，實作與上線仍由客戶負責。

title.en: Defined the end-to-end account-opening model
title.zh: 定義端到端線上開戶模型

text.en: Led evidence synthesis, pain-point framing, multi-actor journey construction and target-flow definition across entry, verification, routing and recovery.
text.zh: 主導證據統整、痛點定義、多角色旅程建構，以及入口、驗證、分流與續辦的目標流程定義。

title.en: Turned constraints into development-ready product direction
title.zh: 將限制轉化為可供開發的產品方向

text.en: Aligned operational, compliance and technical constraints into explicit flow states, recovery behavior and complete UI specifications while leaving final implementation and launch with the client.
text.zh: 將營運、法遵與技術限制對齊為明確的流程狀態、續辦行為與完整介面規格；最終實作與上線仍由客戶負責。

claim.en: Delivered a validated multi-route, cross-device account-opening model with KYC, OCR, bank, e-payment, paper and resume paths.
claim.zh: 交付經驗證的多路徑、跨裝置開戶模型，涵蓋 KYC、OCR、銀行帳戶、電子支付、紙本與續填路徑。

claim.en: Post-launch metrics were outside the consulting engagement.
claim.zh: 上線後指標不在本次顧問合作範圍內。

heroVisualBrief.problemSignal: Multiple identity and funding routes lacked continuity
heroVisualBrief.systemSignal: Route selection, KYC/OCR and stage-level resume

after.en: A clearer path to completing the application
after.zh: 使用者能依清楚順序完成申請

supportingCopy.en: I aligned fragmented requirements into one end-to-end flow and translated it into complete interface specifications for delivery.
supportingCopy.zh: 我將分散的申請要求對齊成一條端到端流程，並轉化為可交付的完整介面規格。

cathay-sit-online-account-opening.transformation: From fragmented requirements to one end-to-end account-opening journey
cathay-sit-online-account-opening.transformation_zh: 從分散的申請要求，到完整的線上開戶旅程
cathay-sit-online-account-opening.at_glance: Led a two-month redesign of the end-to-end online account-opening journey, aligning fragmented requirements into one flow and delivering complete UI specifications for implementation.
cathay-sit-online-account-opening.at_glance_zh: 主導為期兩個月的端到端線上開戶改版，將分散的申請要求整合為一套流程，並交付可供實作的完整介面規格。
cathay-sit-online-account-opening.why: Applicants had to interpret fragmented requirements and move through a flow whose sequence and information needs were not consistently aligned.
cathay-sit-online-account-opening.why_zh: 申請人必須自行解讀分散的要求，流程順序與資料需求也缺乏一致對齊。
cathay-sit-online-account-opening.impact: Established one implementation-ready account-opening flow that aligned journey logic, interface states, and delivery specifications.
cathay-sit-online-account-opening.impact_zh: 建立可直接實作的線上開戶流程，對齊旅程邏輯、介面狀態與交付規格。

cardTitle.zh: 重整端到端線上開戶流程

criticalProblem.en: Applicants had to interpret fragmented requirements and move through a flow whose sequence and information needs were not consistently aligned.
criticalProblem.zh: 申請人必須自行解讀分散的要求，流程順序與資料需求也缺乏一致對齊。

headline.en: In two months, I delivered one end-to-end account-opening flow and complete implementation-ready UI specifications.
headline.zh: 在兩個月內，我完成一條端到端開戶流程，以及可直接實作的完整介面規格。

supportingStatement.en: The work aligned fragmented applicant requirements, interface states and implementation logic.
supportingStatement.zh: 這項工作對齊分散的申請要求、介面狀態與實作邏輯。

title.en: From isolated complaints to an end-to-end opportunity model
title.zh: 從零散抱怨，到端到端機會模型

whatIDecided.en: Combine existing research, customer pain points, traffic signals and stakeholder constraints into one journey spanning referral, identity verification, KYC, account verification and completion.
whatIDecided.zh: 將既有研究、顧客痛點、流量訊號與利害關係人限制整合成一條旅程，涵蓋推薦、身分驗證、KYC、帳戶驗證與完成。

whyThisChoice.en: Bank authentication, document upload and invisible referral binding crossed screens and teams; isolated screen redesigns could not resolve their shared causes.
whyThisChoice.zh: 銀行驗證、文件上傳與不可見的推薦綁定橫跨多個畫面與團隊；單獨改版畫面無法處理其共同成因。

title.en: From late account constraints to upfront routing and resumable stages
title.zh: 從後段才出現的帳戶限制，到前置分流與可續辦階段

whatIDecided.en: Move account requirements and preparation earlier, route applicants through bank, e-payment or paper paths, and define stage-level progress and resume behavior.
whatIDecided.zh: 將帳戶要求與準備說明前移，依銀行、電子支付或紙本路徑分流，並定義階段層級的進度與續辦行為。

whyThisChoice.en: Applicants discovered restrictions late, while authentication or system failures could otherwise force full-flow restarts.
whyThisChoice.zh: 申請人過去在後段才發現限制，而驗證或系統失敗可能迫使其重新開始整段流程。

content.en: We chose stage-level persistence over continuous field-level saving, accepting re-entry within an unfinished stage to protect feasible, compliant recovery without forcing applicants to restart the full journey. Only completed stages could be retained for one month.
content.zh: 我們選擇階段層級保存而非持續保存每個欄位，接受申請人需重新輸入未完成階段，以保護可行且符合法遵的續辦能力，避免整段旅程重來。僅已完成階段可保留一個月。

tradeOff.acceptedLoss: Applicants may need to re-enter an unfinished stage
tradeOff.protectedValue: Feasible, compliant recovery without full-flow restart
tradeOff.constraint: Only completed stages could be retained for one month

constraint.en: Only completed stages could be retained for one month.
constraint.zh: 只有已完成的階段可保留一個月。

title.en: From opaque verification failures to explicit handoffs and recovery states
title.zh: 從不透明的驗證失敗，到明確交接與復原狀態

whatIDecided.en: Define preparation, phone matching, document purpose, OCR review, retry limits, redirects and fallback actions across identity, bank and e-payment verification.
whatIDecided.zh: 針對身分、銀行與電子支付驗證，定義事前準備、電話比對、文件用途、OCR 審查、重試限制、重新導向與替代操作。

whyThisChoice.en: Generic errors and hidden external conditions prevented applicants from understanding whether to retry, change route or resume later.
whyThisChoice.zh: 通用錯誤與隱藏的外部條件，使申請人無法判斷應重試、改走其他路徑或稍後續辦。

content.en: Reduced repeated failure and abandonment risk by making external dependencies, retry boundaries and fallback actions explicit.
content.zh: 透過明確呈現外部依賴、重試邊界與替代操作，降低重複失敗與放棄申請的風險。

statusAndDisclosure.renderRule: Resolve only fields that exist; do not synthesize missing claims.

title.en: Critical requirements appeared after applicants had already invested effort
title.zh: 關鍵要求往往在申請人投入大量操作後才出現

description.en: Eligibility, account and document constraints were distributed across stages, making it difficult to know which route was viable before starting.
description.zh: 資格、帳戶與文件限制分散在不同階段，使申請人難以在開始前判斷哪條路徑可行。

title.en: Verification depended on external systems, redirects and device handoffs
title.zh: 驗證依賴外部系統、重新導向與裝置交接

description.en: Identity checks, OCR, OTP, bank authentication and external-service redirects created failure points that could interrupt or invalidate progress.
description.zh: 身分檢查、OCR、OTP、銀行驗證與外部服務重新導向形成多個可能中斷或使進度失效的節點。

title.en: Applicants could not reliably distinguish retry, alternate route or later resume
title.zh: 申請人無法可靠判斷應重試、改走其他路徑或稍後續辦

description.en: Generic errors and hidden external conditions made recovery ambiguous when verification, account matching or document checks failed.
description.zh: 當驗證、帳戶比對或文件檢查失敗時，通用錯誤與隱藏的外部條件使恢復方式不明確。

whatThisProves.en: Translating account-opening research into an end-to-end transaction flow and implementation-ready specification.
whatThisProves.zh: 將開戶研究轉化為端到端交易流程與可直接落地的設計規格。

impactEvidence.shippedProof: Research/journey, end-to-end user flow and UI specification delivered.
impactEvidence.recommendedHeadline: Translated account-opening research into an end-to-end transaction flow and implementation-ready UI specification.
impactEvidence.boundary: No verified completion/conversion metric in current evidence.

relationship.relationshipDescription: A separate internal-operations project for the same account-opening service. Keep the customer-facing redesign and internal review/remediation operations as sibling cases.

title.en: Fragmented review knowledge to a shared remediation operating model
title.zh: 從分散的審件知識，到共享的補件營運模型

atAGlance.en: As Lead Product Designer (independent consultant), I led workflow reconstruction and prioritisation across the review-remediation operating model, turning fragmented operational knowledge into a shared baseline and phased direction over a five-month engagement.
atAGlance.zh: 身為首席產品設計師（獨立顧問），我主導審件補件營運模型的流程重建與優先排序，並在五個月的合作期間，將分散的營運知識轉化為共享基線與分階段方向。

rationale.en: Coordinates internal roles, rules, approvals, exceptions or operational decisions.
rationale.zh: 協調內部角色、規則、核准、例外或營運決策。

scope.zh: 端到端審件補件營運模型

whyItMattered.en: Review and remediation logic was distributed across people, documents, systems and handoffs, preventing staff from verifying one end-to-end operating model.
whyItMattered.zh: 審件與補件邏輯分散在人員、文件、系統與交接之間，使內部人員無法驗證一套端到端營運模型。

businessImpact.en: Established a shared operating reference for review and remediation, reducing dependency on fragmented documents and individual memory.
businessImpact.zh: 建立審件與補件的共同營運參考，降低對分散文件與個人記憶的依賴。

ownedWork: Planned and facilitated the internal workshop
Collected operational feedback from review and development participants
Synthesised existing research and workshop findings
Mapped the complete current-state operating process
Analysed pain points and opportunity areas
Separated expected benefit from implementation difficulty
Produced recommendations and an initial future-state flow
Created a reusable process map for Product Manager phase planning
roleAndOwnership.stakeholderModel: One full-team workshop, followed by two one-hour online workflow interviews. Primary interview participants included two core users and one supervisor.

operationalScale.phaseCountNote: The detailed flow labels Phase 2 as 2-1 and 2-2; public copy treats the programme as five major phases.

manualReviewSignal.definition: Manual review duration shown in the workshop board
manualReviewSignal.publicTreatment: Use approximately and only with client approval.

sourceReportedFailureSignals.definitionStatus: The source labels these values as failure rates, but the denominator and time period require confirmation before public use.
sourceReportedFailureSignals.publicUse: Do not publish as a complete distribution until denominator, date range and category overlap are confirmed.

majorPainPointClusters.label: Document and data review
evidence: Reviewers switched between pages to compare documents and entered data

majorPainPointClusters.label: External screening dependencies
evidence: Judicial website outages and scheduled-task failures
AML scans could take a long time
Common names required extended manual research
Results were stored separately and required page switching

majorPainPointClusters.label: Manual risk and list review
evidence: High-risk approval crossed departments and remained paper-heavy
Problem lists required record-by-record validation and notes
Reviewers used external search and manually documented decisions

majorPainPointClusters.label: System handoff and stock transfer
evidence: Stock-system import supported only five records at a time
Concurrent reviewers queued to avoid import errors
Address and employee-number corrections were tracked in notes and fixed later

majorPainPointClusters.label: Customer remediation and status
evidence: Applicants could not see detailed review progress
Remediation SMS did not take applicants directly to the failed step
Applicants had to re-enter the journey and search for the error
Long review times could cause applicants to miss an investment window

method: Mapped the existing review and remediation journey
Voted on the five highest-impact pain points
Synthesised recommendations into benefit and feasibility groups

topPainPointsByExpectedBenefit.issue: AML scan time and common-name manual review
Remediation judgement and direct return to the failed step
Lack of detailed applicant review status
Stock-system import limited to five records and queueing

opportunitiesByEase.opportunity: Keyword filtering for low- and medium-risk companies and occupations
OCR and document validation during application
Customer information cards and review-result filtering
Simplify manual comparison by review priority

workshopEvidence.publicMetricBoundary: Scores are internal workshop prioritisation evidence and should normally be abstracted into relative positions rather than published as exact values.

expectedBenefitOrder: Shorten automated review and approval time
Simplify and clarify applicant status communication
executionDifficultyOrderLowToHigh: Notify referral agents about remediation status
Automatically classify lists and reduce manual review
Digitise the complete internal review process
priorityModel.recommendationStatus: Workshop-based recommendation; not confirmed as an approved delivery roadmap.

opportunities: Keyword filtering for occupation and company risk

recommendedPhases.focus: Reduce repetitive manual review and operational handoffs
Digitise and connect the internal review operating model

title.en: From distributed know-how to a verifiable end-to-end operating model
title.zh: 從分散在個人經驗的做法，到可驗證的端到端營運模式

whatIDecided.en: Mapped the actual five-phase review journey across people, internal systems, external databases, paper approvals, exceptions and customer remediation.
whatIDecided.zh: 盤點實際五階段審件旅程，涵蓋角色、內部系統、外部資料庫、紙本簽核、例外情境與顧客補件。

whyThisChoice.en: The Product Manager could not reliably identify breakpoints or sequence optimisation while the process depended on separate screenshots, PDFs, notes and individual memory.
whyThisChoice.zh: 當流程依賴分散的截圖、PDF、筆記與個人記憶時，產品經理無法可靠辨識斷點或安排優化順序。

evidence.en: The detailed process map documents roles, systems, decisions, success paths, remediation, high-risk approval and failure branches.
evidence.zh: 詳細流程圖記錄角色、系統、決策、成功路徑、補件、高風險核准與失敗分支。

title.en: From equal-weight feedback to benefit-and-feasibility prioritisation
title.zh: 從等權重回饋，到依效益與可行性排序

whatIDecided.en: Structured the workshop so participants first selected the highest-impact pain points, then rated opportunity difficulty separately before recommendations were synthesised.
whatIDecided.zh: 先從工作坊選出高影響痛點，再獨立評估改善機會的難度，最後才統整建議。

whyThisChoice.en: Operational urgency and engineering effort were being discussed together, making high-value problems difficult to distinguish from easy-to-build ideas.
whyThisChoice.zh: 營運急迫性與工程投入原本被混在一起討論，導致高價值問題與容易開發的想法難以區分。

evidence.en: The results exposed a wide feasibility range: keyword risk filtering was rated relatively accessible, while direct internal-system approval was the hardest opportunity.
evidence.zh: 結果顯示可行性差異明顯：關鍵字風險篩選相對容易，直接串接內部核准系統則最困難。

title.en: From all-at-once digitisation to phased optimisation recommendations
title.zh: 從一次完成全面數位化，到分階段優化建議

whatIDecided.en: Recommended sequencing input-quality and transparency improvements before list automation, stock-system optimisation and full internal-review digitisation.
whatIDecided.zh: 建議先改善輸入品質與透明度，再推進清單自動化、庫存系統優化與完整內部審查數位化。

whyThisChoice.en: The workshop showed that high-benefit structural changes also carried the greatest implementation difficulty, while several narrower interventions could reduce friction earlier.
whyThisChoice.zh: 工作坊顯示，高效益的結構性改善同時具有最高實作難度；較聚焦的介入則能更早降低操作阻力。

decisionStatusNote.en: The phased model was delivered as a planning recommendation. Client approval, implementation sequence and outcomes remain unconfirmed.
decisionStatusNote.zh: 分階段模型以規劃建議形式交付；客戶核准、實作順序與成果尚未確認。

label.zh: 未來營運模式・尚未實作

summary.en: The proposed future flow connected automated screening, internal review, customer remediation and stock-system handoff, but the workshop deck explicitly marked detailed content as pending team confirmation.
summary.zh: 提案中的未來流程串接自動篩選、內部審查、顧客補件與庫存系統交接，但工作坊資料明確標示細節仍待團隊確認。

claimBoundary: Do not present the ideal flow as approved or shipped.
Do not imply that AML, judicial checks or stock-system transfer were fully automated.
Do not claim the recommendation determined the final delivery sequence without confirmation.

title.en: My contribution
title.zh: 我的貢獻

summary.en: I turned staff knowledge and existing evidence into a shared operating model, facilitated prioritisation and delivered recommendations the Product Manager could use to plan optimisation phases.
summary.zh: 我將內部同仁經驗與既有證據轉化為共享營運模式，主持優先排序，並交付可供產品經理安排優化階段的建議。

proof.label: DISCOVERY
proof.content: Collected and synthesised current operational pain points.

proof.label: SYSTEM
proof.content: Mapped the complete current-state workflow, systems, roles and exceptions.

proof.label: FACILITATION
proof.content: Separated expected benefit from implementation difficulty through workshop voting.

proof.label: DIRECTION
proof.content: Translated findings into phased optimisation recommendations.

publicContent.confidentialityNote: *For confidentiality reasons, exact metrics are not disclosed.*

title.en: Research focused on the workflow staff used most often
title.zh: 研究聚焦於內部人員最常執行的流程

summary.en: A full-team workshop identified shared issues; two one-hour screen-led interviews then reconstructed the routine process covering more than 80% of normal cases.
summary.zh: 先以一次全團隊工作坊彙整共同問題，再透過兩次各一小時、以畫面為引導的訪談，重建涵蓋 80% 以上日常案件的主要流程。

headline.en: Review remediation needed a shared internal operating model before it needed more screens.
headline.zh: 審件補件改善，首先需要的是共享的內部營運模型，而不是更多畫面。

supportingCopy.en: I reframed the work from isolated interface and process issues into one internal operating model — making roles, systems, exception paths and remediation handoffs visible before prioritising improvements.
supportingCopy.zh: 我將工作從分散的介面與流程問題，重新定義為一套內部營運模型；在排序改善方向前，先讓角色、系統、例外路徑與補件交接變得可見。

title.en: Research & operating-model evidence
title.zh: 研究與營運模型證據

title.en: Research coverage
title.zh: 研究涵蓋

copy.en: Research reconstructed the routine review and remediation flow before the operating model was defined.
copy.zh: 研究先重建日常審件與補件流程，再據此定義營運模型。

title.en: Operating-model complexity
title.zh: 營運模型複雜度

copy.en: Reconstructed roles, systems, decision points and remediation handoffs into one end-to-end operating view.
copy.zh: 將角色、系統、決策點與補件交接重建為一套端到端營運視圖。

title.en: Benefit-and-feasibility prioritisation
title.zh: 效益與可行性排序

copy.en: Separated expected benefit from implementation difficulty to make meaningful priority differences visible.
copy.zh: 將預期效益與實作難度分開，使有意義的優先差異清楚可見。

title.en: Phased direction
title.zh: 分階段方向

copy.en: Sequenced opportunities into near-, mid- and long-term recommendations rather than one undifferentiated digitisation scope.
copy.zh: 將機會排序為近、中、長期建議，而非一個未分化的數位化範圍。

title.en: Research coverage
title.zh: 研究涵蓋

intro.en: The interviews reconstructed routine review and remediation flows described as representing more than 80% of normal case-flow coverage.
intro.zh: 訪談重建日常審件與補件流程；來源描述這些流程涵蓋超過 80% 的一般案件流程。

supportingCopy.en: Shared operational issues
supportingCopy.zh: 彙整共同營運問題

supportingCopy.en: Screen-led walkthroughs
supportingCopy.zh: 以畫面引導的流程走查

supportingCopy.en: Two core users and one supervisor
supportingCopy.zh: 兩位核心使用者與一位主管

supportingCopy.en: Coverage evidence, not a performance metric
supportingCopy.zh: 涵蓋證據，非績效指標

mappingTitle.en: From workflow evidence to prioritised direction
mappingTitle.zh: 從流程證據到完成優先排序的方向

heading.en: Reconstructed the end-to-end operating model
heading.zh: 重建端到端營運模型

summary.en: Connected customer submission, early review, AML screening, high-risk approval, remediation, resubmission and re-review into one shared five-phase model.
summary.zh: 將客戶提交、初步審件、防制洗錢篩查、高風險核准、補件、重新提交與再審核，連結成共享的五階段模型。

heading.en: Mapped what each review step depended on
heading.zh: 盤點每個審件步驟的依賴

summary.en: Connected screens, systems, logic, inputs and handoffs across AML tools, internal transaction management, external lookups, PDF case lists, SMS, local notes and paper approvals.
summary.zh: 串連防制洗錢工具、內部交易管理、外部查詢、PDF 案件清單、簡訊、在地筆記與紙本核准中的畫面、系統、邏輯、輸入與交接。

heading.en: Made exception and recovery paths explicit
heading.zh: 明確呈現例外與復原路徑

summary.en: Mapped failed checks, incomplete documents, additional-document requests, customer resubmission, re-review and high-risk approval as part of the normal operating model rather than edge cases outside it.
summary.zh: 將檢核失敗、文件不完整、追加文件要求、客戶重新提交、再審核與高風險核准，納入正常營運模型，而非視為模型之外的邊緣情況。

heading.en: Separated value from implementation difficulty
heading.zh: 將價值與實作難度分開

summary.en: Workshop findings were assessed by expected benefit and implementation difficulty separately, making high-value structural problems visible without treating every idea as equally urgent.
summary.zh: 將工作坊發現分別依預期效益與實作難度評估，使高價值結構性問題可見，且不把每個想法視為同等急迫。

heading.en: Turned the operating model into phased recommendations
heading.zh: 將營運模型轉化為分階段建議

summary.en: Grouped opportunities into near-, mid- and long-term recommendations. This was recommendation scope; implementation remained client-owned.
summary.zh: 將機會整理為近、中、長期建議；此處為建議範圍，實作仍由客戶負責。

title.en: Outcomes
title.zh: 成果

headline.en: Established a shared basis for improving review remediation without overstating implementation.
headline.zh: 建立改善審件補件的共同基礎，同時不誇大實作狀態。

heading.en: A shared operating model
heading.zh: 共享的營運模型

copy.en: Established a reviewable end-to-end representation of the remediation workflow and its handoffs.
copy.zh: 建立可供檢視的端到端補件流程與交接模型。

heading.en: Defensible prioritisation
heading.zh: 可辯護的優先排序

copy.en: Created a clearer basis for comparing remediation opportunities by benefit and feasibility.
copy.zh: 建立更清楚的基礎，依效益與可行性比較補件改善機會。

heading.en: Phased product direction
heading.zh: 分階段產品方向

copy.en: Translated research findings into sequenced optimisation recommendations rather than one undifferentiated digitisation scope.
copy.zh: 將研究發現轉化為有順序的優化建議，而非單一、未分化的數位化範圍。

closing.en: These are delivered definition and recommendation outcomes; implementation, adoption and post-launch metrics remained outside the engagement.
closing.zh: 以上為已交付的定義與建議成果；實作、採用與上線後數據不在本次合作範圍內。

hero.purpose: Communicate operational complexity and the delivered system view within five seconds.
hero.recommendedContent: A public redraw of the five-phase review and remediation operating model, showing people, internal systems, external checks and major handoffs.

operatingBaseline.purpose: Prove the depth of current-state discovery.
operatingBaseline.recommendedContent: A simplified map of the five pain-point clusters with a small system inventory and selected manual handoffs.
operatingBaseline.avoid: Exact customer names, internal screen captures, database paths or dense source notes.

workshopPrioritisation.purpose: Show how competing opinions became an evidence-based priority model.
workshopPrioritisation.recommendedContent: A public impact-versus-feasibility matrix using relative positions, not exact participant scores.
workshopPrioritisation.avoid: Participant names and exact internal vote markers.

futureRoadmap.purpose: Show sequencing rather than a speculative future-state screen.
futureRoadmap.recommendedContent: Three phases: input quality and transparency, manual-review reduction, connected internal digitisation.
futureRoadmap.avoid: Presenting the ideal workshop flow as approved or shipped.

detailedProcessProof.recommendedContent: Two zoomed and redrawn excerpts: early review/AML and remediation/high-risk handling.
detailedProcessProof.avoid: Publishing the complete raw flow as one unreadable image.

strengths: AML, high-risk approval and remediation complexity
Clear separation of delivered research and unimplemented future direction
remainingGaps: Client adoption of the process map, if publicly disclosable
Approved optimisation phases, if publicly disclosable
Meaning and denominator of source-reported failure rates
Public-safe redraws of the operating model and prioritisation
principalReadinessAudit.outcomeBoundary: Implementation metrics are unavailable due to the external consulting boundary and are not treated as a completeness gap.

processMappingPhase.observationFocus: Participants walked through the standard review and remediation workflow on screen. The mapping focused on routine cases representing more than 80% of normal case volume.

researchCoverage.participantBoundary: The three primary participants refer to the interview phase: two core users and one supervisor. The full-team workshop headcount is not disclosed.

publicSummary.en: Created a reusable current-state operating baseline and priority model that the Product Manager could use to identify breakpoints and plan optimisation phases.
publicSummary.zh: 建立可重用的目前狀態營運基準與優先順序模型，讓產品經理能辨識斷點並安排優化階段。

zh: 受監管審件與補件營運

en: How do you map a complex internal review process?

如何設計 AML 補件流程？

confidentialityNote.en: *Post-launch metrics were not available within the consulting engagement; outcomes are reported through validated decisions and delivered system change.*
confidentialityNote.zh: *受接案合作範圍限制，無法取得上線後數據；成果以已驗證決策與實際交付的系統改變呈現。*

publicSummary.en: Led workshop analysis, interviews, process mapping and operating-model definition; implementation priority and organisational adoption remained client decisions.
publicSummary.zh: 主導工作坊分析、訪談、流程對應與營運模型定義；實作優先順序與組織採用則由客戶決定。

intro.en: I owned the operating-model reconstruction and prioritisation direction; roadmap, implementation and adoption remained client-owned.
intro.zh: 我負責營運模型重建與優先排序方向；路線圖、實作與採用仍由客戶負責。

title.en: Built the operating model behind the review and remediation system
title.zh: 建立審件與補件系統背後的營運模型

text.en: Led workflow interviews, workshop synthesis and current-state reconstruction across roles, systems, decision logic, remediation paths and operational handoffs.
text.zh: 主導流程訪談、工作坊統整與目前狀態重建，涵蓋角色、系統、決策邏輯、補件路徑與營運交接。

title.en: Turned operational complexity into prioritised planning direction
title.zh: 將營運複雜度轉化為優先規劃方向

text.en: Structured benefit/feasibility prioritisation and translated the shared operating baseline into phased recommendations while keeping roadmap and implementation ownership with the client.
text.zh: 建立效益／可行性排序，並將共享營運基準轉化為分階段建議，同時保留路線圖與實作由客戶負責。

claim.en: Two screen-led interviews with two core users and one supervisor focused the operating model on the routine flows representing more than 80% of work.
claim.zh: 2 位核心使用者與 1 位主管的兩場畫面導向訪談，使營運模型聚焦於占工作量 80% 以上的日常流程。

claim.en: Delivered a reusable process baseline and priority model for client planning.
claim.zh: 交付可重用的流程基準與優先順序模型，供客戶後續規劃。

heroVisualBrief.problemSignal: Review and remediation work was difficult to prioritise consistently
heroVisualBrief.systemSignal: Routine path, exception path and priority model

before.en: Review logic, exceptions and handoffs were distributed across individual memory, screenshots, PDFs, external lookups and manual operational practices.
before.zh: 審件邏輯、例外與交接分散於個人記憶、截圖、PDF、外部查詢與人工營運做法。

intervention.en: I led workflow interviews, workshop synthesis and process reconstruction to connect roles, systems, decision logic, inputs, handoffs and remediation paths into one verifiable model.
intervention.zh: 我主導流程訪談、工作坊統整與流程重建，將角色、系統、決策邏輯、輸入、交接與補件路徑連結成一套可驗證模型。

after.en: The team had a shared five-phase operating baseline, clearer exception visibility and a structured way to separate expected benefit from implementation difficulty.
after.zh: 團隊取得共享的五階段營運基準、更清楚的例外可視性，以及區分預期效益與實作難度的結構化方法。

supportingCopy.en: Built a shared operating baseline before defining optimisation direction; no software implementation is implied.
supportingCopy.zh: 先建立共享營運基準，再定義優化方向；不代表軟體已實作。

cathay-sit-review-remediation-operations.transformation: From fragmented review knowledge to a shared remediation operating model
cathay-sit-review-remediation-operations.transformation_zh: 從分散的審件知識，到共享的補件營運模型
cathay-sit-review-remediation-operations.at_glance: Led research synthesis and operating-model definition for an internal review and remediation workflow, turning fragmented operational knowledge into a traceable five-phase baseline and prioritised optimisation recommendations.
cathay-sit-review-remediation-operations.at_glance_zh: 主導內部審件與補件流程的研究統整與營運模型定義，將分散的營運知識轉化為可追溯的五階段基準與完成優先排序的優化建議。
cathay-sit-review-remediation-operations.why: Review and remediation logic was distributed across people, documents, systems and handoffs, preventing staff from verifying one end-to-end operating model.
cathay-sit-review-remediation-operations.why_zh: 審件與補件邏輯分散在人員、文件、系統與交接之間，使內部人員無法驗證一套端到端營運模型。
cathay-sit-review-remediation-operations.impact: Established a shared operating model for internal review, document requests, customer resubmission and re-review.
cathay-sit-review-remediation-operations.impact_zh: 建立涵蓋內部審件、文件要求、客戶重新提交與再審核的共享營運模型。

cardTitle.en: Clarifying the review and remediation journey

criticalProblem.en: Review knowledge was fragmented across people, documents, systems and handoffs, preventing the team from seeing one verifiable end-to-end operating journey.
criticalProblem.zh: 審件知識分散在人員、文件、系統與交接之間，使團隊無法看見一條可驗證的端到端營運旅程。

title.en: From distributed know-how to a verifiable end-to-end operating model
title.zh: 從分散經驗，到可驗證的端到端營運模型

whatIDecided.en: Make the remediation workflow explicit across review, document request, customer resubmission and re-review so the process could be evaluated as one operating system rather than disconnected tasks.
whatIDecided.zh: 明確呈現審件、文件要求、客戶重新提交與再審核的補件流程，使整體能以一套營運系統評估，而非彼此分離的工作。

whyThisChoice.en: The work could not be prioritised reliably while critical steps, ownership and handoffs remained implicit or distributed across teams.
whyThisChoice.zh: 當關鍵步驟、責任歸屬與交接仍隱含或分散於團隊之間時，工作無法被可靠排序。

content.en: Reconstruct roles, systems, inputs, logic and handoffs before evaluating optimisation opportunities.
content.zh: 在評估優化機會前，先重建角色、系統、輸入、邏輯與交接。

title.en: From equal-weight feedback to benefit-and-feasibility prioritisation
title.zh: 從等權重回饋，到依效益與可行性排序

whatIDecided.en: Structure findings so improvement opportunities could be compared by likely benefit and feasibility rather than treated as an undifferentiated list of issues.
whatIDecided.zh: 將研究發現結構化，使改善機會可依可能效益與可行性比較，而非被視為未分化的問題清單。

whyThisChoice.en: The research surfaced multiple problems, but the organisation needed a defensible way to decide what deserved attention first.
whyThisChoice.zh: 研究揭露多項問題，但組織需要一套可辯護的方法，決定哪些問題應優先處理。

title.en: From all-at-once digitisation to phased optimisation recommendations
title.zh: 從一次完成全面數位化，到分階段優化建議

whatIDecided.en: Translate the operating-model findings into phased recommendations rather than assuming the entire remediation flow should be digitised at once.
whatIDecided.zh: 將營運模型發現轉化為分階段建議，而非假設整個補件流程應一次全面數位化。

whyThisChoice.en: Different problems depended on different operational, policy or system foundations; they could not credibly be represented as one immediate implementation scope.
whyThisChoice.zh: 不同問題依賴不同的營運、政策或系統基礎，無法可信地被呈現為單一立即實作範圍。

content.en: The engagement could recommend sequence and opportunity areas, but final roadmap priority, implementation and adoption remained client-owned.
content.zh: 本次合作可建議順序與機會領域，但最終路線圖優先順序、實作與採用仍由客戶負責。

statusAndDisclosure.renderRule: Resolve only fields that exist; do not synthesize missing claims.

headline.en: Built a shared operating baseline
headline.zh: 建立共享的營運基準

supportingStatement.en: Led workflow reconstruction and prioritisation without implying implemented software.
supportingStatement.zh: 主導流程重建與優先排序，不暗示軟體已實作。

title.en: Distributed operating knowledge
title.zh: 營運知識分散

description.en: The remediation process existed across people, steps, documents and tacit operational knowledge rather than one verifiable end-to-end model.
description.zh: 補件流程分散在人員、步驟、文件與隱性營運知識中，而非一套可驗證的端到端模型。

title.en: Feedback had unequal value
title.zh: 回饋價值並不相等

description.en: Issues and opportunities could not be treated as equally important; prioritisation needed to balance expected benefit and feasibility.
description.zh: 問題與機會不能被視為同等重要；優先排序必須同時衡量預期效益與可行性。

title.en: Full digitisation was not a credible immediate assumption
title.zh: 全面數位化並非可信的立即假設

description.en: Recommendations needed to distinguish what could be improved first from what required deeper operational or system change.
description.zh: 建議必須區分可先改善的項目，以及需要更深層營運或系統變革的項目。

whatThisProves.en: Diagnosing operational breakdowns across screens, system logic, inputs and handoffs before solutioning.
whatThisProves.zh: 在進入解法前，辨識畫面、系統邏輯、輸入與交接中的營運斷點。

impactEvidence.recommendedHeadline: Mapped the end-to-end remediation operation and separated screen issues from system, input and handoff breakdowns.
impactEvidence.boundary: Recommendation/definition outcome; no verified efficiency uplift.

title.en: Building one self-service mortgage application from fragmented application tasks
title.zh: 將分散的申請任務整合為單一房貸自助申請

atAGlance.en: Led the 0→1 product design of an in-app mortgage application, restructuring fragmented information into a staged, resumable journey that supported contextual entry, related-party participation and regulated guidance.
atAGlance.zh: 主導 App 內房貸申請的 0→1 產品設計，將分散資訊重整為可分階段、可續辦的旅程，支援情境式進入、關係人參與與受監管的資訊引導。

rationale.en: Establishes a new product capability and application model where no equivalent self-service journey previously existed.
rationale.zh: 建立先前不存在的自助申請產品能力與申請模型。

scope.zh: 端到端 App 內房貸申請

whyItMattered.en: Mortgage applications were split across web and paper channels, making entry points, applicant responsibilities, and progress difficult to understand.
whyItMattered.zh: 房貸申請分散在網站與紙本管道，使申請入口、角色責任與進度難以理解。

businessImpact.en: Established one implementation-ready mortgage application model that reduced dependency on separate web and paper journey logic.
businessImpact.zh: 建立一套可直接實作的房貸申請模型，降低對網站與紙本獨立旅程邏輯的依賴。

ownedWork: Problem statement, design vision and design principles
Application interruption, session and resume logic
Field grouping, purpose explanations and confirmation behaviour
Document, guarantor and post-submission follow-up model
roleAndOwnership.teamBoundary: PM, Engineering, compliance and client stakeholder roles need confirmation.

canonicalSources.coverage: Three user-entry mindsets, problem statement, design vision and design principles

canonicalSources.filename: 中信房貸 - 決策流程地圖 （自用）2.pdf
canonicalSources.coverage: Existing web/paper pain points, stakeholder constraints, design questions, proposed flow and delivery planning
Updated end-to-end app flow, UI states, applicant branches, related-party flows, session recovery and result states

sourceEvidence.visualReview: All three oversized single-page PDFs were rendered at reduced scale and visually inspected.

entryRoutes.label: Direct application
entryRoutes.mindset: Already decided to apply and wants to begin without further persuasion.
entryRoutes.experienceImplication: Fast start, clear stages and no repeated confirmation.

entryRoutes.label: Calculator or comparison entry
entryRoutes.mindset: Has tested scenarios and wants to reduce decision risk.
entryRoutes.experienceImplication: Carry forward calculator context and avoid repeated entry.

entryRoutes.label: Relationship-manager referral
entryRoutes.mindset: Expects assistance and believes part of the application may already be prepared.
entryRoutes.experienceImplication: Preserve referral context, prefill known information and keep help visible.

userModel.problemStatement: Applicants had often chosen the bank before entering the application, but uncertainty about effort and outcome delayed or interrupted completion.
userModel.designVision: Turn mortgage application from a high-pressure decision flow into a predictable, controllable and reassuring experience.
designPrinciples: Lower the psychological cost of starting
Make the process and remaining work predictable
Explain why important fields are required and what they affect
Break the application into achievable steps
Preserve existing decisions, referral context and known data

channelProblem: The app was a new application capability rather than a simple visual refresh.

highFrictionAreas.evidence: Property, loan purpose, repayment model, related parties and consent were mixed in one high-drop-off area.
The page was long, interruption caused re-entry, and field labels or purposes were not sufficiently clear.
Applicants did not understand whether the banking-law relationship information was required, and marital-state logic could show irrelevant fields.
Terms were scattered across loan, related-person and confirmation pages and had to be accepted again on return.
Editing returned users to the start of the application area rather than the relevant section.
Requiring documents during the main application could block users who were applying during commutes or without paperwork at hand.
Result pages did not make next actions, missing documents or process status sufficiently clear.

applicantBranches: Existing mortgage customers and other deposit customers
Main applicants with or without co-borrowers or guarantors
Applicants with or without a financial credential
coreCapabilities: Preparation page with process, time and document expectations
Three entry routes with preserved context
New and existing customer identity flows
Application saving, session handling and resumption
State-based result, document and progress pages
resultStateModel: No financial credential + no related party

stakeholderAndRegulatoryConstraints.constraint: Consent must be accepted again when an applicant re-enters.
stakeholderAndRegulatoryConstraints.designEffect: Application data can be preserved, but consent cannot be treated as permanently retained.

stakeholderAndRegulatoryConstraints.constraint: The guarantor application statement must be typed by the applicant.
stakeholderAndRegulatoryConstraints.designEffect: No fixed form or selectable sentence assembly could replace the applicant-entered declaration; guidance had to remain limited.

stakeholderAndRegulatoryConstraints.constraint: Applicants may not have supporting documents during mobile use.
stakeholderAndRegulatoryConstraints.designEffect: Supporting files were separated from the core submission and surfaced in post-submit status and follow-up states.

stakeholderAndRegulatoryConstraints.constraint: A financial credential changes required document states.
stakeholderAndRegulatoryConstraints.designEffect: Result and upload requirements branch according to credential availability.

stakeholderAndRegulatoryConstraints.constraint: Related parties may need to install or open another banking app.
stakeholderAndRegulatoryConstraints.designEffect: SMS and email invitation, identity verification and return paths had to be modelled separately.

title.en: From mixed fields to a purpose-led application architecture
title.zh: 從混雜欄位到目的導向的申請架構

whatIDecided.en: Reorganised the application by grouping fields around related information goals—such as loan details, personal information, related parties, consent and confirmation—rather than preserving the existing field sequence.
whatIDecided.zh: 不沿用既有欄位順序，而是依貸款資料、個人資訊、關係人、同意與確認等相關資訊目的重新組織申請。

whyThisChoice.en: Applicants needed to understand not only what to enter, but where they were in the application and why each group of information was required.
whyThisChoice.zh: 申請人不只需要知道要輸入什麼，也需要理解目前所在位置，以及每組資訊為何必須提供。

content.en: Auditing the full field set, identifying common purpose and dependencies, regrouping related inputs into coherent stages, and defining progress, section-level editing and contextual explanations.
content.zh: 盤點完整欄位、辨識共同目的與依賴關係、將相關輸入重組為連貫階段，並定義進度、區段編輯與情境說明。

outcome.en: Established a clearer staged information architecture that gave applicants a stronger sense of progress, purpose and remaining work across the mortgage application.
outcome.zh: 建立更清楚的分階段資訊架構，讓申請人更能掌握房貸申請的進度、目的與剩餘工作。

title.en: From a generic app start to context-aware entry
title.zh: 從通用 App 起點到情境感知的進入方式

whatIDecided.en: Mapped the existing mortgage traffic and evaluated which available customer context could meaningfully inform the starting state of the new in-app application, without changing the existing entry points themselves.
whatIDecided.zh: 盤點既有房貸流量，評估哪些可用顧客情境能有效影響新 App 內申請的起始狀態，同時不更動既有入口本身。

whyThisChoice.en: Customers could arrive at different stages of consideration, and discarding useful context could create unnecessary repetition inside the application.
whyThisChoice.zh: 顧客可能在不同考慮階段進入；捨棄有用情境會在申請內造成不必要的重複。

content.en: Separating acquisition traffic from application logic, identifying reliable contextual signals and defining clear boundaries around what could be carried forward without implying guaranteed lending terms.
content.zh: 將獲客流量與申請邏輯分離、辨識可靠情境訊號，並清楚界定哪些資訊可沿用而不暗示保證的貸款條件。

outcome.en: Established a context-aware starting model for the app while preserving the existing acquisition ecosystem.
outcome.zh: 在保留既有獲客生態的同時，建立具情境感知的 App 起始模型。

deliveryBoundary.en: Further contextual routing options were not validated within the project scope.
deliveryBoundary.zh: 更多情境式路由選項未在本專案範圍內完成驗證。

title.en: From one-session form completion to a persistent application state
title.zh: 從單次完成表單到可持續保留的申請狀態

whatIDecided.en: Designed save, resume and related-party participation as part of the core application model rather than treating interruption as an exception.
whatIDecided.zh: 將儲存、續辦與關係人參與設計為核心申請模型的一部分，而非將中斷視為例外。

whyThisChoice.en: Applicants might not have property information, documents or another participant’s input available when they first started.
whyThisChoice.zh: 申請人初次開始時，可能尚未備妥房產資訊、文件或其他參與者的輸入。

content.en: Persistent state, clear ownership of incomplete information, return behaviour and related-party completion paths that preserved work already entered.
content.zh: 持續狀態、未完成資訊的清楚責任、返回行為，以及能保留既有輸入的關係人完成路徑。

outcome.en: Established a more realistic self-service model that could support interrupted and multi-party mortgage applications without forcing applicants to restart completed work.
outcome.zh: 建立更符合實際情境的自助服務模型，可支援中斷與多方房貸申請，而不迫使申請人重新開始已完成的工作。

title.en: Building one self-service mortgage application from fragmented application tasks
title.zh: 將分散的申請任務整合為單一房貸自助申請

headline.en: The scalable unit was the application state—not the screen.
headline.zh: 可擴展的單位是申請狀態，而非畫面。

supportingCopy.en: A screen describes one moment. Application state connects the information, progress and dependencies that must remain coherent across the mortgage journey.
supportingCopy.zh: 畫面只描述單一時刻；申請狀態則連結房貸旅程中必須保持一致的資訊、進度與依賴關係。

title.en: Evidence that shaped the decisions
title.zh: 塑造決策的證據

heading.en: Different readiness states required a state-driven journey
heading.zh: 不同準備狀態需要以狀態驅動的旅程

summary.en: Users entered with different information and dependencies, so one fixed sequence could not serve every application state.
summary.zh: 使用者進入時掌握的資訊與依賴關係各不相同，因此單一固定順序無法適用每一種申請狀態。

heading.en: Interruption was part of the normal application journey
heading.zh: 中斷是正常申請旅程的一部分

summary.en: Missing information or documents meant users needed to leave and return without losing progress.
summary.zh: 資訊或文件未備齊，意味著使用者需要離開後再返回，同時保留既有進度。

heading.en: Multiple applicants still needed one coherent application
heading.zh: 多位申請人仍需要一份連貫的申請

summary.en: Related applicants could contribute at different moments, but their input still had to remain within the same application.
summary.zh: 關係申請人可能在不同時間提供資料，但其輸入仍須維持在同一份申請中。

title.en: Outcomes
title.zh: 成果

heading.en: One staged application model
heading.zh: 一套分階段申請模型

copy.en: A coherent structure for presenting mortgage information according to applicant readiness and application progress.
copy.zh: 依申請人準備程度與申請進度呈現房貸資訊的連貫結構。

heading.en: Resumable application progress
heading.zh: 可續辦的申請進度

copy.en: A journey designed to preserve completed work across pauses, missing information and return visits.
copy.zh: 能在暫停、資訊未備齊與再次返回時保留已完成工作的旅程。

heading.en: Coordinated multi-party completion
heading.zh: 協調一致的多方完成

copy.en: One application structure that supported co-borrower and guarantor contribution without fragmenting the underlying journey.
copy.zh: 一套支援共借人與保證人參與、同時不割裂底層旅程的申請結構。

closing.en: The end-to-end UX and application-state specification was delivered to CTBC; production launch and post-launch performance were not confirmed within the external engagement.
closing.zh: 端到端 UX 與申請狀態規格已交付 CTBC；正式上線與上線後成效未在此外部合作期間確認。

hero.purpose: Show the new app experience within five seconds.
hero.recommendedContent: A 3-5-screen montage showing preparation, loan data, save/resume, confirmation and result/status.

userEntryModel.recommendedContent: A clean three-route framework for direct, calculator/comparison and relationship-manager entry, with the distinct mindset and design implication for each.
userEntryModel.avoid: Publishing the full raw user-analysis board.

systemArchitecture.recommendedContent: A simplified architecture connecting the main applicant, customer-state branches, related-party subflows, financial credential, supporting documents and result/status states.
systemArchitecture.avoid: A raw full-flow screenshot with unreadable text.

stagedJourney.recommendedContent: A before/after comparison: one mixed restart-prone form versus staged tasks with purpose explanations, progress, prefill and resume.
stagedJourney.avoid: Claiming implementation or measured abandonment improvement.

postSubmissionModel.recommendedContent: A main-submission-to-follow-up map showing documents, guarantor declaration, co-borrower invitation and status-based next actions.
postSubmissionModel.avoid: Showing internal policy wording or unapproved legal copy.

craftProof.recommendedContent: Three focused examples: save/resume, dynamic confirmation/editing and a result state with clear next actions.
craftProof.avoid: Using the entire flow canvas as one image.

strengths: New app channel rather than visual redesign
Detailed flow and representative interface evidence
remainingGaps: Core team and stakeholder model
Final detailed UI and specification status
Development or production status, if publicly disclosable
principalReadinessAudit.outcomeBoundary: Post-launch performance is not accessible under the consulting engagement and is not treated as a case-quality deficiency.

publicSummary.en: Established the 0→1 app product model, end-to-end applicant flow and related-party completion architecture for client delivery.
publicSummary.zh: 建立 0→1 應用程式產品模式、端到端申請人流程與關係人補件架構，供客戶後續交付。

outcomeReporting.postLaunchMetrics: Not available within the external consulting engagement.

disclosureNote.zh: 受接案合作範圍限制，無法取得上線後數據；成果以已驗證決策與實際交付的系統改變呈現。

en: How do you move a mortgage application from web and paper to app?
How do you design multi-party lending journeys?
How do you preserve progress in a long application?
zh: 如何將房貸申請從網站與紙本移到 App？
如何設計多方貸款 Journey？
如何在長流程中保留申請進度？

confidentialityNote.en: *Post-launch metrics were not available within the consulting engagement; outcomes are reported through validated decisions and delivered system change.*
confidentialityNote.zh: *受接案合作範圍限制，無法取得上線後數據；成果以已驗證決策與實際交付的系統改變呈現。*

publicSummary.en: Led the 0→1 application model and information architecture while keeping acquisition, lending, implementation and launch boundaries explicit.
publicSummary.zh: 主導 0→1 申請模型與資訊架構，同時清楚界定獲客、授信、實作與上線責任。

coDecided.en: Implementation dependencies required for the proposed experience
coDecided.zh: 提案體驗所需的實作依賴

partnerOwned.zh: 正式上線與上線後衡量

intro.en: I turned a structurally complex mortgage process into a product direction the team could implement.
intro.zh: 我將結構複雜的房貸流程轉化為團隊可實作的產品方向。

title.en: Defined the product model behind the 0→1 mortgage journey
title.zh: 定義 0→1 房貸旅程背後的產品模型

text.en: I led the product framing, journey architecture and interaction strategy that turned fragmented mortgage tasks into one coherent in-app experience.
text.zh: 我主導產品定義、旅程架構與互動策略，將分散的房貸任務轉化為單一連貫的 App 內體驗。

title.en: Turned business and lending constraints into a buildable direction
title.zh: 將商業與授信限制轉化為可實作方向

text.en: I connected customer needs, operational requirements, lending boundaries and implementation feasibility into product decisions the team could take forward without losing the intended experience model.
text.zh: 我將顧客需求、營運要求、授信邊界與實作可行性連結成團隊可持續推進的產品決策，同時維持原定體驗模型。

claim.en: Delivered a complete mortgage-application product blueprint covering three entry routes, staged completion, related parties, recovery, and post-submit tasks.
claim.zh: 交付完整的房貸申請產品藍圖，涵蓋三種入口、分段填寫、關係人、進度復原與送件後任務。

claim.en: Defined three application entry routes for different decision states.
claim.zh: 依不同決策階段定義三種申請入口。

claim.en: Coordinated main applicants, co-borrowers, and guarantors within one end-to-end application model.
claim.zh: 在同一套端到端申請模型中，整合主申請人、共借人與保證人。

claim.en: Post-launch metrics were not available within the consulting engagement.
claim.zh: 受接案合作範圍限制，無法取得上線後數據。

heroVisualBrief.problemSignal: Web and paper steps caused restart and coordination risk
heroVisualBrief.systemSignal: Three entry routes, staged form and related-party/document orchestration

before.en: Dense application tasks with unclear grouping and interrupted completion
before.zh: 分組不清、完成容易中斷的密集申請任務

intervention.en: A staged application architecture built around information purpose, persistent state and customer context
intervention.zh: 以資訊目的、持續狀態與顧客情境建立的分階段申請架構

after.en: One clearer self-service journey prepared for app delivery
after.zh: 一條更清楚、已為 App 交付準備的自助服務旅程

supportingCopy.en: I reorganised the mortgage information architecture, defined how application state should persist across interruption and related-party participation, and evaluated where existing entry context could reduce unnecessary repetition.
supportingCopy.zh: 我重整房貸資訊架構，定義申請狀態如何在中斷與關係人參與時持續保留，並評估既有入口情境可在哪些位置減少不必要的重複輸入。

ctbc-mortgage-self-service-app.transformation: From fragmented mortgage entry routes to one resumable application
ctbc-mortgage-self-service-app.transformation_zh: 從分散的房貸入口，到單一可續辦申請
ctbc-mortgage-self-service-app.at_glance: Led the 0→1 product design of an in-app mortgage application, restructuring fragmented information into a staged, resumable journey that supported contextual entry, related-party participation and regulated guidance.
ctbc-mortgage-self-service-app.at_glance_zh: 主導 App 內房貸申請的 0→1 產品設計，將分散資訊重整為可分階段、可續辦的旅程，支援情境式進入、關係人參與與受監管的資訊引導。
ctbc-mortgage-self-service-app.why: Mortgage applications were split across web and paper channels, making entry points, applicant responsibilities, and progress difficult to understand.
ctbc-mortgage-self-service-app.why_zh: 房貸申請分散在網站與紙本管道，使申請入口、角色責任與進度難以理解。
ctbc-mortgage-self-service-app.impact: Established a complete in-app mortgage application model that aligned entry, applicant roles, and application progression.
ctbc-mortgage-self-service-app.impact_zh: 建立完整的 App 內房貸申請模式，對齊申請入口、角色與流程進度。

cardTitle.en: Turning paper mortgage applications into self-service
cardTitle.zh: 將紙本房貸申請轉為 App 自助流程

title.en: Delivery and outcomes
title.zh: 交付與成果

summary.en: Because post-launch metrics were not available within the consulting engagement, outcomes are reported through verified product scope, system decisions, and implementation-ready delivery.
summary.zh: 受接案合作範圍限制，無法取得上線後數據；因此成果以已確認的產品範圍、系統決策與可供實作的交付內容呈現。

detail.en: Defined the complete journey from entry selection and staged application to related-party coordination, documents, submission, and follow-up.
detail.zh: 定義從入口選擇、分段申請、關係人協作、文件補充，到送件與後續處理的完整旅程。

detail.en: Direct application, calculator and comparison, and relationship-manager-assisted application.
detail.zh: 直接申請、試算比較，以及由客戶關係經理協助申請。

detail.en: Main applicants, co-borrowers, and guarantors with distinct data, consent, invitation, and follow-up needs.
detail.zh: 主申請人、共借人與保證人，分別具有不同的資料、同意、邀請與後續處理需求。

detail.en: Delivered flows, states, exceptions, recovery paths, and representative interface direction for client implementation.
detail.zh: 交付流程、狀態、例外情境、復原路徑與代表性介面方向，供客戶後續實作。

measurementBoundary.en: Development and post-launch outcomes were not available for public reporting.
measurementBoundary.zh: 目前無法公開開發與上線後成效，因此不使用推測性數字。

criticalProblem.en: Existing mortgage entry routes, long-form requirements and interrupted sessions created parallel journeys without one clear way to understand progress, saved state or the next action.
criticalProblem.zh: 既有房貸入口、長篇申請要求與中斷情境形成多條平行旅程，缺少單一方式讓申請人理解進度、儲存狀態與下一步。

headline.en: Changed the work from screen redesign to product-model definition.
headline.zh: 將工作從畫面重設轉向產品模型定義。

supportingStatement.en: I mapped the fragmented requirements into one working model of stages, states and dependencies, giving the team a coherent basis for product and interaction decisions.
supportingStatement.zh: 我將分散需求整理成一套涵蓋階段、狀態與依賴關係的工作模型，讓團隊能以一致基礎做出產品與互動決策。

title.en: Structure the journey around application state
title.zh: 以申請狀態組織旅程

whatIDecided.en: Organised mortgage information into stages defined by user intent, field dependencies, readiness and application progress instead of a fixed sequence of screens.
whatIDecided.zh: 依使用者目的、欄位依賴、準備程度與申請進度，將房貸資訊組織成不同階段，而非固定畫面順序。

whyThisChoice.en: Applicants entered with different context and available information, while the field inventory showed dependencies that a single linear sequence could not represent coherently.
whyThisChoice.zh: 申請人進入時帶有不同情境與可用資訊；欄位盤點也顯示彼此依賴，單一線性順序無法連貫呈現。

content.en: Existing context could shape the starting state, but product guidance could not imply an approved amount, rate or eligibility before formal assessment.
content.zh: 既有情境可影響起始狀態，但產品引導不能在正式評估前暗示已核准的金額、利率或資格。

outcome.en: Enabled one staged application model that could present the right information according to readiness and progress.
outcome.zh: 形成一套分階段申請模型，可依準備程度與進度呈現適當資訊。

deliveryBoundary.en: Further contextual routing options were not validated within the project scope.
deliveryBoundary.zh: 更多情境式路由選項未在本專案範圍內完成驗證。

title.en: Treat interruption and return as a first-class application state
title.zh: 將中斷與返回視為一級申請狀態

whatIDecided.en: Designed save, pause, return and recovery as normal parts of the application model so completed work could persist across sessions.
whatIDecided.zh: 將儲存、暫停、返回與復原設計為申請模型的正常部分，讓已完成工作能跨使用階段保留。

whyThisChoice.en: Applicants might not have property details or supporting documents available when they started, so one uninterrupted completion path was not a realistic assumption.
whyThisChoice.zh: 申請人開始時可能尚未備妥房產資料或佐證文件，因此假設一次不中斷地完成並不符合實際情境。

content.en: Application data could be preserved, but consent had to be accepted again when an applicant re-entered.
content.zh: 申請資料可以保留，但申請人重新進入時仍必須再次同意。

outcome.en: Enabled resumable application progress without forcing applicants to restart completed work.
outcome.zh: 形成可續辦的申請進度，不必迫使申請人重新開始已完成的工作。

title.en: Keep multiple participants inside one coherent application
title.zh: 讓多位參與者維持在同一連貫申請中

whatIDecided.en: Modelled co-borrower and guarantor contribution as related completion paths within the same mortgage application rather than as disconnected participant flows.
whatIDecided.zh: 將共借人與保證人的參與建模為同一房貸申請中的關聯完成路徑，而非彼此割裂的參與者流程。

whyThisChoice.en: The main applicant could depend on information and actions from related applicants, while the underlying application still needed one consistent status and progression model.
whyThisChoice.zh: 主申請人可能依賴關係申請人的資訊與操作，但底層申請仍需要一致的狀態與進度模型。

content.en: Related applicants required distinct invitation, identity-verification, consent and return paths, including cases that opened another banking app.
content.zh: 關係申請人需要獨立的邀請、身分驗證、同意與返回路徑，包括需開啟另一個銀行 App 的情境。

outcome.en: Enabled coordinated multi-party completion while preserving the integrity of one application.
outcome.zh: 形成協調一致的多方完成方式，同時維持單一申請的完整性。

statusAndDisclosure.renderRule: Resolve only fields that exist; do not synthesize missing claims.

intro.en: CTBC wanted mortgage applicants to complete more of the journey inside the app, but the work crossed dense financial information, different levels of readiness, information that might not be available yet, and tasks involving more than one applicant.
intro.zh: CTBC 希望房貸申請人能在 App 內完成更多流程，但此問題橫跨密集的金融資訊、不同準備程度、當下可能尚未取得的資料，以及涉及多位申請人的任務。

title.en: The information had dependencies
title.zh: 資訊之間存在依賴關係

description.en: Property, loan, personal, related-party and consent information served different purposes and could not be treated as one flat form.
description.zh: 房產、貸款、個人、關係人與同意資訊各有不同目的，無法被視為單一扁平表單。

title.en: Applicants did not begin from the same point
title.zh: 申請人並非都從相同起點開始

description.en: Customers could arrive from direct application, comparison activity or a relationship-manager referral with different context and levels of readiness.
description.zh: 顧客可能從直接申請、比較活動或客戶關係經理轉介進入，帶著不同情境與準備程度。

title.en: Completion could span time and people
title.zh: 完成申請可能跨越時間與多人

description.en: Required details, documents or another applicant’s input might not be available in the first session, while formal lending assessment remained a separate institutional process.
description.zh: 必要資料、文件或其他申請人的輸入可能無法在第一次使用時取得，而正式授信評估仍屬獨立的機構流程。

delivered.zh: 端到端房貸自助產品模型
主申請人、共借人與保證人流程

delivered.en: Save-and-resume, consent, document and status logic
delivered.zh: 儲存續辦、同意、文件與狀態邏輯

productionStatus.en: Not confirmed within the consulting engagement
productionStatus.zh: 接案合作期間內未確認

postLaunchMeasurement.zh: 設計合作範圍內無法取得

whatThisProves.en: Structuring a high-stakes mortgage application around progress, resumption and clear next actions.
whatThisProves.zh: 以進度、續填與清楚下一步，重構高風險房貸申請流程。

impactEvidence.recommendedHeadline: Defined a 0→1 five-stage mortgage self-service model with resumable progress and multi-system handoffs.
impactEvidence.boundary: No post-launch UI or business KPI attribution.

title.en: From uncertain expansion to a lower-risk taxi pickup experiment
title.zh: 從不確定的服務擴張，到低風險的計程車接送實驗

atAGlance.en: Led nine months of research and strategy for Booking.com’s taxi pre-booking expansion, combining customer, supplier, market and performance evidence to redefine the proposition and recommend a lower-cost Phase 1 experiment in selected target markets.
atAGlance.zh: 主導 Booking.com 計程車預約服務為期九個月的研究與策略，整合顧客、供應商、市場與產品表現證據，重新定義服務主張，並建議在選定目標市場進行低成本的第一階段實驗。

rationale.en: Establishes a new product capability and operating model where no equivalent product previously existed.
rationale.zh: 建立先前不存在的新產品能力與運作模式。

scope.en: Research and strategy from opportunity framing through Phase 1 experiment recommendation
scope.zh: 從機會定義到第一階段實驗建議的研究與策略

primary.zh: 考慮預約計程車接送的旅客

headline.en: Converted an open-ended growth question into an evidence-led Phase 1 experiment that could test market demand without committing to a full rollout.
headline.zh: 將開放式成長問題轉化為以證據驅動的第一階段實驗，在不承諾全面上線的前提下驗證市場需求。

supportingStatement.en: The strategy aligned customer value, supplier feasibility, market readiness and commercial risk in one decision framework.
supportingStatement.zh: 這套策略以同一套決策框架對齊顧客價值、供應商可行性、市場成熟度與商業風險。

criticalProblem.en: Booking.com wanted to expand the audience for taxi pre-booking, but customer demand, supplier feasibility, market readiness and a non-disruptive way to test the opportunity were still unvalidated.
criticalProblem.zh: Booking.com 希望擴大計程車預約服務的受眾，但顧客需求、供應商可行性、市場成熟度，以及不干擾既有產品的驗證方式都尚未確認。

whyItMattered.en: The growth opportunity could not justify a full rollout until customer, supplier and market evidence were connected into a testable strategy.
whyItMattered.zh: 在顧客、供應商與市場證據尚未整合為可驗證策略前，這項成長機會不足以支持全面上線。

title.en: Customer value had to work for suppliers too
title.zh: 顧客價值也必須對供應商可行

description.en: A stronger traveller proposition would fail if local suppliers could not support the expected pickup, pricing or service conditions.
description.zh: 即使旅客端主張更有吸引力，只要當地供應商無法支援接送、定價或服務條件，方案仍無法成立。

title.en: Pickup behaviour varied by market
title.zh: 接送行為會因市場而異

description.en: Airport habits, local transport options, price expectations and supplier coverage changed which proposition could be credible.
description.zh: 機場使用習慣、在地交通選項、價格期待與供應商覆蓋度，會改變哪種服務主張可信。

title.en: The opportunity needed a non-disruptive test
title.zh: 機會需要不干擾既有產品的驗證方式

description.en: The team needed evidence before broader investment, while avoiding a large product build or unsupported market commitment.
description.zh: 團隊需要在擴大投入前取得證據，同時避免大型產品開發或缺乏依據的市場承諾。

title.en: Booking Pickup Research Strategy
title.zh: Booking 接送服務研究策略

description.en: Used existing performance evidence to identify where growth assumptions needed validation.
description.zh: 以既有產品表現辨識需要驗證的成長假設。

description.en: Connected traveller needs with supplier feasibility and service constraints.
description.zh: 串接旅客需求、供應商可行性與服務限制。

description.en: Assessed demand, local behaviour, competition and operational readiness.
description.zh: 評估需求、在地行為、競爭與營運成熟度。

description.en: Translated evidence into testable value and price-framing hypotheses.
description.zh: 將證據轉化為可驗證的價值與價格框架假設。

description.en: Defined a lower-cost experiment before any broader rollout decision.
description.zh: 在任何全面上線決策前，先定義低成本實驗。

title.en: From full expansion to a lower-risk market experiment
title.zh: 從全面擴張，到低風險市場實驗

whatIDecided.en: Recommended a selected-market Phase 1 experiment instead of committing immediately to broad product expansion.
whatIDecided.zh: 建議先在選定市場執行第一階段實驗，而非立即承諾全面產品擴張。

whyThisChoice.en: Customer demand, supplier readiness and market conditions needed to be validated together before larger investment.
whyThisChoice.zh: 顧客需求、供應商成熟度與市場條件必須一起驗證，才能支持更大規模投入。

content.en: We accepted slower geographic expansion in exchange for reducing product, supplier and commercial risk.
content.zh: 我們接受較慢的地域擴張速度，換取降低產品、供應商與商業風險。

title.en: From abstract convenience to a testable price anchor
title.zh: 從抽象便利性，到可驗證的價格錨點

whatIDecided.en: Recommended price anchoring as a Phase 1 proposition test rather than presenting it as a shipped pricing model.
whatIDecided.zh: 建議將價格錨點作為第一階段服務主張測試，而非把它描述為已上線的定價模型。

whyThisChoice.en: Travellers needed a concrete basis for judging the value of pre-booking against familiar local alternatives.
whyThisChoice.zh: 旅客需要具體依據，才能比較預約接送與熟悉的在地替代方案是否值得。

content.en: The recommendation had to remain testable without implying final commercial pricing or launch approval.
content.zh: 此建議必須可被驗證，同時不得暗示最終商業定價或已核准上線。

title.en: From one global premise to market-readiness criteria
title.zh: 從單一全球假設，到市場成熟度準則

whatIDecided.en: Combined customer demand, supplier coverage, local transport context and commercial feasibility into criteria for selecting target markets.
whatIDecided.zh: 將顧客需求、供應商覆蓋、在地交通脈絡與商業可行性整合為目標市場選擇準則。

whyThisChoice.en: A proposition that worked in one market could fail elsewhere when airport behaviour, alternatives or supplier conditions changed.
whyThisChoice.zh: 當機場行為、替代方案或供應商條件改變時，在單一市場成立的服務主張可能無法直接複製。

content.en: This required customer, supplier, market and performance evidence to be evaluated in one decision model.
content.zh: 這需要將顧客、供應商、市場與產品表現證據放在同一套決策模型中評估。

businessImpact.en: Reduced dependency on broad assumptions by giving Product, Commercial and Supplier teams a shared evidence-led framework for deciding whether and where to run Phase 1.
businessImpact.zh: 透過共用的證據決策框架，降低產品、商務與供應商團隊對廣泛假設的依賴，並支持判斷是否及應在哪些市場執行第一階段實驗。

publicSummary.en: Led the research synthesis, opportunity framing, proposition hypotheses and Phase 1 recommendation, working with Data, Research, Product, Commercial and Supplier teams.
publicSummary.zh: 主導研究統整、機會定義、服務主張假設與第一階段建議，並與資料、研究、產品、商務及供應商團隊協作。

coDecided.en: Target-market and commercial feasibility with Product and Commercial teams
coDecided.zh: 與產品及商務團隊共同判斷目標市場與商業可行性
與供應商團隊共同判斷供應可行性

partnerOwned.zh: 資料團隊提供產品表現分析

claim.en: Delivered an evidence-led Phase 1 market experiment recommendation and decision framework.
claim.zh: 完成以證據驅動的第一階段市場實驗建議與決策框架。

claim.en: Launch, growth, revenue and experiment-result evidence are not available and are not claimed.
claim.zh: 目前沒有可公開的上線、成長、營收或實驗結果證據，因此不作相關主張。

confidentialityNote.en: This case uses public-safe research and strategy summaries; supplier, commercial and market-sensitive details are abstracted.
confidentialityNote.zh: 本案例使用可公開的研究與策略摘要；供應商、商業及市場敏感細節已抽象化。

zh: Booking.com 計程車研究與策略

criticalProblem.en: Booking.com wanted to expand the audience for taxi pre-booking, but customer demand, supplier feasibility, market readiness and a non-disruptive way to test the opportunity were still unvalidated.
criticalProblem.zh: Booking.com 希望擴大計程車預約服務的受眾，但顧客需求、供應商可行性、市場成熟度，以及不干擾既有產品的驗證方式都尚未確認。

title.en: Customer value had to work for suppliers too
title.zh: 顧客價值也必須對供應商可行

description.en: A stronger traveller proposition would fail if local suppliers could not support the expected pickup, pricing or service conditions.
description.zh: 即使旅客端主張更有吸引力，只要當地供應商無法支援接送、定價或服務條件，方案仍無法成立。

title.en: Pickup behaviour varied by market
title.zh: 接送行為會因市場而異

description.en: Airport habits, local transport options, price expectations and supplier coverage changed which proposition could be credible.
description.zh: 機場使用習慣、在地交通選項、價格期待與供應商覆蓋度，會改變哪種服務主張可信。

title.en: The opportunity needed a non-disruptive test
title.zh: 機會需要不干擾既有產品的驗證方式

description.en: The team needed evidence before broader investment, while avoiding a large product build or unsupported market commitment.
description.zh: 團隊需要在擴大投入前取得證據，同時避免大型產品開發或缺乏依據的市場承諾。

title.en: The airport transfer journey became easier to trust when itinerary context and airport-native language worked together.
title.zh: 當行程脈絡與機場熟悉語言一起被帶入流程時，機場接送服務才更值得信任。

statement.en: Customers should not have to rebuild information the platform already knows. Reusing trip details and expressing options in familiar airport language—such as carry-on and checked baggage—helped reduce ambiguity, improved confidence in vehicle selection and made the service easier to act on from comparison through pickup.
statement.zh: 使用者不該重新輸入平台已知的行程資訊。當產品能重用旅程脈絡，並以旅客熟悉的機場語言表達選項——例如隨身行李與托運行李——就能減少理解落差，提升對車型與服務選擇的信心，讓使用者更容易從比較、預訂一路走到接送。

title.en: Future service opportunities
title.zh: 未來服務機會

title.en: Preferred driver continuity
title.zh: 延續偏好司機

concept.en: Allow customers to save a preferred driver and prioritise that driver when booking another airport transfer from the same airport.
concept.zh: 讓使用者儲存偏好司機，並在再次預訂同一機場的接送服務時優先媒合該司機。

whyItMatters.en: Preserving a trusted driver preference could reduce perceived service risk and strengthen repeat-use confidence.
whyItMatters.zh: 保留可信任的司機偏好，可降低感知服務風險並強化再次使用的信心。

systemRequirement.en: Driver availability, airport/service-area matching and fallback logic must prevent false availability promises.
systemRequirement.zh: 需要司機可用性、機場／服務區域媒合與備援邏輯，避免錯誤的可用性承諾。

title.en: Contextual route-risk disclosure
title.zh: 情境式路線風險揭露

concept.en: Use the transfer date, airport and destination to surface time-sensitive route risks before booking.
concept.zh: 依接送日期、機場與目的地，在預訂前呈現具時效性的路線風險。

whyItMatters.en: Known disruption visibility could clarify when journey duration may be longer than expected.
whyItMatters.zh: 呈現已知中斷可協助理解何時車程可能超出預期。

systemRequirement.en: Location-aware disruption data, time-window relevance and clear confidence states are required.
systemRequirement.zh: 需要具地點感知的中斷資料、時間關聯性與清楚的可信度狀態。

booking-taxi-pickup-service-strategy.transformation: From uncertain expansion to a lower-risk taxi pickup experiment

booking-taxi-pickup-service-strategy.at_glance: Led nine months of research and strategy for Booking.com’s taxi pre-booking expansion, combining customer, supplier, market and performance evidence to redefine the proposition and recommend a lower-cost Phase 1 experiment in selected target markets.
booking-taxi-pickup-service-strategy.at_glance_zh: 主導 Booking.com 計程車預約服務為期九個月的研究與策略，整合顧客、供應商、市場與產品表現證據，重新定義服務主張，並建議在選定目標市場進行低成本的第一階段實驗。

whatThisProves.en: Translating ambiguous pickup behaviour and service constraints into a phased product strategy.
whatThisProves.zh: 將模糊的接送行為與服務限制，轉化為分階段產品策略。

Confidentiality note appears only when abstracted internal metrics are visible.
Concept, tested, implementation-complete, shipped and adopted remain distinct.

show: One decisive visual or public-safe redraw
One outcome, research count or status boundary when relevant

disclosureLayer.presentation: Use the existing disclosure/evidence viewer; do not create a second modal system.
mayContain: Readable process-map crops or public redraws

internalOnly: Raw boards containing employee names or comments
deepEvidenceDisclosure.rule: Do not delete useful evidence. Change its information level. Do not list every evidence type as equal-weight outer-page content.

stageFocus.contrast: WCAG AA text contrast; non-text boundaries/controls >=3:1 where applicable.
stageFocus.contentLimit: One stage label + one concise relation statement. No duplicated contribution, metrics, delivery status or parent summary.

label.style: Small colored semantic label/tag using existing design tokens.

designDecision.title: Stronger, outcome-oriented decision title.
designDecision.effectRequired: Every decision must state the effect, improvement, resulting behavior/state, or measurable/observable consequence.
designDecision.visualEvidenceRequired: Provide a governed visual slot directly after the decision when evidence exists.

deliveryBoundary.rule: Standard compact subsection/status treatment within the shared decision or ownership system; no project-specific special container.

popupSectionSystem.goal: One shared section grammar and stronger separation across all project popups.
majorSectionTreatment: shared divider or surface change where useful
popupSectionSystem.containerRule: Avoid container-in-container stacking; prefer one section surface with internal grid/layout.
popupSectionSystem.backgroundRule: Use section background/surface changes strategically for grouping, not unique cards for every subsection.

expandableImages.behavior: Evidence images can be clicked/tapped to open a larger lightbox/dialog and closed without losing scroll context.

domainCards.rule: Homepage/Work domain project cards should include meaningful governed project imagery.
domainCards.assetGovernance: Use governed project assets/manifest and responsive image delivery.

metricIntegrity.principle: Never present benchmark, assumed, synthetic, inferred, or industry-average uplift as a project outcome.
metricIntegrity.confidentialityRule: Approximate values may be used only when they are derived from real project measurements and intentionally rounded/abstracted for confidentiality.
metricIntegrity.benchmarkRule: Industry benchmarks may appear only as explicitly labeled external context or opportunity sizing, never as 'result', 'impact', 'growth', or 'improvement' from the user's work.
allowedOutcomeEvidenceTypes: verified observational trend with non-causal wording
metricIntegrity.whenNoOutcomeMetric: Use the strongest verifiable evidence signal instead of inventing a percentage.

recommendedPublicNote.en: Selected figures are rounded or abstracted for confidentiality.
recommendedPublicNote.zh: 部分數據基於保密需求採約略值或抽象化呈現。

forbiddenPatterns: Estimated +20% growth presented as project result
Industry-average conversion uplift relabeled as confidential project performance
Unmeasured improvement phrased as a causal KPI change

measured-outcome.useWhen: Verified shipped KPI / adoption / quality metric exists.
measured-outcome.visualGrammar: 1 primary metric + up to 2 supporting metrics + short interpretation + attribution/confidentiality note if needed.
measured-outcome.heading: Measured impact

observational-trend.useWhen: Verified before/after or cohort trend exists but causality is not established.
observational-trend.visualGrammar: Trend or before→after figure + explicit non-causal boundary + interpretation.
observational-trend.heading: Observed signal

research-decision-signal.useWhen: Research ratios/counts directly changed architecture or interaction decisions.
research-decision-signal.visualGrammar: 2–3 research signals + what changed because of the evidence.
research-decision-signal.heading: Evidence that changed the product

scale-and-system-change.useWhen: No reliable uplift exists, but rollout scale / system standardisation is verified.
scale-and-system-change.visualGrammar: Scale signal + system change + why it matters.
scale-and-system-change.heading: System change

delivery-and-definition-proof.visualGrammar: Research/delivery scale + complexity resolved + resulting capability + clear delivery boundary.
delivery-and-definition-proof.heading: What became possible

launch-and-coverage-proof.useWhen: Launch / shipped coverage is verified but KPI measurement is unavailable.
launch-and-coverage-proof.visualGrammar: Launch status + validated scope + delivered product capability; no fake uplift.
launch-and-coverage-proof.heading: Shipped proof

title.en: My contribution
title.zh: 我的貢獻

summary.en: I co-framed the problem with the Product Manager, then independently led the design strategy, phase model, end-to-end customer experience, Back Office requirements, stakeholder alignment and Engineering handoff.
summary.zh: 我與產品經理共同定義問題，之後獨立主導設計策略、階段模型、端到端顧客體驗、後台需求、利害關係人對齊與工程交接。

content.en: Reframed isolated games as a configurable engagement platform.
content.zh: 將孤立遊戲重構為可配置參與平台。

content.en: Separated the urgent concurrent-hosting foundation from later lifecycle and engagement capabilities.
content.zh: 將急迫的並行-承載基礎與後續生命週期／參與能力分階段處理。

content.en: Aligned stakeholder feedback, operational controls and Engineering constraints into one release model.
content.zh: 將利害關係人回饋、營運控制項與工程限制對齊為同一上線模型。

content.en: Extended the launch foundation into implementation-complete lifecycle and resilience states.
content.zh: 將上線基礎延伸為開發完成的生命週期與韌性狀態。

showInPrimaryNarrative: Transformation from one game to concurrent platform
Sole design ownership with PM boundary
Phase 1.2 lifecycle system and status boundary
moveToExpandableEvidence: Loading, empty, API error and pressed states
keepInternalOnly: Unshipped potential funnels and long-term reward concepts

multiGameParticipation.measurementPeriod: 10 weekly periods from 7 August to 15 October 2025
multiGameParticipation.numerator: Unique mini-game players who engaged with two or more distinct mini games during the measured week.
multiGameParticipation.denominator: Unique mini-game players who engaged with at least one mini game during the same measured week.
excludedDenominators: All Game Center page visitors who did not start a game

denominatorEvidence.weeklyTracking: The GTM sheet pairs the percentage metric with weekly mini-game player counts.
denominatorEvidence.dailySupportingView: The supporting engagement chart segments users who engaged with games into one-, two- and three-game groups on the same day.

publicClaim.en: Across the 10-week tracking period, roughly 70% of weekly mini-game players engaged with two or more games—about 20 percentage points above the 50% target.
publicClaim.zh: 在 10 週追蹤期間，約 70% 的每週小遊戲玩家參與兩個以上遊戲，較 50% 目標高出約 20 個百分點。

gamificationPenetration.interpretation: approximately stable; about +0.3 percentage points using the rounded before/after values
gamificationPenetration.printedChangeConflict: The performance deck prints +2.4%, which does not reconcile with 22.68% to 23%.
gamificationPenetration.publicUse: Do not claim material growth until the metric definition is confirmed.

voucherVolumes.attributionBoundary: Campaign mix changed between the comparison periods; do not attribute all movement to the listing page.

gmv.sourceSummary: The deck compares Finest Fest 1 with Finest Fest 2 plus Kopitiam and includes annualised GMV and uplift figures.

sameDayEngagementEvidence.sourceFinding: 19,349 unique users engaged with every available game on the listing page on the same day, reported as +248.4% in the internal view.
sameDayEngagementEvidence.distributionInterpretation: The daily stacked chart groups engaged players by the number of distinct games played, confirming that the cohort is game-engaged users rather than all page visitors.
sameDayEngagementEvidence.publicUse: Do not publish the +248.4% until its comparison baseline is confirmed.

visibilityEvidence.sourceFinding: The internal scroll analysis indicated that roughly 22% of users did not scroll far enough to reach the third game.
visibilityEvidence.designImplication: Phase 1.2 prioritised clearer card-level urgency and lifecycle communication; a denser 2x2 layout was parked as a separate continuous-improvement item.
visibilityEvidence.publicUse: May be described qualitatively or with an approximate 20% figure after confidentiality review.

signal.en: Shows platform-level ownership from problem framing to delivery: converting a single campaign slot into a configurable multi-game system, sequencing an intentionally constrained launch, then completing a lifecycle-state expansion while measuring repeat multi-game behaviour.
signal.zh: 呈現從 Problem framing 到交付的平台-level ownership：將單一活動 slot 轉為可配置多遊戲系統、安排刻意收斂的首版，再完成生命週期-狀態擴充，並衡量重複多遊戲 behaviour。

strongestEvidence: Co-framed the problem with the Product Manager
Shulin-led design strategy and phase planning
Independent stakeholder alignment and Engineering handoff
Concurrent game hosting and Back Office configuration
Approximately 70% of weekly mini-game players engaged with two or more games
Phase 1.2 design and Engineering development completed
remainingEvidenceNeeded: Final confirmation that Phase 1.2 deployed after the planned early-2026 window
Explanation of printed voucher and Gamification MAU percentage changes

dimensions.reason: The single-game-to-platform transformation is immediate and concrete.
The case connects customer discovery, sponsor concurrency, Operations configuration and lifecycle states.
Sole design ownership and PM boundaries are explicit; the first-release trade-off is credible.
The approximately 70% multi-game participation result is strong and well-defined; secondary metrics remain unresolved.
Stakeholder and Engineering leadership are shown, but executive adoption, multi-team reuse and mentoring evidence are still limited.
The operating-model change is clear, but sponsorship revenue, campaign throughput or dependency reduction are not quantified.
Shipped flows, Back Office, resilience states, responsive behaviour and accessibility-scale handling are documented.
The evidence is strong but must be pruned into three decisions and one system-proof block.

criticalGaps: No quantified sponsor, revenue, campaign-throughput or operational-efficiency impact.
No evidence yet that the platform model changed priorities across multiple teams or was adopted beyond this product.
No mentoring, quality-bar or design-organisation influence within this case.
Phase 1.2 final production release remains unconfirmed.
Secondary performance and GMV tables remain unreconciled.

claim.en: Across ten measured weeks, about 70% of tracked users played two or more games; the exact denominator must remain attached to the source.
claim.zh: 在 10 個追蹤週期中，約 70% 的受追蹤使用者玩了兩個以上的遊戲；公開時保留來源中的分母定義。

claim.en: Phase 1.1 launched with game listing, up to four games, login handling, repeatable games and back-office visibility controls.
claim.zh: 第 1.1 階段已上線遊戲列表、最多四個遊戲、登入處理、可重複遊玩機制與後台顯示控制。

title.en: From fleeting ideas to a three-stage capture system
title.zh: 從稍縱即逝的想法，到三階段靈感捕捉系統

summary.en: A physical-digital system combining an Egg recording device, wireless charger and filtering programme across Stimulate, Note and Filter stages.
summary.zh: 結合蛋形錄音裝置、無線充電與篩選計畫，建立涵蓋刺激、記錄與篩選三階段的實體數位系統。

capture-ideas.audience: Workers who need idea stimulation and expert consultation across meetings, leisure and individual work.
capture-ideas.award: RSA Student Design Awards - Final 7 shortlist

How do you combine a physical object with a digital service?

title.zh: 從令人卻步的發想，到具趣味性的商業創意系統

summary.en: A physical and online design-thinking toolbox helping non-designers generate, converge and validate ideas across meetings, offices, homes and remote collaboration.
summary.zh: 結合實體與線上的設計思考工具箱，協助非設計背景使用者在會議、辦公、居家與遠端協作中產生、收斂並驗證想法。

title.zh: 從文化距離，到可遊玩的魯凱學習體驗

summary.en: A locally launched edutainment system combining Rukai hunting-culture games, branding, products and tailored activities to support cultural learning and tourism.
summary.zh: 已在當地上線的寓教於樂系統，結合魯凱狩獵文化遊戲、品牌、產品與活動，支持文化學習與觀光。

historicalClaims.publicUse: Needs evidence or quantification before publishing as an outcome
