title.en: From individual usability testing to a reusable group-testing template
title.zh: 從個別可用性測試，到可重用的團體測試方法

summary.en: Designed and facilitated a group test combining focus-group discussion, behavioural tasks and before-and-after emotion scoring, using a collaborative Japanese cooking toy as the test object.
summary.zh: 設計並主持結合焦點團體討論、行為任務與前後情緒評分的團體測試，並以多人協作的日本料理玩具作為測試物件。

outcomes: Created a reusable AJA group-testing template
Tested a combined focus-group and usability-testing method

phases.name: First impression
questions: Have you heard of this product?
What do you think it can do?
What information do you expect from it?
Who is it designed for and why?

tasks: Choose and complete the first through sixth dishes
Decide what to do after all dishes are completed

phases.name: Ending

food-testing-workshop.methodOutcome: Created a reusable group-testing template combining first-impression assessment, group warm-up, behavioural tasks and before/after emotion scoring.

title.zh: 從方法分享，到現場洞察與設計模擬

summary.en: Co-created AJA Creative’s first external practical workshop and served as the first methodology speaker, teaching how to transform user insights into design outcomes while observing how group personality affected collaboration.
summary.zh: 共同建立 AJA Creative 首場對外實作工作坊，並擔任首位方法分享講者，說明如何將使用者洞察轉化為設計成果，同時觀察團體個性對協作的影響。

aja-creative-workshop.topic: How can we transfer user insights into design outcomes?

agenda.activity: Introduce an e-commerce company brief and allow three help requests.
Listen to buyer and seller statements and capture research evidence.
Organise evidence and orient the market using a matrix.
Build affinity diagrams around behaviour, needs and pain points.
Generate and categorise ideas beside the supporting evidence.
Evaluate ideas using creativity, accessibility and profitability.
Translate the selected idea into a before-and-after scenario.
Present outcomes and evaluate accessibility, creativity, profitability, persuasion and insight accuracy.

aja-creative-workshop.participantStructure: Six groups organised using pre-event personality profiles; one observer recorded each group’s behaviour.

testimonial.quote: It’s really precious that we could come up with solutions in such a minimum of time. Full of content and joy.

en: How do you teach design thinking through practice?
How do you facilitate rapid concept creation?
zh: 如何透過實作教 Design thinking？
如何引導快速概念產出？

title.en: From isolated design knowledge to a weekly cross-functional decision practice
title.zh: 從設計知識各自分散，到每週跨職能決策實踐

summary.en: Initiated and facilitated weekly sessions that connected research, analytics, empathy work and early design critique with Engineering, Product and stakeholders.
summary.zh: 我主動建立並主持每週設計評議，將使用者研究、數據分析、同理心練習與早期設計討論，串接到工程、產品與利害關係人。

sessionTypes.evidence: Market and user research, GA events, behavioural and conversion tracking, Hotjar heat maps and recordings
Early feasibility and constraint feedback before formal iteration

testimonial.quote: It’s a great session and effort you make. I can see the team enjoy seeing all these insights, and engage better.

How do you make research visible to engineering?
zh: 如何建立設計評議文化？
如何讓工程團隊看見研究證據？

sessionTypes_zh.evidence: 市場與使用者研究、Google Analytics 事件、行為與轉換追蹤，以及 Hotjar 熱點圖與操作錄影
以人物誌分群與使用者旅程進行討論
在正式迭代前先取得可行性與限制回饋

r65.target: Principal Product Designer and equivalent Staff / Lead IC roles
currentStrengths: Confirmed sole design ownership of a scaled Payment system
Evidence-led decisions, trade-offs and shipped craft

criticalRisks.issue: Booking and Payment contain strong figures whose statistical definitions are not yet explicit.
criticalRisks.requiredAction: Confirm baseline, denominator, comparison window and whether each percentage is relative uplift, percentage-point change or index.

criticalRisks.issue: DBS demonstrates multi-market direction but still lacks a concrete durable outcome and confirmed Timeline.
criticalRisks.requiredAction: Add operational adoption, cycle-time, error, escalation or dependency-reduction evidence.

criticalRisks.issue: Too many featured cases reduce decision speed and make the portfolio feel like a project archive.
criticalRisks.requiredAction: Keep three primary cases on the homepage and route the rest through domain/search pathways.

criticalRisks.issue: The Cathay SIT project strengthens recency but currently proves delivery rather than launch or measurable impact.
criticalRisks.requiredAction: Add production status, constraints and post-launch evidence when available.

criticalRisks.issue: Strategy evidence is stronger than visible implementation-quality proof in several cases.
criticalRisks.requiredAction: Pair each core case with one system diagram, one decision visual and one shipped interaction-quality visual.

summary.en: Regulated onboarding, lending, risk decisions and financial operations.
summary.zh: 受監管的初始申請、授信與風險決策，以及金融營運。

cardSubtitle.zh: 受監管的初始申請與授信

synthesisBasis.en: Synthesised from regulated application, advisory, review, exception, and remediation work across banking and investment products.
synthesisBasis.zh: 統整銀行與投資產品中的申請、諮詢、審查、例外及補件經驗。

en: Eligibility and documentation requirements are difficult to understand before commitment
Application, review, and remediation states are fragmented across channels and teams
Risk controls create friction when decision ownership and next actions are unclear
zh: 資格與文件要求在正式申請前難以理解
申請、審查與補件狀態分散在不同通路與團隊
當決策責任與下一步不清楚時，風險控管會轉化為流程阻力

en: Translate policy, eligibility, and evidence requirements into visible decision states and guidance.
Structure journeys around information readiness and handoffs—not form completion alone.
Separate standard, exception, and remediation paths while keeping progress and responsibility traceable.
zh: 將政策、資格與證明資料要求轉化為可見的決策狀態與引導。
依資訊是否備妥與交接需求組織旅程，而不只以填完表單為目標。
分開標準、例外與補件路徑，同時維持進度與責任可追溯。

publicationBoundary.en: No client outcome, shipped-state, or metric is inferred from the domain synthesis.
publicationBoundary.zh: 此領域統整不推論客戶成果、上線狀態或數據。

summary.en: Internal systems that coordinate roles, rules, exceptions and accountable decisions.
summary.zh: 協調角色、規則、例外與可追責決策的企業內部系統。

synthesisBasis.en: Synthesised from internal case review, operational handoff, approval, exception, and remediation workflows.
synthesisBasis.zh: 統整內部案件審查、營運交接、核准、例外與補件流程經驗。

zh: 分散且斷裂的營運流程
不清楚的核准路徑與決策責任
不一致的例外與補救處理方式

en: Define roles, authority, states, and ownership before shaping the interface.
Create traceable routing for approvals, exceptions, and decision ownership.
Turn fragmented operational knowledge into shared workflows and phased delivery plans.
zh: 在設計介面前，先定義角色、權限、狀態與責任。
為核准、例外與決策責任建立可追溯的處理路徑。
將分散的營運知識轉化為共享流程與分階段交付計畫。

publicationBoundary.en: The copy describes recurring workflow conditions and reusable methods, not implementation or operational-outcome claims.
publicationBoundary.zh: 文案只描述反覆出現的流程狀況與可重用做法，不主張實作或營運成果。

summary.en: Eligibility, reward, campaign and engagement systems that scale beyond one promotion.
summary.zh: 能超越單次活動、持續擴充的資格、獎勵、活動與參與系統。

cardSubtitle.zh: 會員機制、優惠券與遊戲化

synthesisBasis.en: Synthesised from a multi-year voucher programme, campaign journeys, shared incentive rules, engagement products, and supplier-funded mechanics.
synthesisBasis.zh: 統整多年票券計畫、活動旅程、共享獎勵規則、互動產品與供應商出資機制。

en: Campaign mechanics are repeatedly rebuilt as one-off journeys
Eligibility, progress, and reward value are difficult to understand
New growth ideas introduce states and operating rules faster than teams can standardise them
zh: 活動機制反覆被做成一次性旅程
資格、進度與獎勵價值難以理解
成長構想帶來新狀態與營運規則的速度，超過團隊標準化能力

en: Separate stable incentive rules from campaign content and presentation.
Make relevance, eligibility, progress, expiry, and reward states visible across the journey.
Turn recurring campaign mechanics into reusable modules, shared definitions, and configurable operating rules.
zh: 將穩定的獎勵規則與活動內容及呈現分開。
在完整旅程中清楚呈現相關性、資格、進度、到期與獎勵狀態。
將反覆出現的活動機制轉化為可重用模組、共享定義與可設定的營運規則。

publicationBoundary.en: Voucher Center and Game Center remain subject to their project-level fact checks; the domain copy uses only patterns also supported by the broader voucher programme.
publicationBoundary.zh: Voucher Center 與 Game Center 仍需完成個別專案事實確認；領域文案只採用同時受到優惠券母計畫支持的模式。

summary.en: Online travel agency journeys shaped by booking conversion, market constraints and connected-trip dependencies.
summary.zh: 受預訂轉換、市場限制與跨產品旅程依賴影響的線上旅遊產品。

cardSubtitle.zh: 線上旅行社與全球預訂

synthesisBasis.en: Synthesised from a global connected-trip booking case and a separate taxi-pickup market strategy.
synthesisBasis.zh: 統整全球 Connected Trip 預訂案例與獨立計程車接送市場策略。

en: Shared journeys break when market or participant constraints surface too late
Users lose trust when commitment and transaction states are ambiguous
Exceptions span multiple parties, markets, or support teams without clear ownership
zh: 市場或參與者限制太晚上浮時，共用旅程容易失效
承諾與交易狀態模糊時，使用者容易失去信任
例外橫跨多方角色、市場或支援團隊，卻缺乏明確責任

en: Map market, participant, content, and policy constraints before finalising the shared journey.
Make commitment, transaction, and exception states explicit at decision points.
Keep one core marketplace model while governing local, participant, and operational variations.
zh: 在共用旅程定案前，先盤點市場、參與者、內容與政策限制。
在關鍵決策點明確呈現承諾、交易與例外狀態。
保留單一核心市場模型，同時治理在地、角色與營運差異。

publicationBoundary.en: Connected Trip conversion evidence and Taxi Pickup strategy recommendations remain separate; no launch or growth outcome is inferred for the strategy case.
publicationBoundary.zh: Connected Trip 轉換證據與 Taxi Pickup 策略建議維持分開；策略案不推論上線或成長成果。

summary.en: Omnichannel checkout, discovery, transactions and post-purchase operations.
summary.zh: 跨通路結帳、探索、交易與購買後營運。

synthesisBasis.en: Synthesised from online and in-store voucher discovery, checkout, payment, recovery, and post-purchase journeys.
synthesisBasis.zh: 統整線上與店內票券探索、結帳、付款、失敗復原與購後旅程。

en: Customers begin with products and baskets while savings are isolated in separate promotional surfaces
Eligibility, stackability, and final value are unclear before checkout
Digital, in-store, payment, and post-purchase states drift across channels
zh: 顧客從商品與購物車開始，但優惠被隔離在獨立促銷介面
資格、可否疊加與最終價值在結帳前不清楚
數位、店內、付款與購後狀態在不同通路間逐漸分歧

en: Surface relevant value where customers evaluate products and build baskets.
Explain applicability, conditions, savings, and recovery before payment.
Use shared state models across wallet, product, cart, checkout, in-store, and post-purchase journeys.
zh: 在顧客評估商品與建立購物車的時刻呈現相關價值。
在付款前說明適用性、條件、實際節省與失敗復原方式。
在票券錢包、商品、購物車、結帳、店內與購後旅程共用同一狀態模型。

publicationBoundary.en: The payment project remains under project-level verification; all three public patterns are independently supported by the verified voucher programme research.
publicationBoundary.zh: 付款專案仍需完成個案驗證；三項公開模式皆可由已驗證的優惠券母計畫研究獨立支持。

summary.en: Skill progression, guided practice, content discovery and playful learning.
summary.zh: 技能進程、引導式練習、內容探索與具趣味性的學習體驗。

synthesisBasis.en: Based on issues encountered in the current Bandzo learning-platform case.
synthesisBasis.zh: 以目前 Bandzo 學習平台案例中實際遇到的問題經驗為基礎。

en: Fragmented content makes progression and next steps difficult to understand
Personalisation depends on grading and content taxonomies that may not yet exist
Discovery, purchase, libraries, and practice become disconnected across devices
zh: 內容零散，使學習進程與下一步難以理解
個人化依賴可能尚未建立的分級與內容分類
探索、購買、個人譜庫與練習在不同裝置間彼此斷裂

en: Turn broad learning goals into a client-manageable content and progression framework.
Preserve useful personalisation with simple, explainable choices until richer taxonomies are ready.
Connect discovery, purchase, access, and practice through one cross-device structure.
zh: 將廣泛的學習目標轉化為客戶可自行管理的內容與進程框架。

ownershipDetail.en: Led channel-constraint and customer-friction analysis; the final mechanism direction required shared business and engineering approval.
ownershipDetail.zh: 主導通路 constraint 與顧客-friction 分析；最終機制方向需由商務與工程共同核准。

ownershipDetail.zh: 主導證據統整與資訊priority recommendations；最終 Visual 語意與設計系統 team 對齊。

title.zh: 從商務團隊要求加入搜尋，到以證據優先支援探索

title.zh: 從單一直接入口，到中央多遊戲中心

title.en: From a broad gamification vision to a focused concurrent-games release
title.zh: 從廣泛遊戲化願景，到聚焦多遊戲並行的首版

title.en: From a fixed game tile to an operator-configured listing
title.zh: 從固定遊戲卡片，到由營運團隊配置列表

title.en: From identical game cards to lifecycle-aware states
title.zh: 從狀態相同的遊戲卡片，到理解遊戲生命週期的狀態

title.en: From adding more layout density to clarifying urgency within the existing list

title.zh: 從以報表為中心的工作方式，到依角色分流的例外案件工作台

title.en: From partial departmental views to one shared decision architecture
title.zh: 從各部門的片段視角，到一套共享的決策架構

title.en: From one suggested taxi to scanable option comparison
title.zh: 從單一建議計程車，到可快速掃描的選項比較

title.en: From repeated form entry to connected itinerary confirmation
title.zh: 從重複填寫表單，到連結旅程資訊的確認流程

title.zh: 從分散的部門資訊，到一套共享的諮詢結構

title.en: From research handoff to a validated, system-aligned delivery
title.zh: 從研究交接，到經驗證且符合既有系統的設計交付

title.en: From separate loyalty and payment steps to one checkout identity
title.zh: 從分離的忠誠與付款步驟，到單一結帳識別

title.en: From ambiguous QR interactions to channel-specific guidance
title.zh: 從模糊的 QR 互動，到依通路設計的操作引導

title.en: From a successful payment screen to an end-to-end recovery and operations model
title.zh: 從付款成功畫面，到端到端恢復與營運模型

title.en: From one generic order list to labeled transaction histories
title.zh: 從單一通用訂單清單，到有清楚標籤的交易紀錄

title.en: From isolated complaints to an end-to-end opportunity model
title.zh: 從零散抱怨，到端到端機會模型

title.en: From late account constraints to upfront routing and resumable stages
title.zh: 從後段才出現的帳戶限制，到前置分流與可續辦階段

title.en: From opaque verification failures to explicit handoffs and recovery states
title.zh: 從不透明的驗證失敗，到明確交接與復原狀態

title.en: From distributed know-how to a verifiable end-to-end operating model
title.zh: 從分散在個人經驗的做法，到可驗證的端到端營運模式

title.en: From equal-weight feedback to benefit-and-feasibility prioritisation
title.zh: 從等權重回饋，到依效益與可行性排序

title.en: From all-at-once digitisation to phased optimisation recommendations
title.zh: 從一次完成全面數位化，到分階段優化建議

title.en: From one generic start to intent-aware application entry
title.zh: 從單一入口，到理解既有決策的申請起點

title.en: From a long restart-prone form to staged, purpose-led completion
title.zh: 從過長且容易重來的表單，到分段且說明目的的完成流程

title.zh: 從紙本與文件阻塞，到協調式的送件後完成模型

title.zh: 從廣泛功能願景，到可上線的學習核心循環

title.en: From disconnected content screens to a connected entitlement-and-practice system

title.en: From a payment service to a trusted P2P marketplace
title.zh: 從支付服務，到值得信任的 P2P 市集

whatIDecided.en: Expanded the initial third-party payment brief into a marketplace model that guided sellers stage by stage and protected buyers throughout the transaction.
whatIDecided.zh: 將原本的第三方支付需求擴展為市集模型，分階段引導賣家，並在交易過程中保障買家。

whyThisChoice.en: Market research showed that Taishin Bank’s trust advantage could create more value through a governed end-to-end service than through an isolated payment function.
whyThisChoice.zh: 市場研究顯示，台新銀行的信任優勢透過受治理的端到端服務，能比單一付款功能創造更完整的價值。

content.en: We accepted a broader service-definition scope instead of a faster payment-only delivery to protect buyer–seller trust and transaction coherence.
content.zh: 我們接受較廣的服務定義範圍，而非更快交付單一付款功能，以保障買賣信任與交易一致性。

title.en: From screen rules to one end-to-end transaction regulation
title.zh: 從逐頁規則，到一套端到端交易規範

whatIDecided.en: Mapped payment, logistics, notifications, service states and response actions into one shared regulation across the bank and software vendor.
whatIDecided.zh: 將付款、物流、通知、服務狀態與回應動作整理為銀行與軟體供應商共用的一套規範。

whyThisChoice.en: Buyer and seller journeys crossed organisational responsibilities; inconsistent state logic would create operational and implementation risk.
whyThisChoice.zh: 買賣雙方旅程橫跨不同組織責任；狀態邏輯不一致會增加營運與實作風險。

content.en: This required shared transaction states and responsibility boundaries before interface specifications could remain consistent.
content.zh: 這需要先建立共用交易狀態與責任邊界，介面規格才能維持一致。

title.en: From separate UX and UI production to reusable patterns
title.zh: 從分離的 UX／UI 製作，到可重用模式

whatIDecided.en: Applied UI-defined patterns inside high-fidelity UX specifications so the broader platform could be documented consistently despite limited UI capacity.
whatIDecided.zh: 在高擬真 UX 規格中套用 UI 已定義的模式，使有限 UI 資源下仍能一致記錄更廣的平台範圍。

whyThisChoice.en: The platform scope exceeded the available UI resource and needed a shared pattern model to protect delivery consistency.
whyThisChoice.zh: 平台範圍超過現有 UI 資源，需要共享模式來維持交付一致性。

content.en: We accepted heavier UX specification effort in exchange for reducing the UI bottleneck and preserving implementation consistency.
content.zh: 我們接受較高的 UX 規格投入，換取降低 UI 瓶頸並維持實作一致性。

title.en: From full expansion to a lower-risk market experiment
title.zh: 從全面擴張，到低風險市場實驗

whatIDecided.en: Recommended a selected-market Phase 1 experiment instead of committing immediately to broad product expansion.
whatIDecided.zh: 建議先在選定市場執行第一階段實驗，而非立即承諾全面產品擴張。

whyThisChoice.en: Customer demand, supplier readiness and market conditions needed to be validated together before larger investment.
whyThisChoice.zh: 顧客需求、供應商成熟度與市場條件必須一起驗證，才能支持更大規模投入。

content.en: We accepted slower geographic expansion in exchange for reducing product, supplier and commercial risk.
content.zh: 我們接受較慢的地域擴張速度，換取降低產品、供應商與商業風險。

title.en: From abstract convenience to a testable price anchor
title.zh: 從抽象便利性，到可驗證的價格錨點

whatIDecided.en: Recommended price anchoring as a Phase 1 proposition test rather than presenting it as a shipped pricing model.
whatIDecided.zh: 建議將價格錨點作為第一階段服務主張測試，而非把它描述為已上線的定價模型。

whyThisChoice.en: Travellers needed a concrete basis for judging the value of pre-booking against familiar local alternatives.
whyThisChoice.zh: 旅客需要具體依據，才能比較預約接送與熟悉的在地替代方案是否值得。

content.en: The recommendation had to remain testable without implying final commercial pricing or launch approval.
content.zh: 此建議必須可被驗證，同時不得暗示最終商業定價或已核准上線。

title.en: From one global premise to market-readiness criteria
title.zh: 從單一全球假設，到市場成熟度準則

whatIDecided.en: Combined customer demand, supplier coverage, local transport context and commercial feasibility into criteria for selecting target markets.
whatIDecided.zh: 將顧客需求、供應商覆蓋、在地交通脈絡與商業可行性整合為目標市場選擇準則。

whyThisChoice.en: A proposition that worked in one market could fail elsewhere when airport behaviour, alternatives or supplier conditions changed.
whyThisChoice.zh: 當機場行為、替代方案或供應商條件改變時，在單一市場成立的服務主張可能無法直接複製。

content.en: This required customer, supplier, market and performance evidence to be evaluated in one decision model.
content.zh: 這需要將顧客、供應商、市場與產品表現證據放在同一套決策模型中評估。

decisionReferenceRules.canonicalOwner: Decision copy remains at each sourcePath in decisionRegistry.

purpose.en: Help senior and principal hiring reviewers distinguish decision quality, individual ownership, system impact and evidence strength without inflating claims.

owned.definition: The candidate completed the named design scope end to end.
owned.definition_zh: 由候選人端到端完成指定設計範圍。

coDecided.definition: The direction was selected jointly with product, engineering, research, business, operations or client partners.
coDecided.definition_zh: 方向由候選人與產品、工程、研究、商務、營運或客戶共同決定。

partnerOwned.definition: A partner owned this specialist input; the candidate integrated it into the product decision.
partnerOwned.definition_zh: 此專業輸入由合作夥伴負責，候選人將其整合進產品決策。

outcomeEvidenceTiers.label: Measured behaviour or operations
outcomeEvidenceTiers.label_zh: 可量測行為或營運結果

publicRule.en: Never present delivery output as measured product outcome. Show the strongest verified tier and state when post-launch data was unavailable.
publicRule.zh: 不得把交付產出寫成產品成效；只呈現已驗證的最高證據層級，並清楚說明何時無法取得上線後資料。

purpose.zh: 以一致的 Problem-至系統視覺語法，讓每個專案在三秒內可被辨識。

One visible problem or before-state clue
One scale, status or verified outcome cue
forbidden: Decorative stock photography without product evidence
Unlabelled mixtures of shipped and concept screens
Dense full-board screenshots as the first image

title.zh: 先釐清系統怎麼運作，再設計畫面。

value.zh: 讓複雜協作有清楚的權責與決策機制。

howIWork.zh: 先定義角色、權限、狀態、決策責任與交接方式。

title.en: Turn shared logic into reusable capability.
title.zh: 把共通規則，整理成團隊能沿用的能力。

profile.turn-one-off-solutions-into-reus.en: Turn one-off solutions into reusable logic and components that scale across journeys.
profile.turn-one-off-solutions-into-reus.zh: 把一次性解法轉成能跨旅程擴展的共用邏輯與元件。

profile.senior-lead-staff-ic-bc790580.zh: 資深 · 設計主管 · 首席個人貢獻者

profile.mapped-the-voucher-and-offer-eco.en: Mapped the voucher and offer ecosystem from executive interviews, concept tests, workshops, and prior research. Established a shared taxonomy and reusable analysis template across operations, marketing, design, and engineering.
profile.mapped-the-voucher-and-offer-eco.zh: 從高層訪談、概念測試、工作坊與既有研究，梳理端到端票券與優惠生態；建立營運、行銷、設計與工程共用的分類與可重用分析樣板。

profile.redesigned-regulated-enterprise-.en: Redesigned regulated enterprise workflows across six countries. Led 3 co-creation workshops plus recurring interviews and online tests to guide iteration with product and engineering.
profile.redesigned-regulated-enterprise-.zh: 重新設計橫跨六國的受監管企業流程；主持 3 場共創工作坊，並持續透過訪談與線上測試，和產品、工程共同推進迭代。

profile.delivered-a-0-1-payment-initiati.en: Delivered a 0→1 payment initiative across app and POS, defining the checkout experience across security, finance, and retail, supported by research and journey mapping.
profile.delivered-a-0-1-payment-initiati.zh: 交付跨 App 與 POS 的 0→1 支付專案，整合資安、財務與零售需求定義結帳體驗，並以研究與旅程地圖支援上線採用。

profile.designed-taxi-booking-journeys-a.en: Designed taxi-booking journeys across 40+ countries, contributing to a verified 7% conversion uplift in two weeks. Built a research toolkit that cut reporting from 3–5 days to 2, then shared evidence with engineering in weekly sessions.
profile.designed-taxi-booking-journeys-a.zh: 設計橫跨 40+ 國家的叫車旅程，兩週內帶來經核實的 7% 轉換提升；另建立研究工具，將報告製作由 3–5 天縮短至 2 天，並在每週會議中與工程分享證據。

profile.shipped-ux-across-e-commerce-cha.en: Shipped UX across e-commerce, chatbots, music, fintech, and government services, from interviews through prototyping and testing; also created a custom Sketch plugin to improve team workflow.
profile.shipped-ux-across-e-commerce-cha.zh: 橫跨電商、聊天機器人、音樂、金融科技與政府服務，從訪談、原型到測試完成產品設計；並建立 Sketch 外掛提升團隊工作效率。

profile.explorations-with-verified-recog.zh: 具備可核實成果的探索作品。

profile.recognised-in-germany-for-game-a.en: Recognised in Germany for game and packaging design.
profile.recognised-in-germany-for-game-a.zh: 遊戲與包裝設計獲德國獎項肯定。

profile.recognised-by-taiwan-s-concept-d.en: Recognised by Taiwan’s concept design programme.
profile.recognised-by-taiwan-s-concept-d.zh: 獲台灣概念設計獎項肯定。

profile.selected-for-the-final-seven-sho.en: Selected for the final seven shortlist in the United Kingdom.
profile.selected-for-the-final-seven-sho.zh: 入選英國最終七強名單。

profile.received-the-special-award-in-ta.en: Received the Special Award in Taiwan.

profile.small-practices-that-keep-me-obs.en: Small practices that keep me observant.
profile.small-practices-that-keep-me-obs.zh: 讓我持續保持觀察力的小練習。

profile.drawing-composing-travel-and-div.en: Drawing, composing, travel, and diving shape how I notice rhythm, context, emotion, and uncertainty.
profile.drawing-composing-travel-and-div.zh: 畫畫、作曲、旅行與潛水，影響我觀察節奏、情境、情緒與不確定性的方式。

profile.emotion-through-contrast-and-pro.zh: 透過對比與推進建立情緒。

profile.i-turn-complex-rules-into-em-sys.en: I turn complex rules into systems teams can scale.
profile.i-turn-complex-rules-into-em-sys.zh: 我把複雜規則，轉化為團隊能擴展的系統。

contentWritingStandard.purpose: Keep public portfolio copy clear, credible, scannable, and relevant to Principal Product Designer hiring.

style: Lead with the change, decision, or outcome.
Use active voice and specific verbs.
Avoid stacked nouns, internal acronyms, and generic UX language.
Use product and operational terminology only when it improves precision.
使用台灣產品、金融與營運團隊自然使用的繁體中文。
先寫改變、決策或結果，再補充方法。
句子短而直接，避免英文語序與逐字翻譯。
有清楚中文對應時，不在中文句子中混用英文。
公司名、正式產品名與核准縮寫可保留英文。
避免中國大陸慣用詞與空泛管理術語。

sectionPurpose.title: Communicate the transformation.
sectionPurpose.atAGlance: Summarise role, problem, action, scale, and outcome.
sectionPurpose.whyItMattered: Explain business urgency without describing the solution.
sectionPurpose.businessImpact: State the durable business or operating change.
sectionPurpose.keyInterventionMap: Show where the system, workflow, or experience changed.

projectCardCopyStandard.purpose: A shorter project-card title optimised for fast scanning and balanced line breaks. It does not replace the full transformation title on the project detail page.

english.rule: Lead with the product or system change.

rules: Keep the central product noun phrase intact.
Avoid ending a line with a modifier that belongs to the following noun.
Prefer one clear verb and one product outcome.
Do not force the full From–to construction into compact project cards.
